"""Assembly process graph: operations + precedence, compiled from the validated IPL and sequence.

Each operation says *what is done to which items, in which order, with what* — so text
generation only has to word decisions that are already made. Every operation lists its
IPL rows and 3D occurrences, which is what lets a revision find the steps a changed part
touches.

Disassembly is built from the planned removal order; assembly is derived from it (reverse
order, remove -> install, unfasten -> fasten with torque, discarded parts -> new parts),
then drawing notes add their operations (conductive compound, sealant, lock wire, test).
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import re
from collections import defaultdict

NM_TO_LBFIN = 8.8507458


def torque_range(tq: dict | None) -> dict | None:
    if not tq:
        return None
    lo = tq.get("min_nm") if tq.get("min_nm") is not None else tq["nominal_nm"]
    hi = tq.get("max_nm") if tq.get("max_nm") is not None else tq["nominal_nm"]
    return {"min_nm": round(lo, 2), "max_nm": round(hi, 2), "min_lbfin": round(lo * NM_TO_LBFIN, 1),
            "max_lbfin": round(hi * NM_TO_LBFIN, 1), "nominal_nm": tq["nominal_nm"]}


def note_supply_name(note_text: str, spec: str) -> str | None:
    """'... WITH CONDUCTIVE COMPOUND ACCORDING TO IFC30-145-07' -> 'conductive compound'."""
    up = " ".join(note_text.upper().split())
    m = re.search(rf"([A-Z][A-Z \-]{{2,60}}?)\s+(?:ACCORDING TO|PER|TO)\s+{re.escape(spec)}", up)
    if not m:
        return None
    phrase = re.split(r"\b(?:WITH|BY|OF|FOR|AND INSTALLATION|INSTALLATION)\b", m.group(1))[-1].strip()
    words = [w for w in phrase.split() if w not in ("THE", "A", "AN", "ALL")]
    if len(words) <= 1:
        return None                      # too generic ("compound"): the MBOM description says more
    return " ".join(words[-6:]).lower()


# sub-assemblies that are not taken apart in a CMM (joined for good, or replaced as a unit)
NO_DISASSY = re.compile(r"\b(SHRUNK|SHRINK|WOUND|BONDED|WELDED|BRAZED|RIVETED|CRIMPED|SWAGED|STAKED|LAMINAT\w*|POTTED|"
                        r"EQUIPPED|MACHINING|STACK|PRINTED CIRCUIT|PCB|HARNESS|CABLE ASSY)\b", re.I)
# parts left in place when their sub-assembly is disassembled (press fits, the body itself)
NO_REMOVE = re.compile(r"\b(EXPANSION|KOENIG|LEE|INSERT|HELICOIL|DOWEL|MACHINING|IDENTIFICATION|ISO8734|"
                       r"RULES OF DESIGN|GREASE|TAPE|SHEATH|COMPOUND|ADHESIVE|SEALANT|VARNISH|PAINT)\b", re.I)


def wrench_for(max_nm: float) -> str:
    for lo, hi in ((0.2, 2.0), (1, 12), (5, 30), (20, 110), (60, 340)):
        if max_nm <= hi * 0.9:
            return f"Torque wrench, {lo:g} to {hi:g} N.m"
    return "Torque wrench"


class _Ids:
    def __init__(self, prefix: str):
        self.prefix, self.n = prefix, 0

    def __call__(self) -> str:
        self.n += 1
        return f"{self.prefix}{self.n:03d}"


def _item(row: dict) -> dict:
    return {"row_id": row["id"], "item": row["item"], "part_number": row["part_number"],
            "nomenclature": row["nomenclature"], "role": row["role"], "qty": row.get("units_per_assy"),
            "step_name": row.get("step_name")}


def build_process(ipl: dict, sequence: dict, drawing: dict | None, options: dict | None = None) -> dict:
    options = options or {}
    rows = [r for r in ipl["rows"] if r.get("status") != "rejected"]
    by_id = {r["id"]: r for r in rows}
    row_of_occ = {o: r for r in rows for o in r["occ_ids"] if not r.get("alternate_of")}
    top = next((r for r in rows if r["depth"] == 0), None)
    notes = (drawing or {}).get("notes", [])
    supplies_by_spec = {s["spec"]: s for s in ipl.get("supplies", [])}

    def item_rows(occs: list[str]) -> list[dict]:
        seen, out = set(), []
        for o in occs:
            r = row_of_occ.get(o)
            if r and r["id"] not in seen:
                seen.add(r["id"])
                out.append(r)
        return out

    def count(row: dict, occs: list[str]) -> int:
        return sum(1 for o in occs if o in row["occ_ids"]) or (row.get("units_per_assy") or 1)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ disassembly, level by level
    # Level 1: the parts of the unit, part by part (attaching parts, the part, the parts fitted on it), in
    # the planner's order. Then each sub-assembly that came off is disassembled in its own subtask, from its
    # own plan (the STEP sub-assembly) or, without one, in parts-list order; and so on down the levels.
    kids_of: dict[str, list[dict]] = defaultdict(list)
    for r in rows:
        if r.get("parent_row") and not r.get("alternate_of"):
            kids_of[r["parent_row"]].append(r)

    def child_of(row: dict | None, pid: str) -> dict | None:
        r, seen = row, set()
        while r is not None and r.get("parent_row") != pid:
            if r["id"] in seen or not r.get("parent_row"):
                return None
            seen.add(r["id"])
            r = by_id.get(r["parent_row"])
        return r

    op_id = _Ids("op-d")
    subtasks: list[dict] = []
    ops: list[dict] = []
    used_occs: set[str] = set()                 # 3D occurrences already taken off by an operation
    used_rows: set[str] = set()                 # rows without 3D taken off

    def done_row(r: dict) -> bool:
        """Already taken off by an earlier operation (a shared part number counts per occurrence)."""
        return all(o in used_occs for o in r["occ_ids"]) if r["occ_ids"] else r["id"] in used_rows
    prev_op = None

    def new_st(title: str = "", **kw) -> dict:
        st = {"id": f"st-d{len(subtasks) + 1:02d}", "title": title, "ops": [], "rows": [], **kw}
        subtasks.append(st)
        return st

    def add(op: dict, st: dict) -> dict:
        nonlocal prev_op
        op["id"] = op_id()
        op["after"] = [prev_op] if prev_op else []
        prev_op = op["id"]
        ops.append(op)
        st["ops"].append(op["id"])
        here = set(op.get("occ_ids", []))
        for i in op.get("items", []) + op.get("with", []):
            r = by_id.get(i["row_id"])
            if r and r["occ_ids"]:
                hit = [o for o in r["occ_ids"] if o in here]
                # a sub-assembly row linked to its assembly occurrence: its parts are in the op, so it is all off
                used_occs.update(hit or r["occ_ids"])
            else:
                used_rows.add(i["row_id"])
        return op

    def flags_for(forced: bool) -> list[str]:
        return ["Order forced by the planner: check the 3D."] if forced else []

    def level(steps: list[dict], pid: str, base_occ: str | None, default_from: dict | None,
              one_subtask: dict | None = None, only=None) -> list[dict]:
        """Removal ops for the children of row ``pid``. -> the child rows removed, in order."""
        grouped: list[dict] = []
        for s in steps:
            rws = item_rows(s["members"])
            mains = [m for m in (child_of(r, pid) for r in rws) if m is not None and m["depth"] != 0]
            if not mains:
                continue
            main = mains[0]
            if only is not None and not only(main):
                continue
            # carried parts at this level: a part of a carried sub-assembly counts as that sub-assembly
            riders = []
            for r in item_rows(s["riders"]):
                lr = child_of(r, pid) or r
                if lr["id"] != main["id"] and lr["id"] not in {x["id"] for x in riders} and not done_row(lr):
                    riders.append(lr)
            g = next((g for g in grouped if g["main"]["id"] == main["id"]), None)
            if g:
                g["occs"] += s["members"]
                g["rider_occs"] += s["riders"]
                g["steps"].append(s["step"])
                g["forced"] = g["forced"] or s["forced"]
                for r in riders:
                    if r["id"] not in {x["id"] for x in g["riders"]}:
                        g["riders"].append(r)
            else:
                grouped.append({"main": main, "occs": list(s["members"]), "rider_occs": list(s["riders"]),
                                "riders": riders, "steps": [s["step"]], "direction": s["direction_label"],
                                "forced": s["forced"]})
        level_ids = {r["id"] for r in kids_of.get(pid, [])}

        def is_att(r: dict) -> bool:
            return bool(r["attaching"] and r.get("attaching_for") in level_ids and r["attaching_for"] != r["id"])

        attaching_groups: dict[str, list[dict]] = defaultdict(list)
        for g in grouped:
            if is_att(g["main"]):
                attaching_groups[g["main"]["attaching_for"]].append(g)
        main_groups = [g for g in grouped if not is_att(g["main"])]
        for t, gs in attaching_groups.items():                  # attaching parts whose item is never removed
            if t not in {g["main"]["id"] for g in main_groups}:
                main_groups.append({"main": by_id[t], "occs": [], "rider_occs": [], "riders": [],
                                    "steps": [min(min(x["steps"]) for x in gs)], "direction": None,
                                    "forced": False, "stays": True})
        main_groups.sort(key=lambda g: min([min(g["steps"])] + [min(x["steps"]) for x in attaching_groups.get(g["main"]["id"], [])]))

        base_row = next((child_of(r, pid) for r in rows if base_occ and base_occ in r["occ_ids"]), None)
        from_row = base_row or default_from
        removed: list[dict] = []
        for g in main_groups:
            main = g["main"]
            if done_row(main) and not attaching_groups.get(main["id"]):
                continue
            st = one_subtask or new_st()
            st["rows"].append(main["id"])
            for ag in sorted(attaching_groups.get(main["id"], []), key=lambda x: min(x["steps"])):
                ar = ag["main"]
                if done_row(ar) or (ar["role"] == "washer" and ar.get("fastener_row")):
                    continue
                st["rows"].append(ar["id"])
                washers = [r for r in rows if r["role"] == "washer" and r.get("fastener_row") == ar["id"]]
                items = [{**_item(ar), "count": count(ar, ag["occs"])}]
                for w in washers:
                    items.append({**_item(w), "count": w.get("units_per_assy") or 1})
                    st["rows"].append(w["id"])
                add({"type": "unfasten", "phase": "disassembly", "items": items,
                     "occ_ids": ag["occs"] + [o for w in washers for o in w["occ_ids"]],
                     "from": {**_item(main), "count": count(main, g["occs"]) if g["occs"] else (main.get("units_per_assy") or 1)},
                     "torque": torque_range(ar.get("torque")), "direction": ag["direction"], "flags": flags_for(ag["forced"])}, st)
            if g.get("stays") or done_row(main):
                if not one_subtask:
                    st["title"] = f"Remove the attaching parts from the {main['nomenclature'].lower()}"
                    st["kind"] = "attaching"
                continue
            loose = [r for r in g["riders"] if not r["permanent"] and child_of(r, main["id"]) is None and not done_row(r)]
            frm = from_row if from_row and from_row["id"] != main["id"] else default_from
            add({"type": "remove", "phase": "disassembly", "items": [{**_item(main), "count": count(main, g["occs"])}],
                 "occ_ids": g["occs"] + g["rider_occs"], "from": _item(frm) if frm else None,
                 "discard": bool(main.get("discard_on_removal")) or main["role"] in ("seal", "backup_ring"),
                 "with": [{**_item(r), "count": count(r, g["rider_occs"])} for r in g["riders"] if not done_row(r)],
                 "direction": g["direction"], "flags": flags_for(g["forced"])}, st)
            removed.append(main)
            removed += [r for r in loose if kids_of.get(r["id"])]      # carried sub-assemblies are disassembled too
            if loose:
                discard = [r for r in loose if r["discard_on_removal"]]
                add({"type": "remove_from", "phase": "disassembly",
                     "items": [{**_item(r), "count": count(r, g["rider_occs"])} for r in loose],
                     "occ_ids": [o for r in loose for o in r["occ_ids"] if o in g["rider_occs"]],
                     "from": {**_item(main), "count": count(main, g["occs"])},
                     "discard": bool(discard) and len(discard) == len(loose), "discard_items": [r["id"] for r in discard]}, st)
            if not one_subtask:
                st["title"] = f"Remove the {main['nomenclature'].lower()}"
        return removed

    def _k(x: str) -> str:
        return re.sub(r"[^A-Z0-9]", "", (x or "").upper())

    def plan_for(row: dict, kids: list[dict]) -> dict | None:
        """The STEP sub-assembly plan for an IPL sub-assembly: by its 3D link, its part number, or the plan
        that holds most of its parts (the 3D link of an assembly row can be a fuzzy match)."""
        for o in row["occ_ids"]:
            if o in sub_plans:
                return sub_plans[o]
        k = _k(row["part_number"])
        for oid, p in sub_plans.items():
            if k and _k(oid.rsplit("_", 1)[0]).endswith(k):
                return p
        kid_occs = {o for x in kids for o in x["occ_ids"]}
        best, n = None, 1
        for p in sub_plans.values():
            m = len(kid_occs & {o for s in p.get("disassembly", []) for o in s["members"] + s["riders"]})
            if m > n:
                best, n = p, m
        return best

    def stays_assembled(row: dict) -> bool:
        return bool(NO_DISASSY.search(row["nomenclature"] or ""))

    def removable(r: dict) -> bool:
        return bool(r["occ_ids"]) and not r["permanent"] and (r.get("units_per_assy") or 0) > 0 \
            and r["role"] not in ("insert", "press_plug", "plate") and not NO_REMOVE.search(r["nomenclature"] or "") \
            and not r.get("process")

    def disassemble(row: dict, keep_note: list[dict]) -> None:
        """'Disassemble the <sub-assembly>': its own parts, then its sub-assemblies, depth first."""
        kids = [k for k in kids_of.get(row["id"], []) if (k.get("units_per_assy") or 0) > 0]
        if not kids:
            return
        todo = [k for k in kids if removable(k) and not done_row(k)]
        if stays_assembled(row) or not todo:
            if any(k["occ_ids"] for k in kids):
                keep_note.append(row)
            return
        if len(todo) == 1 and not any(k["attaching"] for k in todo):
            keep_note.append(row)                    # one part left: that is the body, nothing comes apart
            return
        st = new_st(f"Disassemble the {row['nomenclature'].lower()}", kind="disassemble", assy_row=row["id"])
        st["rows"].append(row["id"])
        plan = plan_for(row, kids)
        base_kid = None
        if plan:
            base_kid = next((child_of(r, row["id"]) for r in rows if plan.get("base_unit") in r["occ_ids"]), None)
            removed = level(plan.get("disassembly", []), row["id"], plan.get("base_unit"), row, one_subtask=st,
                            only=removable)
        else:
            removed = []
        # parts the plan did not reach (or no plan): parts-list order, attaching parts before their part
        for k in [k for k in kids if removable(k) and not done_row(k) and k is not base_kid
                  and not (k["attaching"] and k.get("attaching_for") in {x["id"] for x in kids})]:
            for a in [a for a in kids if a["attaching"] and a.get("attaching_for") == k["id"] and not done_row(a) and a["occ_ids"]]:
                add({"type": "unfasten", "phase": "disassembly", "items": [{**_item(a), "count": a.get("units_per_assy") or 1}],
                     "occ_ids": a["occ_ids"], "from": _item(k), "torque": torque_range(a.get("torque")), "flags": []}, st)
                st["rows"].append(a["id"])
            add({"type": "remove", "phase": "disassembly", "items": [{**_item(k), "count": k.get("units_per_assy") or 1}],
                 "occ_ids": list(k["occ_ids"]), "from": _item(row), "with": [], "flags": [] if plan else
                 ["No 3D sub-assembly to plan from: parts-list order. Check the order."]}, st)
            st["rows"].append(k["id"])
            removed.append(k)
        if not st["ops"]:
            subtasks.remove(st)
            return
        notes: list[dict] = []
        for k in list({k["id"]: k for k in removed}.values()):
            disassemble(k, notes)
        notes = list({n["id"]: n for n in notes}.values())
        if notes:
            add({"type": "do_not_disassemble", "phase": "disassembly", "items": [{**_item(n), "count": 1} for n in notes],
                 "occ_ids": [o for n in notes for o in n["occ_ids"]]}, st)

    # preliminary: unmodelled caps and lock wire come off first
    pre = [r for r in rows if not r["occ_ids"] and r["depth"] >= 1 and not r.get("alternate_of")
           and r["role"] in ("cap", "lockwire") and (r.get("units_per_assy") or 0) > 0 and r["depth"] == 1]
    if pre:
        st = {"id": "st-d00", "title": "Remove the protective items", "ops": [], "rows": [r["id"] for r in pre]}
        subtasks.append(st)
        for r in pre:
            add({"type": "remove", "phase": "disassembly", "items": [{**_item(r), "count": r.get("units_per_assy") or 1}],
                 "occ_ids": [], "from": _item(top) if top else None, "discard": r["role"] == "lockwire",
                 "flags": ["Not in the 3D model: confirm where this item is installed."]}, st)

    sub_plans = sequence.get("sub") or {}
    top_id = top["id"] if top else None
    removed_top = level(sequence.get("disassembly", []), top_id, sequence.get("base_unit"), None) if top_id else []
    kept: list[dict] = []
    base_top = next((child_of(r, top_id) for r in rows if sequence.get("base_unit") in r["occ_ids"]), None) if top_id else None
    for row in removed_top + ([base_top] if base_top and base_top not in removed_top else []):
        disassemble(row, kept)

    perm = [r for r in rows if r["permanent"] and r["occ_ids"] and r["role"] in ("insert", "press_plug") and not r.get("alternate_of")]
    if perm or kept:
        st = new_st("Parts that stay installed")
        st["id"] = f"st-d{len(subtasks):02d}x"
        st["rows"] = [r["id"] for r in perm + kept]
        if kept:
            add({"type": "do_not_disassemble", "phase": "disassembly", "items": [{**_item(n), "count": 1} for n in kept],
                 "occ_ids": [o for n in kept for o in n["occ_ids"]]}, st)
        if perm:
            add({"type": "do_not_remove", "phase": "disassembly", "items": [{**_item(r), "count": r.get("units_per_assy") or 1} for r in perm],
                 "occ_ids": [o for r in perm for o in r["occ_ids"]], "condition": "unless they are damaged"}, st)

    disassembly = {"subtasks": subtasks, "operations": ops}

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ assembly: derived
    aop = _Ids("op-a")
    a_ops: list[dict] = []
    a_sub: list[dict] = []
    prev_a = None
    by_op = {o["id"]: o for o in ops}
    note_by_op = defaultdict(list)
    for n in notes:
        note_by_op[n["op"]].append(n)

    def add_a(op: dict, st: dict) -> dict:
        nonlocal prev_a
        op["id"] = aop()
        op["after"] = [prev_a] if prev_a else []
        prev_a = op["id"]
        a_ops.append(op)
        st["ops"].append(op["id"])
        return op

    def supply(sp: str, n: dict) -> dict:
        name = note_supply_name(n["text"], sp) or (supplies_by_spec.get(sp) or {}).get("description") or n["label"]
        return {"spec": sp, "name": name, "description": (supplies_by_spec.get(sp) or {}).get("description"),
                "note": n["text"]}

    def note_supply(op_kind: str, role: str) -> list[dict]:
        out = []
        for n in note_by_op.get(op_kind, []):
            if not n["targets"] or role in n["targets"]:
                out += [supply(sp, n) for sp in n["specs"]]
        return out

    NOTES = ("do_not_remove", "do_not_disassemble")
    for st in reversed([s for s in subtasks if s["id"] != "st-d00"]):
        d_ops = [by_op[o] for o in st["ops"] if by_op[o]["type"] not in NOTES]
        if not d_ops:
            continue
        main_row = by_id[st["rows"][0]]
        ast = {"id": st["id"].replace("st-d", "st-a"), "title": "", "ops": [], "rows": list(st["rows"]),
               **({"kind": "assemble", "assy_row": st["assy_row"]} if st.get("kind") == "disassemble" else
                  {"kind": "attaching"} if st.get("kind") == "attaching" else {})}
        a_sub.append(ast)
        for o in reversed(d_ops):
            if o["type"] == "remove_from":
                add_a({"type": "install_on", "phase": "assembly", "items": o["items"], "occ_ids": o["occ_ids"],
                       "on": o["from"], "new_parts": o.get("discard", False),
                       "new_items": o.get("discard_items", [])}, ast)
            elif o["type"] == "remove":
                role = o["items"][0]["role"]
                add_a({"type": "install", "phase": "assembly", "items": o["items"], "occ_ids": o["occ_ids"],
                       "on": o.get("from"), "with": o.get("with", []), "new_parts": bool(o.get("discard")),
                       "torque": torque_range((by_id.get(o["items"][0]["row_id"]) or main_row).get("torque")),
                       "references": note_supply("install_fittings", role) if role == "fitting" else [],
                       "direction": o.get("direction")}, ast)
            elif o["type"] == "unfasten":
                role = o["items"][0]["role"]
                fop = add_a({"type": "fasten", "phase": "assembly", "items": o["items"], "occ_ids": o["occ_ids"],
                             "on": o["from"], "torque": o.get("torque"),
                             "supplies": note_supply("apply_conductive_compound", role),
                             "flags": [] if o.get("torque") else ["No torque found on the drawing for these fasteners."]}, ast)
                seal_notes = [n for n in note_by_op.get("apply_sealant", []) if n["phase"] == "after_install"
                              and role in n["targets"]]
                if seal_notes:
                    add_a({"type": "apply", "phase": "assembly", "what": "sealant", "on_items": fop["items"],
                           "items": fop["items"], "occ_ids": o["occ_ids"],
                           "supplies": [supply(sp, n) for n in seal_notes for sp in n["specs"]]}, ast)
        ast["title"] = ("Assemble the " if st.get("kind") == "disassemble" else
                        "Install the attaching parts on the " if st.get("kind") == "attaching" else "Install the ") + main_row["nomenclature"].lower()

    close = []
    caps = [r for r in rows if r["role"] == "cap" and not r["occ_ids"] and not r.get("alternate_of") and r["depth"] == 1
            and (r.get("units_per_assy") or 0) > 0]
    for n in note_by_op.get("lockwire", []):
        close.append({"type": "lockwire", "spec": n["specs"], "text": n["text"],
                      "items": [_item(r) for r in rows if r["role"] == "lockwire" and not r.get("alternate_of") and r["depth"] == 1],
                      "flags": ["The drawing calls for lock wire; the parts to safety are not identified — add them."]})
    for n in note_by_op.get("test", []):
        close.append({"type": "test", "spec": n["specs"], "text": n["text"]})
    for n in note_by_op.get("apply_sealant", []):
        if n["phase"] == "after_test":
            plugs = [r for r in rows if r["role"] == "press_plug" and not r.get("alternate_of")]
            close.append({"type": "apply_after_test", "spec": n["specs"], "text": n["text"],
                          "items": [_item(r) for r in plugs]})
    if close:
        st = {"id": "st-a99", "title": "Safety and test", "ops": [], "rows": []}
        a_sub.append(st)
        for c in close:
            add_a({"phase": "assembly", "occ_ids": [], **c,
                   "supplies": [supply(sp, {"text": c["text"], "label": c["text"][:60]}) for sp in c.get("spec", []) if sp != "ATS"]}, st)
    if caps:
        st = {"id": "st-a98", "title": "Install the protective items", "ops": [], "rows": [r["id"] for r in caps]}
        a_sub.append(st)
        for r in caps:
            add_a({"type": "install", "phase": "assembly", "items": [{**_item(r), "count": r.get("units_per_assy") or 1}],
                   "occ_ids": [], "on": None, "flags": ["Not in the 3D model: confirm where this item is installed."]}, st)

    general = [{"text": n["text"], "specs": n["specs"], "label": n["label"], "op": n["op"]}
               for n in notes if n["phase"] == "general"]
    assembly = {"subtasks": a_sub, "operations": a_ops}
    return {"format": "studio.process/1", "disassembly": disassembly, "assembly": assembly,
            "general_notes": general, "top": _item(top) if top else None}

"""ATA iSpec 2200 CMM (XML form): DISASSEMBLY (pgblk 3000), ASSEMBLY (pgblk 7000) and the IPL (pgblk 10000).

Structure and attribute conventions follow ASTHRA's RA-7100 reference CMM: ``task`` /
``topic`` / ``subtask`` with ``prclist1`` / ``prcitem1`` / ``prcitem`` / ``para``, warnings and
cautions at subtask level, ``ted`` (tools) and ``con`` (consumables) inline, and the IPL as
``dplist`` / ``figure`` / ``prtlist`` / ``itemdata`` with keyword-adjective nomenclature.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from xml.sax.saxutils import escape, quoteattr

from .config import PublicationConfig


def _a(**kw) -> str:
    return "".join(f" {k}={quoteattr(str(v))}" for k, v in kw.items() if v is not None and v != "")


def _common(cfg: PublicationConfig, pgblk: str, revdate: str) -> dict:
    return {"chapnbr": cfg.ata_chapter, "sectnbr": cfg.ata_section, "subjnbr": cfg.ata_subject,
            "pgblknbr": pgblk, "chg": "n", "revdate": revdate}


def _proc_pgblk(proc: dict, cfg: PublicationConfig, revdate: str) -> str:
    dis = proc["kind"] == "disassembly"
    pg, tfunc, sfunc, title = ("3000", "000", "040", "DISASSEMBLY") if dis else ("7000", "400", "420", "ASSEMBLY")
    c = _common(cfg, pg, revdate)
    key = f"{cfg.ata_chapter}{cfg.ata_section}{cfg.ata_subject}"
    safety = proc.get("safety", {})
    subs = []
    for i, st in enumerate(proc["subtasks"], start=1):
        wc = "".join(f"<{safety[w]['kind']}><para>{escape(safety[w]['text'])}</para></{safety[w]['kind']}>"
                     for w in st.get("warnings", []) + st.get("cautions", []) if w in safety)
        items = "".join(f"<prcitem1><prcitem><para>{escape(s['text'])}</para></prcitem></prcitem1>" for s in st["steps"])
        subs.append(f"<subtask{_a(**{**c, 'func': sfunc, 'seq': f'{i:03d}', 'confltr': 'A', 'varnbr': '1', 'key': f'subtask-{key}-{sfunc}-{i:03d}-a01'})}>"
                    f"<title>{escape(st['title'])}</title>{wc}<prclist1>{items}</prclist1></subtask>")
    pre = proc["preliminary"]
    pre_items = []
    for w in pre.get("warnings", []):
        if w in safety:
            pre_items.append(f"<{safety[w]['kind']}><para>{escape(safety[w]['text'])}</para></{safety[w]['kind']}>")
    lines = []
    for s in pre.get("support_equipment", []):
        lines.append(f"<prcitem1><prcitem><para>Use the <ted><toolnbr>{escape(s['id'].upper())}</toolnbr>"
                     f"<toolname>{escape(s['name'])}</toolname></ted>.</para></prcitem></prcitem1>")
    for s in pre.get("supplies", []):
        lines.append(f"<prcitem1><prcitem><para>Get the <con><connbr>{escape(s['spec'])}</connbr>"
                     f"<conname>{escape(s['name'])}</conname></con>.</para></prcitem></prcitem1>")
    for s in pre.get("spares", []):
        lines.append(f"<prcitem1><prcitem><para>Get {s['qty']} new {escape(s['name'])} ({escape(s['item'])}), "
                     f"{escape(s['part_number'])}.</para></prcitem></prcitem1>")
    for p in proc.get("common_info", []):
        lines.append(f"<prcitem1><prcitem><para>{escape(p)}</para></prcitem></prcitem1>")
    prep = ""
    if pre_items and not lines:
        lines.append("<prcitem1><prcitem><para>Obey the warning before you start the procedure.</para></prcitem></prcitem1>")
    if lines or pre_items:
        prep = (f"<subtask{_a(**{**c, 'func': sfunc, 'seq': '000', 'confltr': 'A', 'varnbr': '1', 'key': f'subtask-{key}-{sfunc}-000-a01'})}>"
                f"<title>Preparation</title>{''.join(pre_items)}<prclist1>{''.join(lines)}</prclist1></subtask>")
    task = (f"<task{_a(**{**c, 'func': tfunc, 'seq': '801', 'confltr': 'A', 'varnbr': '1', 'key': f'task-{key}-{tfunc}-801-a01'})}>"
            f"<title>{title.title()}</title><topic>{prep}{''.join(subs)}</topic></task>")
    return f"<pgblk{_a(**{**c, 'key': f'pgblk-{key}-{pg}'})}><title>{title}</title>{task}</pgblk>"


def _ipl(ipl: dict, cfg: PublicationConfig, revdate: str, title: str) -> str:
    c = _common(cfg, "10000", revdate)
    key = f"{cfg.ata_chapter}{cfg.ata_section}{cfg.ata_subject}"
    items = []
    for r in ipl["rows"]:
        if r.get("status") == "rejected" or not r.get("item"):
            continue
        nom = r["nomenclature"]
        kwd, adt = (nom.split(",", 1) + [""])[:2] if "," in nom else (nom, "")
        msc = ""
        if r.get("torque"):
            t = r["torque"]
            msc = f"<msc>TORQUE {t['nominal_nm']:g} N.M" + (f" +/- {t['tolerance_nm']:g}" if t.get("tolerance_nm") else "") + "</msc>"
        upa = r.get("units_per_assy")
        upa_s = "RF" if r["depth"] == 0 else ("AR" if upa is None else str(upa))
        indent = max(r["indent"] - 1, 0)
        illus = "1" if r.get("occ_ids") else "0"
        items.append(f"<itemdata{_a(itemnbr=r['item'] if r['depth'] else '1', attach='1' if r.get('attaching_for') else '0', illusind=illus, indent=str(indent), delitem='0')}>"
                     f"<pnr>{escape(r['part_number'])}</pnr>"
                     f"<iplnom><nom><kwd>{escape(kwd.strip())}</kwd>" + (f"<adt>{escape(adt.strip())}</adt>" if adt.strip() else "")
                     + f"</nom>{msc}</iplnom>"
                     + (f"<effcode>{escape(r['effectivity'])}</effcode>" if r.get("effectivity") else "")
                     + (f"<mfr>V{escape(r['cage'])}</mfr>" if r.get("cage") and r["depth"] else "")
                     + f"<upa>{upa_s}</upa></itemdata>")
    return (f"<ipl{_a(**{**c, 'key': 'ipl-1'})}><title>ILLUSTRATED PARTS LIST</title><dplist><title>DETAILED PARTS LIST</title>"
            f"<figure{_a(**{**c, 'func': '950', 'seq': '1', 'confltr': 'A', 'varnbr': '1', 'fignbr': cfg.figure_number, 'key': f'figure-{key}-1'})}>"
            f"<title>FIGURE {escape(cfg.figure_number)} - {escape(title.upper())}</title>"
            f"<prtlist{_a(chg='n', key='prtlist-1', revdate=revdate)}>{''.join(items)}</prtlist></figure></dplist></ipl>")


def render_cmm(procs: list[dict], ipl: dict, cfg: PublicationConfig, title: str) -> tuple[str, str]:
    revdate = (cfg.issue_date or "").replace("-", "")
    top = next((r for r in ipl["rows"] if r["depth"] == 0), None)
    partinfo = ""
    if top:
        partinfo = (f"<partinfo><cmpnom>{escape(title.upper())}</cmpnom><mfrpnr><pnr>{escape(top['part_number'])}</pnr>"
                    f"<mfr>{escape(top.get('cage') or cfg.enterprise_code)}</mfr></mfrpnr></partinfo>")
    blocks = "".join(_proc_pgblk(p, cfg, revdate) for p in sorted(procs, key=lambda p: p["kind"] != "disassembly"))
    xml = ('<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>\n'
           f"<cmm{_a(spl=cfg.enterprise_code, oidate=revdate, tsn='0', docnbr=cfg.cmm_doc_number or (top or {}).get('part_number', ''), lang=cfg.language, chapnbr=cfg.ata_chapter, sectnbr=cfg.ata_section, subjnbr=cfg.ata_subject, type='cmm', prelim='1', chg='n', revdate=revdate)}>"
           f"<title>COMPONENT MAINTENANCE MANUAL WITH ILLUSTRATED PARTS LIST</title>{partinfo}{blocks}{_ipl(ipl, cfg, revdate, title)}</cmm>\n")
    name = f"CMM-{cfg.ata_chapter}-{cfg.ata_section}-{cfg.ata_subject}_{(top or {}).get('part_number', 'IPL')}.xml"
    return name, xml

FILE: backend\studio\publish\config.py

"""Publication identity: DMC / CMM numbering and company data, set once per project."""
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass, field
from datetime import date


@dataclass
class PublicationConfig:
    # S1000D data module code
    model_ident_code: str = "TECHPUB"
    system_diff_code: str = "A"
    system_code: str = "32"
    sub_system_code: str = "4"
    sub_sub_system_code: str = "2"
    assy_code: str = "11"
    disassy_code: str = "00"
    disassy_code_variant: str = "A"
    item_location_code: str = "C"
    language: str = "en"
    country: str = "US"
    issue_number: str = "001"
    in_work: str = "01"
    security_classification: str = "01"
    enterprise_code: str = ""
    enterprise_name: str = ""
    applicability: str = ""
    # the BREX the data modules name (brexDmRef): the S1000D default, or the project's own BREX
    brex_dmc: str = "S1000D-G-04-10-0301-00A-022A-D"
    # ATA iSpec 2200 CMM
    ata_chapter: str = "32"
    ata_section: str = "42"
    ata_subject: str = "11"
    cmm_doc_number: str = ""
    figure_number: str = "1"
    issue_date: str = field(default_factory=lambda: date.today().isoformat())

    def sns(self) -> dict:
        return {"systemCode": self.system_code, "subSystemCode": self.sub_system_code,
                "subSubSystemCode": self.sub_sub_system_code, "assyCode": self.assy_code}

    def dmc(self, info_code: str, variant: str = "A") -> dict:
        return {"modelIdentCode": self.model_ident_code, "systemDiffCode": self.system_diff_code, **self.sns(),
                "disassyCode": self.disassy_code, "disassyCodeVariant": self.disassy_code_variant,
                "infoCode": info_code, "infoCodeVariant": variant, "itemLocationCode": self.item_location_code}

    def brex_dmcode(self) -> dict:
        """brex_dmc ("MIC-SDC-SYS-SUBSUBSUB-ASSY-DISVAR-INFOVAR-LOC", with or without "DMC-") -> dmCode attributes."""
        import re
        m = re.fullmatch(r"(?:DMC-)?([A-Z0-9]{2,14})-([A-Z0-9]{1,4})-([A-Z0-9]{2,3})-([A-Z0-9])([A-Z0-9])-([A-Z0-9]{2,4})-"
                         r"([A-Z0-9]{2})([A-Z0-9]{1,3})-([A-Z0-9]{3})([A-Z0-9])-([A-Z])", (self.brex_dmc or "").strip().upper())
        if not m:
            raise ValueError(f"brex_dmc '{self.brex_dmc}' is not a data module code like S1000D-G-04-10-0301-00A-022A-D")
        keys = ["modelIdentCode", "systemDiffCode", "systemCode", "subSystemCode", "subSubSystemCode", "assyCode",
                "disassyCode", "disassyCodeVariant", "infoCode", "infoCodeVariant", "itemLocationCode"]
        return dict(zip(keys, m.groups()))

    def dmc_string(self, info_code: str, variant: str = "A") -> str:
        d = self.dmc(info_code, variant)
        return (f"DMC-{d['modelIdentCode']}-{d['systemDiffCode']}-{d['systemCode']}-{d['subSystemCode']}"
                f"{d['subSubSystemCode']}-{d['assyCode']}-{d['disassyCode']}{d['disassyCodeVariant']}-"
                f"{d['infoCode']}{d['infoCodeVariant']}-{d['itemLocationCode']}")

    def file_name(self, info_code: str) -> str:
        return (f"{self.dmc_string(info_code)}_{self.issue_number}-{self.in_work}_"
                f"{self.language.upper()}-{self.country.upper()}.XML")

    @classmethod
    def from_dict(cls, d: dict | None) -> "PublicationConfig":
        d = d or {}
        known = {k: v for k, v in d.items() if k in cls.__dataclass_fields__ and v not in (None, "")}
        return cls(**known)

    def as_dict(self) -> dict:
        return asdict(self)

FILE: backend\studio\publish\s1000d.py

"""S1000D Issue 4.2 renderers: procedural data modules (530 disassemble, 710 assemble) and IPD (941).

Element order and content follow the S1000D 4.2 ``proced.xsd`` / ``ipd.xsd`` content models
(the same structure as ASTHRA's RA-7100 reference data modules). Empty requirement groups
use the schema's ``noSupportEquips`` / ``noSupplies`` / ``noSpares`` / ``noSafety`` elements.
Item numbers are written as three-digit IPD items (``220`` -> ``220``, ``10`` -> ``010``).
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import re
from datetime import date
from xml.sax.saxutils import escape, quoteattr

from .config import PublicationConfig

INFO = {"disassembly": ("530", "Disassemble procedure"), "assembly": ("710", "Assemble procedure"),
        "ipd": ("941", "Illustrated parts data")}


def _a(**kw) -> str:
    return "".join(f" {k}={quoteattr(str(v))}" for k, v in kw.items() if v is not None and v != "")


def _dmcode(cfg: PublicationConfig, info: str) -> str:
    return f"<dmCode{_a(**cfg.dmc(info))}/>"


def _id(prefix: str, s: str) -> str:
    return f"{prefix}-" + re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "-", s.lower()).strip("-")


def _ident_status(cfg: PublicationConfig, info: str, info_name: str, tech_name: str) -> str:
    y, m, d = (cfg.issue_date or date.today().isoformat()).split("-")
    ent = f"<enterpriseName>{escape(cfg.enterprise_name or cfg.enterprise_code)}</enterpriseName>"
    applic = escape(cfg.applicability or tech_name)
    code = " ".join(f'{k}="{escape(v)}"' for k, v in cfg.brex_dmcode().items())
    brex = f"<brexDmRef><dmRef><dmRefIdent><dmCode {code}/></dmRefIdent></dmRef></brexDmRef>"
    return (
        "<identAndStatusSection><dmAddress><dmIdent>"
        f"{_dmcode(cfg, info)}<language{_a(languageIsoCode=cfg.language, countryIsoCode=cfg.country)}/>"
        f"<issueInfo{_a(issueNumber=cfg.issue_number, inWork=cfg.in_work)}/></dmIdent>"
        f"<dmAddressItems><issueDate{_a(year=y, month=m, day=d)}/>"
        f"<dmTitle><techName>{escape(tech_name)}</techName><infoName>{escape(info_name)}</infoName></dmTitle>"
        "</dmAddressItems></dmAddress>"
        f'<dmStatus issueType="new"><security{_a(securityClassification=cfg.security_classification)}/>'
        f"<responsiblePartnerCompany{_a(enterpriseCode=cfg.enterprise_code)}>{ent}</responsiblePartnerCompany>"
        f"<originator{_a(enterpriseCode=cfg.enterprise_code)}>{ent}</originator>"
        f"<applic><displayText><simplePara>{applic}</simplePara></displayText></applic>"
        f"{brex}<qualityAssurance><unverified/></qualityAssurance></dmStatus></identAndStatusSection>"
    )


def _wc_para(text: str) -> str:
    return f"<warningAndCautionPara>{escape(text)}</warningAndCautionPara>"


def render_procedure(proc: dict, cfg: PublicationConfig, tech_name: str) -> tuple[str, str]:
    """Return (file name, XML) for an S1000D 4.2 procedural data module."""
    info, info_name = INFO[proc["kind"]]
    safety = proc.get("safety", {})
    used = set(proc["preliminary"].get("warnings", []))
    for st in proc["subtasks"]:
        used |= set(st.get("warnings", [])) | set(st.get("cautions", []))
    wc_ids = {sid: f"{'wrn' if safety[sid]['kind'] == 'warning' else 'cau'}-{i + 1:04d}"
              for i, sid in enumerate(sorted(used)) if sid in safety}
    wac = ""
    if wc_ids:
        wac = "<warningsAndCautions>" + "".join(
            f"<{safety[s]['kind']} id={quoteattr(wc_ids[s])}>{_wc_para(safety[s]['text'])}</{safety[s]['kind']}>"
            for s in sorted(wc_ids)) + "</warningsAndCautions>"
    pre = proc["preliminary"]
    persons = "".join(f'<personnel numRequired="{p["count"]}"><personCategory personCategoryCode={quoteattr(p["category"])}/></personnel>'
                      for p in pre.get("persons", []))
    se = pre.get("support_equipment", [])
    support = ("<reqSupportEquips><supportEquipDescrGroup>" + "".join(
        f"<supportEquipDescr id={quoteattr(s['id'])}><name>{escape(s['name'])}</name>"
        f'<reqQuantity unitOfMeasure="EA">{s.get("qty", 1)}</reqQuantity></supportEquipDescr>' for s in se)
        + "</supportEquipDescrGroup></reqSupportEquips>") if se else "<reqSupportEquips><noSupportEquips/></reqSupportEquips>"
    su = pre.get("supplies", [])
    supplies = ("<reqSupplies><supplyDescrGroup>" + "".join(
        f"<supplyDescr id={quoteattr(s['id'])}><name>{escape(s['name'])}</name>"
        f"<identNumber><manufacturerCode>{escape(cfg.enterprise_code or 'ZZZZZ')}</manufacturerCode>"
        f"<partAndSerialNumber><partNumber>{escape(s['spec'])}</partNumber></partAndSerialNumber></identNumber>"
        f"</supplyDescr>" for s in su)
        + "</supplyDescrGroup></reqSupplies>") if su else "<reqSupplies><noSupplies/></reqSupplies>"
    sp = pre.get("spares", [])
    spares = ("<reqSpares><spareDescrGroup>" + "".join(
        f"<spareDescr id={quoteattr(s['id'])}><name>{escape(s['name'])}</name>"
        f"<identNumber><manufacturerCode>{escape(s.get('cage') or cfg.enterprise_code or 'ZZZZZ')}</manufacturerCode>"
        f"<partAndSerialNumber><partNumber>{escape(s['part_number'])}</partNumber></partAndSerialNumber></identNumber>"
        f'<reqQuantity unitOfMeasure="EA">{s["qty"]}</reqQuantity></spareDescr>' for s in sp)
        + "</spareDescrGroup></reqSpares>") if sp else "<reqSpares><noSpares/></reqSpares>"
    pw = [w for w in pre.get("warnings", []) if w in safety]
    safety_x = ("<reqSafety><safetyRqmts>"
                + "".join(f"<{safety[w]['kind']}>{_wc_para(safety[w]['text'])}</{safety[w]['kind']}>" for w in pw)
                + "</safetyRqmts></reqSafety>") if pw else "<reqSafety><noSafety/></reqSafety>"
    prelim = (f"<preliminaryRqmts><reqCondGroup><noConds/></reqCondGroup><reqPersons>{persons}</reqPersons>"
              f"{support}{supplies}{spares}{safety_x}</preliminaryRqmts>")

    steps_x = []
    for k, st in enumerate(proc["subtasks"], start=1):
        refs = {}
        w = " ".join(wc_ids[x] for x in st.get("warnings", []) if x in wc_ids)
        c = " ".join(wc_ids[x] for x in st.get("cautions", []) if x in wc_ids)
        if w:
            refs["warningRefs"] = w
        if c:
            refs["cautionRefs"] = c
        inner = []
        for s in st["steps"]:
            if s["kind"] == "note":
                inner.append(f"<proceduralStep id={quoteattr(_id('stp', s['id']))}><para>{escape(s['text'])}</para></proceduralStep>")
            else:
                inner.append(f"<proceduralStep id={quoteattr(_id('stp', s['id']))}><para>{escape(s['text'])}</para></proceduralStep>")
        steps_x.append(f"<proceduralStep{_a(id=_id('stp', st['id']), **refs)}><title>{escape(st['title'])}</title>"
                       + "".join(inner) + "</proceduralStep>")
    common = ""
    paras = [f"This procedure gives the instructions to {'disassemble' if proc['kind'] == 'disassembly' else 'assemble'} "
             f"the {tech_name.lower()}."] + list(proc.get("common_info", []))
    common = "<commonInfo><title>Job description</title>" + "".join(f"<para>{escape(p)}</para>" for p in paras) + "</commonInfo>"
    xml = ('<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>\n'
           '<dmodule xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink" '
           'xsi:noNamespaceSchemaLocation="http://www.s1000d.org/S1000D_4-2/xml_schema_flat/proced.xsd">'
           + _ident_status(cfg, info, info_name, tech_name)
           + "<content>" + wac + "<procedure>" + common + prelim
           + "<mainProcedure>" + "".join(steps_x) + "</mainProcedure>"
           + "<closeRqmts><reqCondGroup><noConds/></reqCondGroup></closeRqmts></procedure></content></dmodule>\n")
    return cfg.file_name(info), xml


def _ipd_item(item: str) -> tuple[str, str | None]:
    m = re.match(r"^(-?\d+)([A-Z]?)$", item or "")
    if not m:
        return "000", None
    n = max(int(m.group(1)), 0)
    return f"{n:03d}" if n < 1000 else str(n), (m.group(2) or None)


def render_ipd(ipl: dict, cfg: PublicationConfig, tech_name: str, graphic_icn: str | None = None) -> tuple[str, str]:
    info, info_name = INFO["ipd"]
    sns = cfg.sns()
    fig = f"{int(cfg.figure_number):02d}" if str(cfg.figure_number).isdigit() else cfg.figure_number
    icn = graphic_icn or f"ICN-{cfg.model_ident_code}-{cfg.system_diff_code}-{cfg.system_code}{cfg.sub_system_code}" \
                         f"{cfg.sub_sub_system_code}{cfg.assy_code}-{cfg.item_location_code}-{cfg.enterprise_code or 'ZZZZZ'}-00001-A-001-01"
    out = [f"<figure id={quoteattr('fig-' + fig)}><title>{escape(tech_name)}</title><graphic{_a(infoEntityIdent=icn)}/></figure>"]
    for r in ipl["rows"]:
        if r.get("status") == "rejected" or not r.get("item"):
            continue
        item, variant = _ipd_item(r["item"])
        if r["depth"] == 0:
            item = "001"
        attrs = {**sns, "figureNumber": fig, "item": item, "itemVariant": variant,
                 "indenture": str(max(r["indent"], 1)), "id": f"csn-{fig}-{item}{(variant or '').lower()}"}
        qty = r.get("units_per_assy")
        qty_x = f"<quantityPerNextHigherAssy>{qty if qty is not None else 'AR'}</quantityPerNextHigherAssy>"
        descr = r["nomenclature"].capitalize() if r["nomenclature"].isupper() else r["nomenclature"]
        loc_inner = ("<notIllustrated/>" if not r.get("occ_ids") else "") + \
                    ("<attachStoreShipPart attachStoreShipPartCode=\"1\"/>" if r.get("attaching_for") else "")
        loc = f"<partLocationSegment>{loc_inner}</partLocationSegment>" if loc_inner else ""
        applic = (f"<applicabilitySegment><usableOnCodeAssy>{escape(r['effectivity'])}</usableOnCodeAssy></applicabilitySegment>"
                  if r.get("effectivity") else "")
        out.append(f"<catalogSeqNumber{_a(**attrs)}><itemSeqNumber itemSeqNumberValue=\"00A\">{qty_x}"
                   f"<partRef{_a(manufacturerCodeValue=r.get('cage') or cfg.enterprise_code, partNumberValue=r['part_number'])}/>"
                   f"<partSegment><itemIdentData><descrForPart>{escape(descr)}</descrForPart></itemIdentData></partSegment>"
                   f"{loc}{applic}</itemSeqNumber></catalogSeqNumber>")
    xml = ('<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>\n'
           '<dmodule xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink" '
           'xsi:noNamespaceSchemaLocation="http://www.s1000d.org/S1000D_4-2/xml_schema_flat/ipd.xsd">'
           + _ident_status(cfg, info, info_name, tech_name)
           + "<content><illustratedPartsCatalog>" + "".join(out) + "</illustratedPartsCatalog></content></dmodule>\n")
    return cfg.file_name(info), xml

FILE: backend\studio\publish\techpub.py

"""Exports for the TechPub web tool.

* ``ipl_excel``      — the IPL as the Excel TechPub's "Generate from Excel" route reads
  (``techback/excel_utils.py`` header names: Item No, Indent, Part Number, Keyword,
  Description, Eff Code, Units Per Assy, Attach, Torque Value, Remarks…). An IPL validated
  here can be loaded into TechPub unchanged.
* ``editor_json``    — a procedure in the TechPub procedure editor format
  (``{"task": {"title", "para": [{"intent", "para"}], "subtasks": {}}}``) with the step ids
  kept in ``meta`` so edits made in TechPub can be traced back to operations.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import io


def ipl_excel(ipl: dict) -> bytes:
    from openpyxl import Workbook
    from openpyxl.styles import Font, PatternFill
    wb = Workbook()
    ws = wb.active
    ws.title = "IPL"
    headers = ["Figure Number", "Item No", "Item Variant", "Indent", "Part Number", "Keyword", "Description",
               "Eff Code", "Units Per Assy", "Manufacturer Code", "Attach", "Illus Ind", "Installed-On",
               "Torque Value", "Remarks", "3D Items", "Confidence", "Flags"]
    ws.append(headers)
    for c in ws[1]:
        c.font = Font(bold=True)
        c.fill = PatternFill("solid", fgColor="DDE7F3")
    rows = {r["id"]: r for r in ipl["rows"]}
    for r in ipl["rows"]:
        if r.get("status") == "rejected":
            continue
        nom = r["nomenclature"]
        kwd, adt = (nom.split(",", 1) + [""])[:2] if "," in nom else (nom, "")
        item = r.get("item") or ""
        variant = item[-1] if item[-1:].isalpha() else ""
        tq = r.get("torque")
        installed = rows.get(r.get("attaching_for") or r.get("parent_row") or "", {}).get("item", "")
        ws.append([r.get("fig", "1"), item.rstrip(variant) if variant else item, variant, r["indent"] - 1,
                   r["part_number"], kwd.strip(), adt.strip() or nom, r.get("effectivity") or "",
                   "RF" if r["depth"] == 0 else r.get("units_per_assy"), r.get("cage") or "",
                   "1" if r.get("attaching_for") else "", "1" if r.get("occ_ids") else "0", installed,
                   f"{tq['nominal_nm']:g} N.m" + (f" ±{tq['tolerance_nm']:g}" if tq.get("tolerance_nm") else "") if tq else "",
                   "; ".join(r.get("notes", [])), len(r.get("occ_ids", [])), r.get("confidence"),
                   " | ".join(r.get("flags", []))])
    for col, w in zip("ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQR", (8, 8, 6, 7, 18, 18, 30, 8, 9, 10, 7, 8, 10, 16, 30, 8, 10, 60)):
        ws.column_dimensions[col].width = w
    ws.freeze_panes = "A2"
    buf = io.BytesIO()
    wb.save(buf)
    return buf.getvalue()


def editor_json(proc: dict) -> dict:
    paras = []
    for st in proc["subtasks"]:
        paras.append({"intent": 0, "para": st["title"], "meta": {"subtask": st["id"]}})
        for s in st["steps"]:
            paras.append({"intent": 1, "para": s["text"], "meta": {"step": s["id"], "ops": s["op_ids"]}})
    return {"task": {"title": proc["title"], "para": paras, "subtasks": {}}}

================================================================================
FILE: backend\studio\reconcile\column_mapping.py
