"""End to end through the HTTP API on a real product: STEP + APL + drawing -> IPL -> procedures -> S1000D / ATA
-> checked against the installed schemas, BREX and rule sets -> published; then a revision (one screw part number
changed) compared with the signed-off baseline.

Needs the sample files; set STUDIO_SAMPLES to a folder with
  F6137-D24907000.stp, F6137-D24907000_APL.pdf, F6137-D24907000_Drawing_1.pdf and revB/ (modified STEP + APL CSV).
Skipped when they are not there. Takes about a minute (two full pipeline runs).
"""
import os
import time
from pathlib import Path

import pytest

SAMPLES = Path(os.environ.get("STUDIO_SAMPLES", Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3] / "samples"))
EXAMPLES = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / "examples"
pytestmark = pytest.mark.skipif(not (SAMPLES / "F6137-D24907000.stp").exists(), reason="sample product not available")


@pytest.fixture(scope="module")
def client(tmp_path_factory):
    os.environ["STUDIO_DATA"] = str(tmp_path_factory.mktemp("studio"))
    os.environ["STUDIO_CONFIG"] = str(tmp_path_factory.mktemp("cfg") / "none.yaml")
    from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
    from studio.api import create_app
    from studio.core.config import StudioConfig
    with TestClient(create_app(StudioConfig.load())) as c:
        installed = c.post("/api/conformance/packages/evaluation").json()
        assert all(x["installed"] for x in installed) and len(installed) == 2
        yield c


def wait(client, rid, timeout=300):
    t0 = time.time()
    while time.time() - t0 < timeout:
        r = client.get(f"/api/runs/{rid}").json()
        if r["status"] in ("done", "failed") and not r.get("busy"):
            return r
        time.sleep(1)
    raise TimeoutError(rid)


def files(*names):
    out = {}
    for kind, name in names:
        p = SAMPLES / name
        out[kind] = (p.name, p.read_bytes())
    return out


@pytest.fixture(scope="module")
def baseline(client):
    pid = client.post("/api/projects", json={"name": "BSELV test"}).json()["id"]
    r = client.post(f"/api/projects/{pid}/runs", data={"label": "Rev A"},
                    files=files(("step", "F6137-D24907000.stp"), ("mbom", "F6137-D24907000_APL.pdf"),
                                ("drawing", "F6137-D24907000_Drawing_1.pdf")))
    assert r.status_code == 201, r.text
    run = wait(client, r.json()["id"])
    assert run["status"] == "done", run.get("error")
    return pid, run


def test_baseline_outputs(client, baseline):
    pid, run = baseline
    st = {k: v["summary"] for k, v in run["stages"].items() if v.get("summary")}
    assert st["convert"]["occurrences"] >= 80
    assert st["analyse"]["conflicts"] == 0
    assert st["drawing"]["assigned"] == st["drawing"]["torques"] >= 8
    assert st["ipl"]["rows"] >= 45 and st["ipl"]["with_3d"] >= 30
    for kind in ("disassembly", "assembly"):
        assert st["procedures"][kind]["errors"] == 0
        assert st["procedures"][kind]["steps"] >= 25

    seq = client.get(f"/api/runs/{run['id']}/artifacts/sequence").json()
    pos = {s["unit"]: i for i, s in enumerate(seq["disassembly"])}
    assert not [p for p in seq["precedence"] if p["first"] in pos and pos[p["first"]] > pos[p["then"]]]

    ipl = client.get(f"/api/runs/{run['id']}/artifacts/ipl").json()
    items = [r["item"] for r in ipl["rows"]]
    assert len(items) == len(set(items)), "IPL item numbers are unique"
    assert all(r["sources"] for r in ipl["rows"])


def test_documents_checked_against_installed_schemas(client, baseline):
    _, run = baseline
    assert run["stages"]["check"]["status"] == "done"
    chk = client.get(f"/api/runs/{run['id']}/check").json()
    assert {d["key"] for d in chk["documents"]} == {"S1000D-530", "S1000D-710", "S1000D-941", "ATA-CMM"}
    for d in chk["documents"]:
        r = d["report"]
        assert r["statuses"]["structural"] == "passed", (d["name"], r["diagnostics"][:3])
        assert r["identification"]["package_id"], d["name"]
        assert r["passed"]
    s1000d = [d for d in chk["documents"] if d["key"].startswith("S1000D")]
    # the S1000D default BREX is not installed: said so, never reported as passed
    assert all(any(x["rule_id"] == "VAL-BREX-MISSING" for x in d["report"]["diagnostics"]) for d in s1000d)
    name = s1000d[0]["name"]
    view = client.get(f"/api/runs/{run['id']}/documents/{name}/view").json()
    assert view["stylesheet"]["id"] == "builtin-s1000d-view" and "Brake selector valve" in view["html"]
    xml = client.get(f"/api/runs/{run['id']}/documents/{name}").text
    assert xml.count("\n") > 50, "documents are indented, so problems point at useful lines"


def test_brex_and_rule_sets_gate_publishing(client, baseline):
    pid, run = baseline
    rid = run["id"]
    brex = EXAMPLES / "brex" / "DMC-SLSBSELV-A-00-00-00-00A-022A-D_001-00_EN-US.XML"
    assert client.post("/api/conformance/brex", files={"file": (brex.name, brex.read_bytes())}).status_code == 200
    rules = EXAMPLES / "rules" / "house-rules-s1000d.yaml"
    assert client.post("/api/conformance/rules", files={"file": (rules.name, rules.read_bytes())}).status_code == 200
    sch = EXAMPLES / "rules" / "cmm-checks.sch"
    # a low step limit so the report fires on this small product (subtasks are part by part)
    sch_bytes = sch.read_bytes().replace(b"count(prclist1/prcitem1) &gt; 15", b"count(prclist1/prcitem1) &gt; 2")
    assert client.post("/api/conformance/rules", files={"file": (sch.name, sch_bytes)},
                       data={"applies_to": '{"roots": ["cmm"]}'}).status_code == 200
    client.patch(f"/api/projects/{pid}/settings", json={"publication": {"brex_dmc": "SLSBSELV-A-00-00-00-00A-022A-D",
                                                                        "model_ident_code": "SLSBSELV"}})
    chk = client.post(f"/api/runs/{rid}/check").json()
    by = {d["key"]: d["report"] for d in chk["documents"]}
    rules_hit = {x["rule_id"] for x in by["S1000D-530"]["diagnostics"]}
    assert "SLS-005" in rules_hit                         # project BREX: inWork must be 00
    assert by["S1000D-530"]["statuses"]["business_rules"] == "failed"
    assert any(x["rule_id"] == "CMM-011" for x in by["ATA-CMM"]["diagnostics"])   # Schematron report (warning)
    assert by["ATA-CMM"]["passed"]
    # errors hold publishing back, unless the writer publishes anyway (recorded)
    r = client.post(f"/api/runs/{rid}/publish", json={"connector": "folder", "targets": ["s1000d"]})
    assert r.status_code == 409
    client.patch(f"/api/projects/{pid}/settings", json={"publication": {"in_work": "00"}})
    chk = client.post(f"/api/runs/{rid}/check").json()
    assert "SLS-005" not in {x["rule_id"] for d in chk["documents"] for x in d["report"]["diagnostics"]}
    # a transform stylesheet is applied before the check
    xsl = EXAMPLES / "stylesheets" / "set-originator.xsl"
    st = client.post("/api/conformance/stylesheets", files={"file": (xsl.name, xsl.read_bytes())},
                     data={"kind": "transform", "applies_to": '{"standards": ["S1000D"]}'}).json()
    chk = client.post(f"/api/runs/{rid}/check").json()
    doc = next(d for d in chk["documents"] if d["key"] == "S1000D-710")
    assert doc["transforms"][0]["id"] == st["id"]
    assert "firstVerification" in client.get(f"/api/runs/{rid}/documents/{doc['name']}").text
    client.delete(f"/api/conformance/stylesheets/{st['id']}")


def test_writer_edits_and_checks(client, baseline):
    _, run = baseline
    rid = run["id"]
    proc = client.get(f"/api/runs/{rid}/artifacts/procedure_disassembly").json()
    step = proc["subtasks"][1]["steps"][0]
    r = client.patch(f"/api/runs/{rid}/procedures/disassembly/steps/{step['id']}",
                     json={"text": "Carefully removing the screws (999)."}).json()
    assert {"STE-9.1", "FACT-ITM"} <= {i["rule"] for i in r["issues"]}
    r = client.patch(f"/api/runs/{rid}/procedures/disassembly/steps/{step['id']}", json={"text": step["text"]}).json()
    assert r["issues"] == []
    assert client.post(f"/api/runs/{rid}/ipl/accept", json={"rows": []}).json()["accepted"] > 20


def _retry(fn, tries=60):
    import time
    for _ in range(tries):
        r = fn()
        if r.status_code != 409:
            return r
        time.sleep(0.5)
    return r


def test_document_edit(client, baseline):
    _, run = baseline
    rid = run["id"]
    chk = client.get(f"/api/runs/{rid}/check").json()
    name = next(d["name"] for d in chk["documents"] if d["key"] == "S1000D-530")
    url = f"/api/runs/{rid}/documents/{name}"
    xml = client.get(url).text
    # live validation of unsaved text, nothing written
    bad = xml.replace("<content>", "<content><notAnElement/>", 1)
    rep = client.post(f"{url}/validate", json={"text": bad}).json()
    assert rep["counts"]["error"] + rep["counts"]["fatal"] > 0
    assert client.get(url).text == xml
    assert client.post(f"{url}/view", json={"text": xml}).json()["html"]
    # not well-formed: refused
    assert _retry(lambda: client.put(url, json={"text": xml[:-20]})).status_code == 400
    # saved edit replaces the generated document when checking and publishing
    edited = xml.replace("<techName>", "<techName>Edited ", 1)
    r = _retry(lambda: client.put(url, json={"text": edited}))
    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
    doc = next(d for d in r.json()["documents"] if d["name"] == name)
    assert doc["edited"] and not doc["edited"]["stale"]
    assert "Edited " in client.get(url).text
    # discard: back to the generated document
    r = _retry(lambda: client.delete(f"{url}/edit"))
    doc = next(d for d in r.json()["documents"] if d["name"] == name)
    assert doc["edited"] is None and "Edited " not in client.get(url).text


def test_publish_to_folder(client, baseline):
    _, run = baseline
    r = client.post(f"/api/runs/{run['id']}/publish", json={"connector": "folder", "targets": ["s1000d", "ata", "techpub"],
                                                              "allow_errors": True})
    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
    res = r.json()
    written = [Path(d["path"]) for d in res["documents"]]
    assert len(written) == 7 and all(p.exists() for p in written)
    assert any(p.suffix == ".xlsx" for p in written)
    xml = [d for d in res["documents"] if d["file"].upper().endswith(".XML")]
    assert len(xml) == 4 and all("statuses" in d for d in xml)       # the check travels with the file
    published = next(p for p in written if "530" in p.name).read_bytes()
    checked = client.get(f"/api/runs/{run['id']}/documents/{next(p for p in written if '530' in p.name).name}").content
    assert published == checked


def test_revision_against_baseline(client, baseline):
    pid, run = baseline
    assert client.post(f"/api/runs/{run['id']}/signoff", json={"by": "test"}).status_code == 200
    # a signed-off baseline is read-only
    assert client.post(f"/api/runs/{run['id']}/ipl/accept", json={}).status_code == 400
    if not (SAMPLES / "revB" / "F6137-D24907000_revB.stp").exists():
        pytest.skip("revision sample not available")
    r = client.post(f"/api/projects/{pid}/runs", data={"label": "Rev B"},
                    files=files(("step", "revB/F6137-D24907000_revB.stp"), ("mbom", "revB/F6137-D24907000_APL_revB.csv")))
    new = wait(client, r.json()["id"])
    assert new["status"] == "done", new.get("error")
    assert new["base_run"] == run["id"]
    assert "drawing" in new["inputs"], "inputs not uploaded again are kept from the previous run"
    cs = client.get(f"/api/runs/{new['id']}/artifacts/changeset").json()
    assert cs["summary"]["changes"] == 1
    c = cs["changes"][0]
    assert (c["type"], c["part_number_base"], c["part_number_new"], c["count"]) == \
        ("part_number_changed", "F6137-C77004-10", "F6137-C77004-12", 6)
    assert cs["summary"]["affected_steps"] >= 3
    assert cs["carry_forward"]["assembly"]["kept"] > 25
    mod = client.get(f"/api/runs/{new['id']}/artifacts/procedure_modification").json()
    assert mod["kind"] == "modification" and mod["subtasks"]


def test_variant_and_service_bulletin(client, baseline):
    """A variant that differs only in its parts list, and an SB modification on the shipped product."""
    pid, run = baseline
    if not (SAMPLES / "revB" / "F6137-D24907000_APL_revB.csv").exists():
        pytest.skip("revision sample not available")
    # variant: created from the baseline, only the parts list uploaded
    v = client.post("/api/projects", json={"name": "BSELV variant B", "parent": pid}).json()
    assert v["kind"] == "variant" and v["parent"]["run"] == run["id"]
    assert v["settings"]["publication"]["disassy_code_variant"] == "B"
    r = client.post(f"/api/projects/{v['id']}/runs", files=files(("mbom", "revB/F6137-D24907000_APL_revB.csv")))
    assert r.status_code == 201, r.text
    vr = wait(client, r.json()["id"])
    assert vr["status"] == "done", vr.get("error")
    assert vr["change"]["kind"] == "variant" and vr["base_run"] == run["id"]
    assert set(vr["inputs"]) == {"step", "mbom", "drawing"}            # 3D and drawing come from the parent
    cs = client.get(f"/api/runs/{vr['id']}/artifacts/changeset").json()
    assert cs["context"]["kind"] == "variant" and cs["summary"]["changes"] == 1
    assert cs["changes"][0]["type"] == "part_number_changed" and cs["changes"][0]["source"] == "IPL"
    nums = client.get(f"/api/runs/{vr['id']}/artifacts/ipl").json()["item_numbers"]
    assert nums["new"][0]["replaces_item"] in nums["retired"] and not set(n["item"] for n in nums["new"]) & set(nums["retired"])
    chk = client.get(f"/api/runs/{vr['id']}/check").json()
    assert any("-00B-" in d["name"] for d in chk["documents"])         # the variant's own data module codes

    # SB on the shipped product: needs its reference, raises the issue number, attaches the bulletin
    assert client.post(f"/api/projects/{pid}/runs", data={"change_kind": "modification"}).status_code == 400
    r = client.post(f"/api/projects/{pid}/runs",
                    data={"change_kind": "modification", "reference": "SB 32-0042", "change_title": "Replace the plug screws"},
                    files={**files(("step", "revB/F6137-D24907000_revB.stp"), ("mbom", "revB/F6137-D24907000_APL_revB.csv")),
                           "reference_doc": ("SB_32-0042.pdf", b"%PDF-1.4 bulletin")})
    assert r.status_code == 201, r.text
    sb = r.json()
    assert sb["label"] == "SB 32-0042" and sb["publication"]["issue_number"] == "002" and "reference" in sb["inputs"]
    sb = wait(client, sb["id"])
    assert sb["status"] == "done", sb.get("error")
    mod = client.get(f"/api/runs/{sb['id']}/artifacts/procedure_modification").json()
    assert mod["title"].startswith("SB 32-0042:") and mod["subtasks"]
    names = [d["name"] for d in client.get(f"/api/runs/{sb['id']}/check").json()["documents"]]
    assert any("_002-00_" in n for n in names)
    assert client.get(f"/api/runs/{sb['id']}/parts-import").json()["source"] in ("proposed", "confirmed")

"""Unit tests for the rule-based pieces: drawing torque parsing, notes, roles, STE text, fact check, model diff."""
import pytest

from studio.drawing.extract import _parse_torque
from studio.drawing.notes import classify_note
from studio.engineering.roles import RoleClassifier
from studio.process.graph import torque_range, wrench_for
from studio.procedures.ste import STEChecker, fact_check
from studio.procedures.text import plural, torque_text
from studio.revisions.diff import diff_models


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- drawing
@pytest.mark.parametrize("text, nom, tol", [
    ("C.S./T.T.: 53,1 4,5N.m", 53.1, 4.5),          # French decimal comma, tolerance without the ± glyph
    ("C.S./T.T.: 24±3,7N.m", 24.0, 3.7),
    ("1,05N.m 0,05", 1.05, 0.05),
    ("TORQUE 10.5 ± 0.5 N.m", 10.5, 0.5),
])
def test_torque_parsing(text, nom, tol):
    got = _parse_torque(text)
    assert got is not None
    assert got[0] == pytest.approx(nom)
    assert got[1] == pytest.approx(tol)


@pytest.mark.parametrize("text", ["SEE SHEET 2", "SCALE 2:1", "0 N.m"])
def test_not_a_torque(text):
    assert _parse_torque(text) is None


def test_note_rules():
    n = classify_note("COMPOUND ACCORDING TO IFC30-141-07 ON ALL PARTS NOT IN CONTACT WITH THE OPERATING FLUID")
    assert n["op"] == "apply_compound" and n["phase"] == "general"
    n = classify_note("LOCKWIRE ACCORDING TO NCT60-300-04")
    assert n["op"] == "lockwire" and "fastener" in n["targets"]


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- roles
@pytest.mark.parametrize("pn, name, role", [
    ("M83461-1-014", "PACKING PREFORMED", "seal"),
    ("MS21914-6W", "CAP, PROTECTIVE", "cap"),
    ("NAS1149C0463R", "WASHER, FLAT", "washer"),
    ("C77004-12", "SCREW NAS1351N4-12", "fastener"),
    ("AS3510-0118C", "CABLE", "lockwire"),
])
def test_roles(pn, name, role):
    assert RoleClassifier().classify(pn, [name]).role == role


def test_role_fallbacks():
    c = RoleClassifier()
    assert c.classify("X1", ["THING"], is_assembly=True).role == "lru"
    assert c.classify("X2", ["THING"], geometry={"bbox": None}).role == "marker"


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- text and STE
def test_plural():
    assert plural("packing") == "packings"
    assert plural("bush") == "bushes"
    assert plural("assembly") == "assemblies"


def test_torque_text_and_wrench():
    t = torque_range({"nominal_nm": 10.5, "min_nm": 10, "max_nm": 11})
    assert torque_text(t).startswith("10 to 11 N.m (88.5 to 97.4 lbf.in)")
    assert "N.m" in wrench_for(11)


def test_ste_accepts_a_good_step():
    assert STEChecker().check("Remove the six screws (220) from the plugs (210).") == []


def test_ste_rules():
    rules = {i["rule"] for i in STEChecker().check(
        "Carefully removing the cap which is installed; you should keep it because it can be used again later by the shop.")}
    assert {"STE-9.1", "STE-ING", "STE-8.1", "STE-MOD", "STE-PAS"} <= rules
    long = "Remove " + " ".join(["the cap"] * 12) + "."
    assert any(i["rule"] == "STE-4.1" for i in STEChecker().check(long))


def test_fact_check_catches_invented_values():
    op = {"items": [{"item": "220", "qty": 6}], "torque": torque_range({"nominal_nm": 10.5, "min_nm": 10, "max_nm": 11})}
    ok = fact_check("Torque the six screws (220) to 10 to 11 N.m (88.5 to 97.4 lbf.in).", op, {"220"})
    assert ok == []
    bad = fact_check("Torque the four screws (221) to 12 N.m.", op, {"220"})
    assert {i["rule"] for i in bad} == {"FACT-NUM", "FACT-ITM"}


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- revisions
def _occ(oid, pn, c, size=(10, 10, 10), vol=100.0):
    return {"occ_id": oid, "part_number": pn, "name": pn, "is_assembly": False,
            "geometry": {"centroid": list(c), "bbox": [c[0], c[1], c[2], c[0] + size[0], c[1] + size[1], c[2] + size[2]],
                         "volume_mm3": vol}}


def test_diff_models():
    base = {"occurrences": [_occ("A_1", "A", (0, 0, 0)), _occ("A_2", "A", (50, 0, 0)), _occ("B_1", "B", (100, 0, 0)),
                            _occ("C_1", "C", (200, 0, 0)), _occ("D_1", "D", (300, 0, 0))]}
    new = {"occurrences": [_occ("A2_1", "A2", (0, 0, 0)), _occ("A2_2", "A2", (50, 0, 0)),     # A -> A2 at both places
                           _occ("B_1", "B", (105, 0, 0)),                                     # moved 5 mm
                           _occ("C_1", "C", (200, 0, 0), vol=130.0),                          # same PN, new geometry
                           _occ("E_1", "E", (400, 0, 0))]}                                    # D removed, E added
    ch = {c["type"]: c for c in diff_models(base, new)}
    assert ch["part_number_changed"]["count"] == 2 and ch["part_number_changed"]["geometry"] == "same"
    assert ch["moved"]["distance_mm"] == pytest.approx(5.0)
    assert ch["geometry_changed"]["part_number_new"] == "C"
    assert ch["removed"]["part_number_base"] == "D"
    assert ch["added"]["part_number_new"] == "E"


def test_diff_identical_models_is_empty():
    m = {"occurrences": [_occ("A_1", "A", (0, 0, 0))]}
    assert diff_models(m, m) == []


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- plug-in connectors
class _Echo:  # importable target for the class: entry below
    pass


def test_custom_connector_from_config(tmp_path):
    from studio.connectors.base import Bundle, BundleFile, Connector
    from studio.core.config import StudioConfig

    class Echo(Connector):
        def __init__(self, prefix=""):
            self.prefix = prefix

        def status(self):
            return {"name": self.name, "available": True}

        def publish(self, bundle):
            return {"connector": self.name, "documents": [{"file": self.prefix + f.name, "action": "sent"} for f in bundle.files]}

    import sys
    sys.modules[__name__].Echo = Echo
    cfg = StudioConfig(data_dir=tmp_path, connectors=[{"kind": "plm", "class": f"{__name__}:Echo", "prefix": "plm/"}])
    c = cfg.connector("plm")
    assert c.status() == {"name": "plm", "available": True}
    res = c.publish(Bundle(project={}, run={}, message="", files=[BundleFile("a.xml", b"<a/>")]))
    assert res["documents"][0]["file"] == "plm/a.xml"
    cfg.connectors.append({"kind": "bad", "class": f"{__name__}:_Echo"})
    with pytest.raises(TypeError):
        cfg.connector("bad")


def test_long_item_lists_are_grouped_and_split():
    from studio.procedures.text import item_sentences
    from studio.procedures.ste import STEChecker, technical_names_from
    names = ["packing", "back-up ring", "packing", "back-up ring", "packing", "back-up ring", "screw", "washer", "spring", "piston"]
    items = [{"row_id": f"r{i}", "item": str(100 + 10 * i), "nomenclature": n.upper(), "step_name": n, "count": 1}
             for i, n in enumerate(names)]
    out = item_sentences("Remove", items, " from the valve ball (950)")
    assert all(len(s.split()) <= 20 for s in out)
    assert sorted(x for s in out for x in __import__("re").findall(r"\b1\d0\b", s)) == sorted(i["item"] for i in items)
    new = item_sentences("Install", items[:6], " on the valve ball (950)", new=True)
    assert new == ["Install new packings (100, 120, 140) and new back-up rings (110, 130, 150) on the valve ball (950)."]
    tech = technical_names_from({"rows": [{"nomenclature": "RECOPY LEVER MACHINING"}]})
    assert STEChecker(technical_names=tech).check("Remove the recopy lever machining (600).", "step") == []


def test_regroup_puts_attaching_parts_next_to_their_part():
    from studio.sequence.hierarchy import regroup
    st = lambda n, u, role, layer: {"step": n, "layer": layer, "unit": u, "members": [u], "riders": [], "role": role,
                                    "direction": [0, 0, 1], "direction_label": "+Z", "forced": False}
    seq = {"base_unit": "body", "units": [{"id": x, "members": [x], "carrier": None} for x in
                                          ("body", "s1", "s2", "t1", "cover", "plate")],
           "disassembly": [st(1, "s1", "fastener", 1), st(2, "s2", "fastener", 1), st(3, "t1", "fastener", 1),
                           st(4, "cover", "closure", 2), st(5, "plate", "part", 2)],
           "precedence": [{"first": "s1", "then": "cover"}, {"first": "s2", "then": "cover"}, {"first": "t1", "then": "plate"}]}
    contacts = [{"a": "s1", "b": "cover"}, {"a": "s2", "b": "cover"}, {"a": "t1", "b": "plate"},
                {"a": "s1", "b": "body"}, {"a": "t1", "b": "body"}]
    regroup(seq, contacts)
    assert [s["unit"] for s in seq["disassembly"]] == ["s1", "s2", "cover", "t1", "plate"]
    assert seq["disassembly"][0]["attaches"] == "cover" and seq["disassembly"][2]["attached_by"] == ["s1", "s2"]

"""Parts-list import with ambiguity, stable item numbers, local-LLM answers (no server needed)."""
import json

import pandas as pd
import pytest

from studio.engineering import parts_import as pi
from studio.engineering.item_numbers import stabilize
from studio.llm.providers import LLMProvider, _json_from, refine_steps


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- parts list import
def _xlsx(tmp_path, rows, extra_sheets=None):
    f = tmp_path / "bom.xlsx"
    with pd.ExcelWriter(f) as w:
        pd.DataFrame(rows).to_excel(w, sheet_name="EBOM", header=False, index=False)
        for name, r in (extra_sheets or {}).items():
            pd.DataFrame(r).to_excel(w, sheet_name=name, header=False, index=False)
    return f


FRENCH = [["Export ERP 2026", None, None, None, None], [None] * 5,
          ["Repère", "Réf. pièce", "Libellé article", "Nb", "Fournisseur"],
          ["10", "C75970", "CORPS EQUIPE", "1", "F6137"], ["20", "MS21209F4-15", "INSERT FILETE", "3", "81343"],
          ["30", "NAS1351N4-12", "VIS CHC SPECIALE", "6", "80205"], ["40", "M83461-1-014", "JOINT TORIQUE", "2", "81349"]]


def test_unfamiliar_export_is_read_and_flagged_for_review(tmp_path):
    f = _xlsx(tmp_path, FRENCH, {"Matrix": [["Seat pos", "A1", "A2"], ["C75970", "1", "1"], ["X", "2", "2"]]})
    r = pi.inspect(f)
    m = {k: v["header"] for k, v in r["chosen"]["mapping"].items()}
    assert m["part_number"] == "Réf. pièce" and m["description"] == "Libellé article"
    assert m["qty"] == "Nb" and m["find_number"] == "Repère"          # 10, 20, 30 are item numbers, not quantities
    assert r["needs_review"] and any("guessed" in p for p in r["problems"])
    recs = pi.load(f, pi.mapping_from_proposal(r["chosen"]))
    assert recs[2] == {"part_number": "NAS1351N4-12", "description": "VIS CHC SPECIALE", "qty": "6",
                       "find_number": "30", "manuf_code": "80205"}


def test_known_headers_need_no_review(tmp_path):
    f = tmp_path / "bom.csv"
    f.write_text("Level,Part Number,Description,Qty.,CAGE\n0,D1,VALVE,1,F6137\n1,.C1,BODY,1,F6137\n1,.C2,SCREW,4,F6137\n")
    r = pi.inspect(f)
    assert not r["needs_review"] and r["chosen"]["mapping"]["part_number"]["how"] == "exact"
    assert len(pi.load(f, pi.mapping_from_proposal(r["chosen"]))) == 3


def test_writer_mapping_overrides_the_proposal(tmp_path):
    f = _xlsx(tmp_path, FRENCH)
    chosen = pi.inspect(f)["chosen"]
    recs = pi.load(f, {"table": chosen["id"], "columns": {"part_number": "Réf. pièce", "description": "Libellé article",
                                                          "qty": "Nb", "comments": "Fournisseur"}})
    assert recs[0]["comments"] == "F6137" and "manuf_code" not in recs[0]


def test_no_part_number_column_says_what_to_do(tmp_path):
    f = tmp_path / "x.csv"
    f.write_text("a,b\nhello world,there\n")
    r = pi.inspect(f)
    assert r["chosen"] is None and r["needs_review"] and r["problems"]


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- item numbers
def _row(i, pn, item, order, nom="PART", parent="r0", alt=None, depth=1, role="part"):
    return {"id": i, "part_number": pn, "item": item, "order": order, "nomenclature": nom, "parent_row": parent,
            "alternate_of": alt, "depth": depth, "role": role}


def test_item_numbers_continue_from_the_baseline():
    base = {"rows": [_row("r0", "TOP", "-1", 0, depth=0), _row("a", "P1", "10", 1), _row("b", "SCREW-10", "20", 2, "SCREW"),
                     _row("c", "P3", "30", 3), _row("c2", "P3ALT", "30A", 4, alt="c"), _row("d", "P4", "40", 5)]}
    # new issue: SCREW-10 replaced by SCREW-12 (same name), P5 added after P1, numbering from scratch shifted everything
    new = {"rows": [_row("r0", "TOP", "-1", 0, depth=0), _row("x1", "P1", "10", 1), _row("x5", "P5", "20", 2),
                    _row("x2", "SCREW-12", "30", 3, "SCREW"), _row("x3", "P3", "40", 4), _row("x3a", "P3ALT", "40A", 5, alt="x3"),
                    _row("x4", "P4", "50", 6)]}
    st = stabilize(new, base)
    items = {r["part_number"]: r["item"] for r in new["rows"]}
    assert items["P1"] == "10" and items["P3"] == "30" and items["P3ALT"] == "30A" and items["P4"] == "40"
    assert items["SCREW-12"] == "25"                 # next to the screw it replaces (20)
    assert items["P5"] not in ("10", "20", "25", "30") and 10 < int(items["P5"]) < 30
    assert st["retired"] == ["20"] and len(st["new"]) == 2
    assert len({r["item"] for r in new["rows"]}) == len(new["rows"])


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- local LLM answers
def test_thinking_and_code_fences_are_removed():
    text = '<think>Let me check {"not": "this"}</think>\n```json\n{"steps": [{"id": "s1", "text": "Remove the cap (10)."}]}\n```'
    assert _json_from(text)["steps"][0]["text"] == "Remove the cap (10)."


class _Fake(LLMProvider):
    name = "fake"

    def __init__(self):
        self.calls = 0

    def available(self):
        return True

    def complete(self, system, user, max_tokens=2000):
        self.calls += 1
        steps = json.loads(user.split("Steps:\n", 1)[1])
        if self.calls == 2:
            return "sorry, no JSON here", {}
        return json.dumps({"steps": [{"id": s["id"], "text": s["text"].upper()} for s in steps]}), {"input_tokens": 1}


def test_steps_go_in_batches_and_a_failed_batch_keeps_templates():
    p = _Fake()
    steps = [{"id": f"s{i}", "text": f"step {i}"} for i in range(20)]
    out, usage = refine_steps(p, steps, "ctx", batch_size=8)
    assert p.calls == 3 and usage["batches"] == 3 and usage["failed_batches"] == 1
    assert len(out) == 12 and "s8" not in out and out["s0"] == "STEP 0"

# Example rule file for S1000D procedures. Install it under Schemas and rules -> Rule sets.
# Each rule: id, context (XPath), and one of assert / forbid / allowed / pattern. See README "Rules".
id: house-rules-s1000d
name: House rules for S1000D procedures
applies_to:
  standards: [S1000D]
  doc_types: [proced]
rules:
  - id: HR-001
    severity: error
    context: //proceduralStep[para]
    assert: "string-length(normalize-space(para)) - string-length(translate(normalize-space(para), ' ', '')) + 1 <= 20"
    message: An instruction has at most 20 words (ASD-STE100 rule 5.1).
    suggestion: Split the step into two steps.
  - id: HR-002
    context: //para
    forbid: "contains(., ';')"
    message: Do not use semicolons in procedure text.
  - id: HR-004
    context: //security
    attribute: securityClassification
    allowed: ["01"]
    message: Procedures are published unclassified (security classification 01).
  - id: HR-005
    severity: warning
    context: //proceduralStep/proceduralStep
    assert: "not(proceduralStep/proceduralStep/proceduralStep)"
    message: Keep procedural steps to four levels.
  - id: HR-006
    context: //warningAndCautionPara
    pattern: '^[^a-z]+$'
    severity: warning
    message: Warnings and cautions are written in capital letters.

import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { api } from "./api";
import { StudioProvider, useStudio, ViewId } from "./state";
import { Viewer } from "./Viewer";
import { changeLabel, InputsView } from "./views/Inputs";
import { MatchView } from "./views/Match";
import { IplView } from "./views/Ipl";
import { SequenceView } from "./views/Sequence";
import { ProceduresView } from "./views/Procedures";
import { PublishView } from "./views/Publish";
import { ChangesView } from "./views/Changes";
import { CheckView } from "./views/Check";
import { SchemasView } from "./views/Schemas";
import { SettingsView } from "./views/Settings";

/* The rail reads like a shop routing sheet: each operation has a number, a name, and an inspection stamp
   that shows whether the writer has something to look at there. */
interface Op { id: ViewId; no: string; name: string; stages: string[] }
const OPS: Op[] = [
  { id: "inputs", no: "010", name: "Inputs and run", stages: ["convert"] },
  { id: "match", no: "020", name: "Match 3D to parts list", stages: ["reconcile"] },
  { id: "ipl", no: "030", name: "Illustrated parts list", stages: ["ipl", "drawing"] },
  { id: "sequence", no: "040", name: "Disassembly sequence", stages: ["analyse"] },
  { id: "procedures", no: "050", name: "Procedures", stages: ["process", "procedures"] },
  { id: "check", no: "060", name: "Check documents", stages: ["check"] },
  { id: "publish", no: "070", name: "Publish", stages: [] },
];
const CHANGES: Op = { id: "changes", no: "080", name: "Changes from baseline", stages: ["revision"] };

export default function App() {
  const [toasts, setToasts] = useState<{ id: number; msg: string; kind: string }[]>([]);
  const toast = useCallback((msg: string, kind: "ok" | "bad" = "ok") => {
    const id = Date.now() + Math.random();
    setToasts((t) => [...t, { id, msg, kind }]);
    setTimeout(() => setToasts((t) => t.filter((x) => x.id !== id)), kind === "bad" ? 7000 : 3200);
  }, []);
  return (
    <StudioProvider toast={toast}>
      <Shell />
      <div className="toasts" role="status" aria-live="polite">
        {toasts.map((t) => <div key={t.id} className={`toast ${t.kind}`}>{t.msg}</div>)}
      </div>
    </StudioProvider>
  );
}

function stamp(run: ReturnType<typeof useStudio>["run"], op: Op): { cls: string; text: string; title: string } {
  if (!run) return { cls: "", text: "", title: "No run yet" };
  const st = op.stages.map((s) => run.stages?.[s]).filter(Boolean);
  if (st.some((s) => s!.status === "failed")) return { cls: "bad", text: "!", title: "This step failed" };
  if (st.some((s) => s!.status === "running")) return { cls: "run", text: "", title: "Running" };
  if (op.stages.length && st.length < op.stages.length) return { cls: "wait", text: "", title: "Not run yet" };
  const sum = (k: string) => run.stages?.[k]?.summary || {};
  if (op.id === "ipl") { const f = sum("ipl").flagged; return f ? { cls: "warn", text: String(f), title: `${f} rows to check` } : { cls: "ok", text: "✓", title: "Nothing flagged" }; }
  if (op.id === "match") { const u = (sum("reconcile").unmatched_or_ambiguous_step ?? 0); return u ? { cls: "warn", text: String(u), title: `${u} 3D parts not matched` } : { cls: "ok", text: "✓", title: "All 3D parts matched" }; }
  if (op.id === "sequence") { const c = sum("analyse").conflicts; return c ? { cls: "warn", text: String(c), title: `${c} conflicts` } : { cls: "ok", text: "✓", title: "No conflicts" }; }
  if (op.id === "procedures") {
    const p = sum("procedures"); const e = (p.disassembly?.errors ?? 0) + (p.assembly?.errors ?? 0);
    return e ? { cls: "warn", text: String(e), title: `${e} STE errors` } : { cls: "ok", text: "✓", title: "No STE errors" };
  }
  if (op.id === "check") {
    const c = sum("check");
    return c.errors ? { cls: "warn", text: String(c.errors), title: `${c.errors} validation errors` } :
      c.not_validated ? { cls: "info", text: "?", title: "No schema installed for some documents" } : { cls: "ok", text: "✓", title: "All documents pass" };
  }
  if (op.id === "changes") { const c = sum("revision").changes; return { cls: c ? "info" : "ok", text: c ? String(c) : "✓", title: c ? `${c} changes` : "No changes" }; }
  if (op.id === "publish") return run.signed_off ? { cls: "ok", text: "✓", title: "Signed off" } : { cls: "", text: "", title: "" };
  return run.status === "done" ? { cls: "ok", text: "✓", title: "Done" } : { cls: "", text: "", title: "" };
}

function Shell() {
  const s = useStudio();
  const { run, project, view, setView, scene, pickHandler, setNodes } = s;
  const ops = run?.base_run ? [...OPS, CHANGES] : OPS;
  useEffect(() => { if (view === "changes" && run && !run.base_run) setView("ipl"); }, [view, run, setView]);
  const busy = !!run && (run.busy || run.status === "running" || run.status === "queued");
  const showViewer = !["inputs", "publish", "check", "schemas", "settings"].includes(view);
  const modelUrl = run?.stages?.convert?.status === "done" ? `${api.modelUrl(run.id)}?v=${run.inputs?.step?.sha256?.slice(0, 8)}` : null;

  return (
    <div className="app">
      <header className="top">
        <div className="brand"><span className="brand-mark" aria-hidden />Procedure Studio</div>
        <ProjectPicker />
        <div className="top-spacer" />
        {busy && <div className="top-progress" title={run?.progress?.message}>
          <span className="spinner" aria-hidden />{run?.progress?.message || "Working"}
        </div>}
        <SystemLights />
      </header>

      <nav className="rail" aria-label="Workflow">
        <ol>
          {ops.map((op) => {
            const st = stamp(run, op);
            return (
              <li key={op.id}>
                <button className={`op ${view === op.id ? "on" : ""}`} onClick={() => setView(op.id)} aria-current={view === op.id ? "step" : undefined}>
                  <span className="op-no">{op.no}</span>
                  <span className="op-name">{op.name}</span>
                  <span className={`stamp ${st.cls}`} title={st.title}>{st.text}</span>
                </button>
              </li>
            );
          })}
        </ol>
        <button className={`op lib ${view === "schemas" ? "on" : ""}`} onClick={() => setView("schemas")} aria-current={view === "schemas" ? "page" : undefined}>
          <span className="op-no" aria-hidden>§</span><span className="op-name">Schemas and rules</span><span />
        </button>
        <button className={`op lib2 ${view === "settings" ? "on" : ""}`} onClick={() => setView("settings")} aria-current={view === "settings" ? "page" : undefined}>
          <span className="op-no" aria-hidden>⚙</span><span className="op-name">Settings</span><span />
        </button>
        {run && <RunCard />}
      </nav>

      <main className={`work ${showViewer ? "with-viewer" : ""}`}>
        <section className="panel" aria-label={ops.find((o) => o.id === view)?.name}>
          {view === "schemas" ? <SchemasView /> : view === "settings" ? <SettingsView /> :
            !project ? <InputsView /> :
            view === "inputs" ? <InputsView /> :
            !run ? <Empty text="Start a run from Inputs and run to see this step." /> :
            view === "match" ? <MatchView /> :
            view === "ipl" ? <IplView /> :
            view === "sequence" ? <SequenceView /> :
            view === "procedures" ? <ProceduresView /> :
            view === "check" ? <CheckView /> :
            view === "publish" ? <PublishView /> :
            view === "changes" ? <ChangesView /> : null}
        </section>
        <section className="stage3d" aria-label="3D model" hidden={!showViewer}>
          <Viewer url={modelUrl} {...scene} onPick={(id, add) => pickHandler.current?.(id, add)} onNodes={setNodes} />
        </section>
      </main>
    </div>
  );
}

export function Empty({ text, children }: { text: string; children?: React.ReactNode }) {
  return <div className="empty"><p>{text}</p>{children}</div>;
}

function ProjectPicker() {
  const { projects, project, run, selectProject, selectRun } = useStudio();
  // products first, each followed by its variants
  const roots = projects.filter((p) => !p.parent || !projects.some((q) => q.id === p.parent!.project));
  const kids = (id: string) => projects.filter((p) => p.parent?.project === id);
  const ordered: { p: typeof projects[number]; depth: number }[] = [];
  const walk = (p: typeof projects[number], depth: number) => { ordered.push({ p, depth }); kids(p.id).forEach((k) => walk(k, depth + 1)); };
  roots.sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name)).forEach((p) => walk(p, 0));
  return (
    <div className="picker">
      <label>
        <span className="sr">Product</span>
        <select value={project?.id ?? ""} onChange={(e) => selectProject(e.target.value || null)}>
          {!project && <option value="">Choose a product</option>}
          {ordered.map(({ p, depth }) => <option key={p.id} value={p.id}>{"\u2003".repeat(depth)}{depth ? "↳ " : ""}{p.name}</option>)}
        </select>
      </label>
      {project && project.runs.length > 0 && (
        <label>
          <span className="sr">Run</span>
          <select value={run?.id ?? ""} onChange={(e) => selectRun(e.target.value)}>
            {(project.run_list ?? []).map((r) =>
              <option key={r.id} value={r.id}>{(r.label || r.id) + (project.baseline === r.id ? " · baseline" : "")}</option>)}
          </select>
        </label>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function SystemLights() {
  const { system } = useStudio();
  if (!system) return null;
  const conv = system.converter_status;
  const llm = system.llm;
  const conns: { name: string; available: boolean; error?: string; url?: string; path?: string }[] = system.connectors_status ?? [];
  const cf = system.conformance ?? {};
  return (
    <ul className="lights" aria-label="Connections">
      <li className={conv?.available ? "ok" : "bad"} title={conv?.detail || ""}>STEP converter</li>
      <li className={llm?.available ? "ok" : llm?.provider && llm.provider !== "none" ? "bad" : "off"} title={llm?.available ? `${llm.provider} ${llm.model ?? ""}` : "Steps are written from templates. Set an LLM provider to refine wording."}>
        {llm?.available ? `LLM: ${llm.provider}` : "LLM off"}</li>
      <li className={cf.packages ? "ok" : "bad"} title={`${cf.packages ?? 0} schema packages, ${cf.brex ?? 0} BREX, ${cf.rules ?? 0} rule sets`}>
        {cf.packages ? `Schemas: ${cf.packages}` : "No schemas"}</li>
      {conns.map((c) => <li key={c.name} className={c.available ? "ok" : "bad"} title={c.error || c.url || c.path || ""}>
        {c.name === "folder" ? "Folder" : c.name}</li>)}
    </ul>
  );
}

function RunCard() {
  const { run, project, selectProject, toast, refreshRun } = useStudio();
  if (!run || !project) return null;
  const base = run.base_run ? (project.run_list?.find((r) => r.id === run.base_run)?.label ??
    (project.parent?.run === run.base_run ? `${project.parent.name}, ${project.parent.label}` : run.base_run)) : null;
  const signoff = async () => {
    if (!confirm(`Sign off ${run.label || run.id} as the baseline? It becomes read-only, and later runs are compared with it.`)) return;
    try { await api.signoff(run.id); toast("Signed off as the baseline"); await selectProject(project.id); await refreshRun(); }
    catch (e) { toast((e as Error).message, "bad"); }
  };
  return (
    <div className="runcard">
      <div className="runcard-title">{run.label || run.id}</div>
      <dl>
        {run.change && run.change.kind !== "initial" && <><dt>Change</dt><dd>{changeLabel(run.change)}</dd></>}
        <dt>Started</dt><dd>{new Date(run.created).toLocaleString()}</dd>
        {base && <><dt>Compared with</dt><dd>{base}</dd></>}
        <dt>Status</dt><dd>{run.signed_off ? `Baseline, signed off ${new Date(run.signed_off.at).toLocaleDateString()}` : run.status === "done" ? "Ready for review" : run.status}</dd>
      </dl>
      {!run.signed_off && run.status === "done" && <button className="btn quiet" onClick={signoff}>Sign off as baseline</button>}
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: frontend\src\Viewer.tsx

import { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from "react";
import * as THREE from "three";
import { GLTFLoader } from "three/examples/jsm/loaders/GLTFLoader.js";
import { OrbitControls } from "three/examples/jsm/controls/OrbitControls.js";

/* One viewer for every stage. Node names in the GLB are occurrence ids (PN_n), the same ids the IPL rows,
   sequence steps and procedure steps carry, so selection is shared by id.
   STEP coordinates are Z-up millimetres; the GLB keeps them in metres, and the root is turned Z-up -> Y-up here. */

export interface ViewerProps {
  url: string | null;
  selected: Set<string>;                      // occ ids drawn in chromate
  tint?: Map<string, string>;                 // occ id -> CSS colour (status colouring)
  dim?: Set<string> | null;                   // when set, everything else is ghosted
  explode?: Map<string, [number, number, number]>; // occ id -> STEP direction (unit), for exploded views
  explodeAmount?: number;                     // 0..1
  hidden?: Set<string>;                       // removed parts (sequence playback)
  onPick?: (occId: string | null, additive: boolean) => void;
  onNodes?: (ids: string[]) => void;          // occurrence ids present in the loaded model
}

const BASE = new THREE.Color("#a9b2bc");
const SEL = new THREE.Color("#e3b505");

export function Viewer({ url, selected, tint, dim, explode, explodeAmount = 0, hidden, onPick, onNodes }: ViewerProps) {
  const mount = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const st = useRef<{ renderer?: THREE.WebGLRenderer; scene?: THREE.Scene; camera?: THREE.PerspectiveCamera;
    controls?: OrbitControls; root?: THREE.Group; nodes: Map<string, THREE.Object3D>; mats: Map<string, THREE.MeshStandardMaterial[]>;
    home: Map<string, THREE.Vector3>; size: number; raf?: number }>({ nodes: new Map(), mats: new Map(), home: new Map(), size: 1 });
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<"idle" | "loading" | "ready" | "error">("idle");
  const [err, setErr] = useState("");
  const [hover, setHover] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const reduceMotion = useMemo(() => window.matchMedia?.("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches, []);

  // ---- renderer (once)
  useEffect(() => {
    const el = mount.current!;
    const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ antialias: true, preserveDrawingBuffer: true });
    renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio, 2));
    renderer.setClearColor("#e3e7eb");
    el.appendChild(renderer.domElement);
    const scene = new THREE.Scene();
    const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(35, 1, 0.0005, 100);
    camera.position.set(0.25, 0.2, 0.3);
    const controls = new OrbitControls(camera, renderer.domElement);
    controls.enableDamping = !reduceMotion;
    scene.add(new THREE.HemisphereLight("#ffffff", "#8b96a3", 1.6));
    const key = new THREE.DirectionalLight("#ffffff", 1.6); key.position.set(1, 2, 1.5); scene.add(key);
    const rim = new THREE.DirectionalLight("#dfe7ff", 0.6); rim.position.set(-1.5, 0.5, -1); scene.add(rim);
    st.current = { ...st.current, renderer, scene, camera, controls };
    const resize = () => {
      const w = el.clientWidth, h = el.clientHeight;
      renderer.setSize(w, h, false); renderer.domElement.style.width = "100%"; renderer.domElement.style.height = "100%";
      camera.aspect = w / Math.max(h, 1); camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
    };
    const ro = new ResizeObserver(resize); ro.observe(el); resize();
    const loop = () => { controls.update(); renderer.render(scene, camera); st.current.raf = requestAnimationFrame(loop); };
    loop();
    return () => { ro.disconnect(); cancelAnimationFrame(st.current.raf!); renderer.dispose(); el.removeChild(renderer.domElement); };
  }, [reduceMotion]);

  // ---- model
  useEffect(() => {
    const s = st.current;
    if (!s.scene) return;
    if (s.root) { s.scene.remove(s.root); s.root = undefined; }
    s.nodes.clear(); s.mats.clear(); s.home.clear();
    if (!url) { setStatus("idle"); onNodes?.([]); return; }
    setStatus("loading");
    new GLTFLoader().load(url, (gltf) => {
      const root = new THREE.Group();
      root.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;               // STEP Z-up -> viewer Y-up
      root.add(gltf.scene);
      gltf.scene.traverse((o) => {
        if (o.name.startsWith("hidden:")) o.visible = false;      // manufacturing phases / stock of a machined part
        if (/^[A-Za-z0-9-]+_\d+$/.test(o.name)) s.nodes.set(o.name, o);
        const m = o as THREE.Mesh;
        if (m.isMesh) {
          const mat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: BASE.clone(), metalness: 0.35, roughness: 0.5, transparent: true });
          m.material = mat;
          let p: THREE.Object3D | null = m;
          while (p && !s.nodes.has(p.name) && !/^[A-Za-z0-9-]+_\d+$/.test(p.name)) p = p.parent;
          const id = p?.name ?? m.name;
          if (!s.mats.has(id)) s.mats.set(id, []);
          s.mats.get(id)!.push(mat);
          m.userData.occ = id;
        }
      });
      s.scene!.add(root); s.root = root;
      root.updateMatrixWorld(true);
      s.nodes.forEach((n, id) => s.home.set(id, n.position.clone()));
      const box = new THREE.Box3().setFromObject(root);
      const c = box.getCenter(new THREE.Vector3()), size = box.getSize(new THREE.Vector3()).length();
      s.size = size;
      s.controls!.target.copy(c);
      s.camera!.position.copy(c.clone().add(new THREE.Vector3(0.62, 0.5, 0.95).normalize().multiplyScalar(size * 1.75)));
      s.camera!.near = size / 200; s.camera!.far = size * 50; s.camera!.updateProjectionMatrix();
      setStatus("ready");
      onNodes?.([...s.nodes.keys()]);
    }, undefined, (e) => { setErr(String((e as Error)?.message ?? e)); setStatus("error"); });
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [url]);

  // ---- colours, selection, ghosting, hiding
  useEffect(() => {
    const s = st.current;
    s.mats.forEach((mats, id) => {
      const isSel = selected.has(id);
      const t = tint?.get(id);
      const ghost = dim && !dim.has(id) && !isSel;
      for (const m of mats) {
        m.color.copy(isSel ? SEL : t ? new THREE.Color(t) : BASE);
        m.emissive.copy(isSel ? new THREE.Color("#5a4300") : id === hover ? new THREE.Color("#2a3440") : new THREE.Color("#000000"));
        m.opacity = ghost ? 0.12 : 1;
        m.depthWrite = !ghost;
      }
    });
    s.nodes.forEach((n, id) => { n.visible = !(hidden?.has(id)); });
  }, [selected, tint, dim, hover, hidden, status]);

  // ---- exploded view: offset each part along its removal direction (STEP frame = root-local frame)
  useEffect(() => {
    const s = st.current;
    if (!s.root) return;
    s.root.updateMatrixWorld(true);
    s.nodes.forEach((n, id) => {
      const home = s.home.get(id);
      if (!home) return;
      n.position.copy(home);
      const d = explode?.get(id);
      if (d && explodeAmount > 0 && n.parent) {
        n.parent.updateMatrixWorld(true);
        const worldHome = n.parent.localToWorld(home.clone());
        const dir = new THREE.Vector3(...d).applyQuaternion(s.root!.quaternion).normalize();
        const target = worldHome.add(dir.multiplyScalar(s.size * 0.45 * explodeAmount));
        n.position.copy(n.parent.worldToLocal(target));
      }
    });
  }, [explode, explodeAmount, status]);

  // ---- picking
  const pick = (ev: React.MouseEvent, click: boolean) => {
    const s = st.current;
    if (!s.root || !s.camera) return;
    const r = (ev.currentTarget as HTMLElement).getBoundingClientRect();
    const ndc = new THREE.Vector2(((ev.clientX - r.left) / r.width) * 2 - 1, -((ev.clientY - r.top) / r.height) * 2 + 1);
    const ray = new THREE.Raycaster(); ray.setFromCamera(ndc, s.camera);
    const hit = ray.intersectObject(s.root, true).find((h) => {
      const m = (h.object as THREE.Mesh).material as THREE.MeshStandardMaterial;
      let o: THREE.Object3D | null = h.object;
      while (o) { if (!o.visible) return false; o = o.parent; }      // hidden parts and their parents' hidden bodies
      return !m || m.opacity > 0.5;
    });
    const id = (hit?.object.userData.occ as string) ?? null;
    if (click) onPick?.(id, ev.shiftKey || ev.metaKey || ev.ctrlKey);
    else setHover(id);
  };
  const down = useRef<[number, number]>([0, 0]);

  const fit = () => {
    const s = st.current;
    if (!s.root) return;
    const objs = [...selected].map((id) => s.nodes.get(id)).filter(Boolean) as THREE.Object3D[];
    const box = new THREE.Box3();
    (objs.length ? objs : [s.root]).forEach((o) => box.expandByObject(o));
    const c = box.getCenter(new THREE.Vector3()), size = Math.max(box.getSize(new THREE.Vector3()).length(), s.size * 0.08);
    const dir = s.camera!.position.clone().sub(s.controls!.target).normalize();
    s.controls!.target.copy(c);
    s.camera!.position.copy(c.clone().add(dir.multiplyScalar(size * 1.9)));
  };

  return (
    <div className="viewer">
      <div ref={mount} className="viewer-canvas"
        onMouseDown={(e) => { down.current = [e.clientX, e.clientY]; }}
        onMouseUp={(e) => { if (Math.abs(e.clientX - down.current[0]) + Math.abs(e.clientY - down.current[1]) < 4) pick(e, true); }}
        onMouseMove={(e) => pick(e, false)} />
      <div className="viewer-hud">
        {status === "loading" && <span>Loading the 3D model…</span>}
        {status === "error" && <span className="bad">The 3D model could not be loaded: {err}</span>}
        {status === "idle" && <span>The 3D model appears after the conversion.</span>}
        {status === "ready" && hover && <span className="hover-id">{hover}</span>}
      </div>
      {status === "ready" && <button className="viewer-fit" onClick={fit} title="Frame the selection (or the whole model)">Frame</button>}
    </div>
  );
}

/* Thin client for the studio API. Artifacts are the backend's JSON files, typed loosely on purpose:
   the backend is the single source of truth for their shape (see the backend module docstrings). */
/* eslint-disable @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any */
export type Json = any;

async function req<T = Json>(method: string, url: string, body?: unknown, form?: FormData): Promise<T> {
  const init: RequestInit = { method };
  if (form) init.body = form;
  else if (body !== undefined) {
    init.body = JSON.stringify(body);
    init.headers = { "content-type": "application/json" };
  }
  const r = await fetch(url, init);
  if (!r.ok) {
    let msg = `${r.status} ${r.statusText}`;
    let detail: Json = null;
    try { const j = await r.json(); detail = j.detail; msg = typeof j.detail === "string" ? j.detail : j.detail?.message ?? JSON.stringify(j.detail ?? j); } catch { /* not JSON */ }
    throw Object.assign(new Error(msg), { status: r.status, detail });
  }
  return r.status === 204 ? (undefined as T) : r.json();
}

export interface Run {
  id: string; project: string; label: string; created: string; status: "queued" | "running" | "done" | "failed";
  stages: Record<string, { status: string; label: string; seconds?: number; summary?: Json; error?: string }>;
  progress: { stage: string | null; fraction: number; message: string };
  inputs: Record<string, { file: string; sha256: string; bytes: number }>;
  base_run: string | null; signed_off: { at: string; by: string } | null; error: string | null;
  model_file?: string; busy?: boolean; manuf_prefix?: string;
  change?: { kind: "initial" | "revision" | "modification" | "variant"; reference?: string | null; title?: string | null; reason?: string | null };
  publication?: Json;
}
export interface Project {
  id: string; name: string; created: string; settings: Json; runs: string[]; baseline: string | null; run_list?: Run[]; last_run?: Run | null;
  kind?: "product" | "variant"; family?: string; parent?: { project: string; run: string; name: string; label?: string } | null;
}

export const api = {
  system: () => req("GET", "/api/system"),
  projects: () => req<Project[]>("GET", "/api/projects"),
  project: (pid: string) => req<Project>("GET", `/api/projects/${pid}`),
  createProject: (name: string, settings: Json = {}, parent?: string) => req<Project>("POST", "/api/projects", { name, settings, parent }),
  saveSettings: (pid: string, s: Json) => req<Project>("PATCH", `/api/projects/${pid}/settings`, s),
  createRun: (pid: string, form: FormData) => req<Run>("POST", `/api/projects/${pid}/runs`, undefined, form),
  run: (rid: string) => req<Run>("GET", `/api/runs/${rid}`),
  rerun: (rid: string, stage: string) => req("POST", `/api/runs/${rid}/rerun?from_stage=${stage}`),
  artifact: (rid: string, name: string) => req("GET", `/api/runs/${rid}/artifacts/${name}`),
  editRow: (rid: string, row: string, fields: Json) => req("PATCH", `/api/runs/${rid}/ipl/rows/${row}`, { fields }),
  acceptRows: (rid: string, rows: string[] = []) => req("POST", `/api/runs/${rid}/ipl/accept`, { rows }),
  reorder: (rid: string, order: string[]) => req("PUT", `/api/runs/${rid}/sequence`, { order }),
  editStep: (rid: string, kind: string, step: string, text: string) => req("PATCH", `/api/runs/${rid}/procedures/${kind}/steps/${step}`, { text }),
  signoff: (rid: string) => req<Run>("POST", `/api/runs/${rid}/signoff`, { by: "writer" }),
  publish: (rid: string, body: Json) => req("POST", `/api/runs/${rid}/publish`, body),
  publications: (rid: string) => req<Json[]>("GET", `/api/runs/${rid}/publications`),
  // checked documents
  check: (rid: string) => req("GET", `/api/runs/${rid}/check`),
  checkAgain: (rid: string) => req("POST", `/api/runs/${rid}/check`),
  documentUrl: (rid: string, name: string) => `/api/runs/${rid}/documents/${encodeURIComponent(name)}`,
  documentText: async (rid: string, name: string) => {
    const r = await fetch(`/api/runs/${rid}/documents/${encodeURIComponent(name)}`);
    if (!r.ok) throw new Error(`${r.status} ${r.statusText}`);
    return r.text();
  },
  documentView: (rid: string, name: string, stylesheet?: string) =>
    req<{ html: string; stylesheet: Json }>("GET", `/api/runs/${rid}/documents/${encodeURIComponent(name)}/view${stylesheet ? `?stylesheet=${encodeURIComponent(stylesheet)}` : ""}`),
  documentValidate: (rid: string, name: string, text: string) =>
    req("POST", `/api/runs/${rid}/documents/${encodeURIComponent(name)}/validate`, { text }),
  documentViewText: (rid: string, name: string, text: string, stylesheet?: string) =>
    req<{ html: string; stylesheet: Json }>("POST", `/api/runs/${rid}/documents/${encodeURIComponent(name)}/view`, { text, stylesheet: stylesheet || null }),
  documentSave: (rid: string, name: string, text: string) =>
    req("PUT", `/api/runs/${rid}/documents/${encodeURIComponent(name)}`, { text }),
  documentDiscard: (rid: string, name: string) =>
    req("DELETE", `/api/runs/${rid}/documents/${encodeURIComponent(name)}/edit`),
  // schemas, BREX, rule sets, stylesheets
  conformance: () => req("GET", "/api/conformance"),
  inspectSchemas: (files: File[], paths: string[]) => {
    const f = new FormData();
    files.forEach((x) => f.append("files", x));
    f.append("paths", JSON.stringify(paths));
    return req("POST", "/api/conformance/packages/inspect", undefined, f);
  },
  installSchemas: (staging: string, choice: Json, replace = false) => req("POST", "/api/conformance/packages/install", { staging, choice, replace }),
  installEvaluation: () => req<Json[]>("POST", "/api/conformance/packages/evaluation"),
  setPackage: (key: string, enabled: boolean) => req("PATCH", `/api/conformance/packages/${key}`, { enabled }),
  removePackage: (key: string) => req("DELETE", `/api/conformance/packages/${key}`),
  packageExportUrl: (key: string) => `/api/conformance/package-export/${key}`,
  addBrex: (file: File) => { const f = new FormData(); f.append("file", file); return req("POST", "/api/conformance/brex", undefined, f); },
  removeBrex: (dmc: string, issue: string) => req("DELETE", `/api/conformance/brex/${encodeURIComponent(dmc)}/${encodeURIComponent(issue)}`),
  setSubstitute: (named: string, use: string) => req("PUT", "/api/conformance/brex-substitutes", { named, use }),
  removeSubstitute: (named: string) => req("DELETE", `/api/conformance/brex-substitutes/${encodeURIComponent(named)}`),
  addRules: (file: File, applies_to: Json, name = "") => {
    const f = new FormData(); f.append("file", file); f.append("name", name); f.append("applies_to", JSON.stringify(applies_to));
    return req("POST", "/api/conformance/rules", undefined, f);
  },
  changeRules: (id: string, body: Json) => req("PATCH", `/api/conformance/rules/${id}`, body),
  removeRules: (id: string) => req("DELETE", `/api/conformance/rules/${id}`),
  rulesSourceUrl: (id: string) => `/api/conformance/rules/${id}/source`,
  addStylesheet: (file: File, kind: string, applies_to: Json, order = 100, name = "") => {
    const f = new FormData(); f.append("file", file); f.append("kind", kind); f.append("name", name);
    f.append("applies_to", JSON.stringify(applies_to)); f.append("order", String(order));
    return req("POST", "/api/conformance/stylesheets", undefined, f);
  },
  changeStylesheet: (id: string, body: Json) => req("PATCH", `/api/conformance/stylesheets/${id}`, body),
  removeStylesheet: (id: string) => req("DELETE", `/api/conformance/stylesheets/${id}`),
  stylesheetSourceUrl: (id: string) => `/api/conformance/stylesheets/${id}/source`,
  checkAny: (file: File) => { const f = new FormData(); f.append("file", file); return req("POST", "/api/conformance/check", undefined, f); },
  partsImport: (rid: string) => req("GET", `/api/runs/${rid}/parts-import`),
  confirmPartsImport: (rid: string, table: string, columns: Json) => req("PUT", `/api/runs/${rid}/parts-import`, { table, columns }),
  llmSettings: () => req("GET", "/api/settings/llm"),
  saveLlm: (s: Json) => req("PUT", "/api/settings/llm", s),
  testLlm: (s: Json) => req("POST", "/api/settings/llm/test", s),
  llmModels: (s: Json) => req<{ models: string[] }>("POST", "/api/settings/llm/models", s),
  modelUrl: (rid: string) => `/api/runs/${rid}/model.glb`,
  exportUrl: (rid: string, target: string) => `/api/runs/${rid}/export/${target}`,
};

import { createContext, useCallback, useContext, useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { api, Json, Project, Run } from "./api";

/* Shared studio state: the selected project and run, the scene shown in the 3D viewer, and artifact loading.
   Views describe what the viewer should show (selection, tint, ghosting, explode, hidden) and the shell draws it. */

export interface Scene {
  selected: Set<string>;
  tint?: Map<string, string>;
  dim?: Set<string> | null;
  explode?: Map<string, [number, number, number]>;
  explodeAmount?: number;
  hidden?: Set<string>;
}

export type ViewId = "inputs" | "match" | "ipl" | "sequence" | "procedures" | "check" | "publish" | "changes" | "schemas" | "settings";

interface Ctx {
  system: Json | null;
  projects: Project[];
  project: Project | null;
  run: Run | null;
  version: number;                    // bumps whenever run outputs may have changed
  view: ViewId; setView: (v: ViewId) => void;
  procKind: string; setProcKind: (k: string) => void;
  selectProject: (pid: string | null) => void;
  selectRun: (rid: string | null) => void;
  refreshProjects: () => Promise<void>;
  refreshRun: () => Promise<void>;
  refreshSystem: () => void;
  touch: () => void;                  // local edit happened: reload artifacts
  scene: Scene; setScene: (s: Partial<Scene>) => void;
  nodes: string[]; setNodes: (n: string[]) => void;
  pickHandler: React.MutableRefObject<((id: string | null, add: boolean) => void) | null>;
  toast: (msg: string, kind?: "ok" | "bad") => void;
  editable: boolean;
}

const C = createContext<Ctx | null>(null);
export const useStudio = () => useContext(C)!;

export function StudioProvider({ children, toast }: { children: React.ReactNode; toast: Ctx["toast"] }) {
  const [system, setSystem] = useState<Json | null>(null);
  const [projects, setProjects] = useState<Project[]>([]);
  const [project, setProject] = useState<Project | null>(null);
  const [run, setRun] = useState<Run | null>(null);
  const [version, setVersion] = useState(0);
  const [view, setView] = useState<ViewId>("inputs");
  const [procKind, setProcKind] = useState("disassembly");
  const [scene, setSceneState] = useState<Scene>({ selected: new Set() });
  const [nodes, setNodes] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const pickHandler = useRef<((id: string | null, add: boolean) => void) | null>(null);
  const fingerprint = useRef("");

  const params = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
  const initial = useRef({ project: params.get("project"), run: params.get("run"), view: params.get("view") as ViewId | null });

  const refreshProjects = useCallback(async () => {
    const ps = await api.projects();
    setProjects(ps);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    api.system().then(setSystem).catch((e) => toast(`The studio server did not answer: ${e.message}`, "bad"));
    refreshProjects().then(() => {
      const { project: p, view: v } = initial.current;
      if (v) setView(v);
      if (p) selectProject(p);
    });
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, []);

  // first project by default
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!project && projects.length && !initial.current.project) selectProject(projects[0].id);
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [projects]);

  const selectProject = useCallback(async (pid: string | null) => {
    if (!pid) { setProject(null); setRun(null); return; }
    try {
      const p = await api.project(pid);
      setProject(p);
      const want = initial.current.run && p.runs.includes(initial.current.run) ? initial.current.run : p.runs[p.runs.length - 1];
      initial.current.run = null;
      if (want) selectRun(want); else setRun(null);
    } catch (e) { toast((e as Error).message, "bad"); }
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, []);

  const selectRun = useCallback(async (rid: string | null) => {
    if (!rid) { setRun(null); return; }
    const r = await api.run(rid);
    fingerprint.current = "";
    setRun(r);
    setSceneState({ selected: new Set() });
    setVersion((v) => v + 1);
  }, []);

  const refreshRun = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!run) return;
    const r = await api.run(run.id);
    const fp = JSON.stringify([r.status, Object.values(r.stages || {}).map((s) => [s.status, s.seconds])]);
    if (fp !== fingerprint.current) { fingerprint.current = fp; setVersion((v) => v + 1); }
    setRun(r);
  }, [run]);

  // keep the URL shareable
  useEffect(() => {
    const q = new URLSearchParams();
    if (project) q.set("project", project.id);
    if (run) q.set("run", run.id);
    q.set("view", view);
    history.replaceState(null, "", `?${q}`);
  }, [project, run, view]);

  // poll while the pipeline runs
  const busy = !!run && (run.busy || run.status === "running" || run.status === "queued");
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!busy) return;
    const t = setInterval(() => { refreshRun().catch(() => undefined); }, 900);
    return () => clearInterval(t);
  }, [busy, refreshRun]);

  const refreshSystem = useCallback(() => { api.system().then(setSystem).catch(() => undefined); }, []);
  const setScene = useCallback((s: Partial<Scene>) => setSceneState((o) => ({ ...o, ...s })), []);
  const touch = useCallback(() => { setVersion((v) => v + 1); setTimeout(() => refreshRun().catch(() => undefined), 400); }, [refreshRun]);

  return (
    <C.Provider value={{ system, projects, project, run, version, view, setView, procKind, setProcKind, selectProject, selectRun, refreshProjects,
      refreshRun, refreshSystem, touch, scene, setScene, nodes, setNodes, pickHandler, toast, editable: !!run && !run.signed_off && !busy }}>
      {children}
    </C.Provider>
  );
}

/** Load a run artifact (JSON) and reload it whenever the run's outputs change. */
export function useArtifact<T = Json>(name: string, enabled = true): { data: T | null; error: string | null; reload: () => void } {
  const { run, version } = useStudio();
  const [data, setData] = useState<T | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [n, setN] = useState(0);
  const rid = run?.id;
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!rid || !enabled) { setData(null); return; }
    let live = true;
    api.artifact(rid, name).then((d) => { if (live) { setData(d); setError(null); } })
      .catch((e) => { if (live) { setData(null); setError(e.message); } });
    return () => { live = false; };
  }, [rid, name, version, n, enabled]);
  return { data, error, reload: () => setN((x) => x + 1) };
}

/** The occurrence ids in the model for a STEP part number (GLB node names are safe(PN)_n). */
export function occsForPn(nodes: string[], pn: string | null | undefined): string[] {
  if (!pn) return [];
  const safe = pn.trim().replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9-]+/g, "-").replace(/^-+|-+$/g, "");
  return nodes.filter((n) => n.slice(0, n.lastIndexOf("_")) === safe);
}

export const plural = (n: number, one: string, many = one + "s") => `${n} ${n === 1 ? one : many}`;

import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { Json } from "../api";
import { plural, useArtifact, useStudio } from "../state";

/* What changed between the signed-off baseline and this run, which procedure steps it touches,
   and how much of the baseline text was carried forward unchanged. */

const TYPE: Record<string, string> = {
  part_number_changed: "Part number changed", added: "Part added", removed: "Part removed", moved: "Part moved",
  geometry_changed: "Geometry changed", quantity_changed: "Quantity changed", torque_changed: "Torque changed",
  nomenclature_changed: "Name changed", note_changed: "Drawing note changed", ipl_added: "Parts-list line added",
  ipl_removed: "Parts-list line removed", ipl_changed: "Parts-list line changed",
};
const typeLabel = (t: string) => TYPE[t] ?? t.replace(/_/g, " ").replace(/^./, (c) => c.toUpperCase());

export function ChangesView() {
  const { data: cs, error } = useArtifact<Json>("changeset");
  const { setScene, pickHandler, nodes, setView, setProcKind, project, run } = useStudio();
  const [sel, setSel] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const changes: Json[] = cs?.changes ?? [];

  const tint = useMemo(() => {
    const m = new Map<string, string>();
    changes.forEach((c) => (c.occ_ids_new ?? []).forEach((o: string) => m.set(o, "#6f95bd")));
    return m;
  }, [changes]);
  const dim = useMemo(() => new Set(changes.flatMap((c) => c.occ_ids_new ?? [])), [changes]);
  useEffect(() => {
    const c = changes.find((x) => x.id === sel);
    setScene({ selected: new Set(c?.occ_ids_new ?? []), tint, dim: dim.size ? dim : null, explode: undefined, hidden: undefined });
  }, [sel, changes, tint, dim, setScene]);
  useEffect(() => () => setScene({ dim: null }), [setScene]);
  useEffect(() => {
    pickHandler.current = (id) => setSel(changes.find((c) => c.occ_ids_new?.includes(id))?.id ?? null);
    return () => { pickHandler.current = null; };
  }, [changes, pickHandler]);

  if (error) return <div className="view"><h1>Changes from baseline</h1><p className="fine">This run has no comparison yet. It is made when the run has a signed-off baseline.</p></div>;
  if (!cs) return <div className="view"><p className="fine">Loading…</p></div>;
  const base = project?.run_list?.find((r) => r.id === run?.base_run);
  const ctx = cs.context ?? {};
  const baseName = base?.label ?? (ctx.base ? `${ctx.base.product}, ${ctx.base.label}` : "the baseline");
  const cf = cs.carry_forward ?? {};

  return (
    <div className="view changes">
      <header className="view-head">
        <h1>{ctx.kind === "variant" ? `Differences from ${baseName}` : ctx.kind === "modification" ? `${ctx.reference}: changes from ${baseName}` : `Changes from ${baseName}`}</h1>
        {(ctx.title || ctx.reason) && <p className="fine">{ctx.title}{ctx.title && ctx.reason ? " · " : ""}{ctx.reason ? `Reason: ${ctx.reason}` : ""}</p>}
        <p className="lede-s">{changes.length ? `${plural(changes.length, "change")} found in the 3D model, parts list and drawing. ${plural(cs.summary?.affected_steps ?? 0, "procedure step")} in ${plural(cs.summary?.affected_subtasks ?? 0, "subtask")} are affected.` : "No changes from the baseline: the procedures carry over as they are."}</p>
        <div className="carry">
          {(["disassembly", "assembly"] as const).map((k) => cf[k] && (
            <div key={k} className="carry-bar" title={`${cf[k].kept} steps kept word for word, ${cf[k].changed} regenerated`}>
              <span className="carry-label">{k === "disassembly" ? "Disassembly" : "Assembly"}</span>
              <span className="bar2"><span className="kept" style={{ flex: cf[k].kept }} /><span className="chg" style={{ flex: Math.max(cf[k].changed, 0.0001) }} /></span>
              <span className="fine">{cf[k].kept} kept, {cf[k].changed} regenerated</span>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
        {changes.length > 0 && <button className="btn" onClick={() => { setProcKind("modification"); setView("procedures"); }}>{ctx.kind === "variant" ? "Open the conversion procedure" : "Open the modification procedure"}</button>}
      </header>

      <ol className="change-list">
        {changes.map((c) => (
          <li key={c.id} className={sel === c.id ? "sel" : ""} onClick={() => setSel(sel === c.id ? null : c.id)}>
            <div className="chg-head">
              <span className="tag info">{typeLabel(c.type)}</span>
              <span className="chg-msg">{c.part_number_base || c.part_number_new ? (c.name ?? c.message) : c.message}{c.count > 1 ? ` (${c.count} places)` : ""}</span>
              <span className="fine">{c.source}</span>
            </div>
            {(c.part_number_base || c.part_number_new) && <p className="chg-pn"><span className="pn old">{c.part_number_base ?? "—"}</span> <span aria-hidden>→</span> <span className="pn">{c.part_number_new ?? "—"}</span>
              {c.geometry && c.source !== "IPL" && <span className="fine"> · {c.geometry === "same" ? "same geometry and position" : `geometry ${c.geometry}`}</span>}</p>}
            {c.ipl && <p className="fine">{c.ipl}</p>}
            {(c.flags ?? []).map((f: string, i: number) => <p key={i} className="flag">{f}</p>)}
            {c.affected_steps?.length > 0 && <>
              <h4>Steps that change</h4>
              <ul className="aff">{c.affected_steps.map((s: Json, i: number) => <li key={i}><span className="fine">{s.procedure}</span> {s.text}</li>)}</ul>
            </>}
            {nodes.length > 0 && !(c.occ_ids_new ?? []).length && c.source !== "IPL" && <p className="fine">Not in the new 3D model.</p>}
            {c.source === "IPL" && <p className="flag">The 3D model was not changed: it still shows {c.part_number_base ?? "the previous part"}. Update the 3D, or confirm the change applies to the parts list only.</p>}
          </li>
        ))}
      </ol>
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: frontend\src\views\Check.tsx
