import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { api, Json } from "../api";
import { plural, useStudio } from "../state";
import { XmlCode } from "./xml/XmlCode";
import { XmlDoc } from "./xml/XmlDoc";

/* The generated documents as they will be published: checked against the installed schema, the BREX they
   name and the rule sets, shown through a view stylesheet, with every problem tied to its line. */

const STATUS_LABEL: Record<string, string> = {
  passed: "Passed", failed: "Failed", "not-run": "Not checked", "not-implemented": "Not available", unsupported: "No schema",
};
const STATUS_CLS: Record<string, string> = { passed: "ok", failed: "bad", "not-run": "", unsupported: "warn", "not-implemented": "" };

export function CheckView() {
  const { run, project, toast, touch, setView, selectProject, version, editable } = useStudio();
  const dirty = useRef(false);
  const [check, setCheck] = useState<Json | null>(null);
  const [err, setErr] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [sel, setSel] = useState(0);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [conf, setConf] = useState<Json | null>(null);

  const load = () => run && api.check(run.id).then((c) => { setCheck(c); setErr(null); }).catch((e) => { setCheck(null); setErr(e.message); });
  // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  useEffect(() => { load(); }, [run?.id, version]);
  useEffect(() => { api.conformance().then(setConf).catch(() => undefined); }, []);

  const again = async () => {
    if (!run) return;
    setBusy(true);
    try { const c = await api.checkAgain(run.id); setCheck(c); touch(); toast(c.summary.errors ? `Checked: ${plural(c.summary.errors, "error")}` : "Checked: no errors", c.summary.errors ? "bad" : "ok"); }
    catch (e) { toast((e as Error).message, "bad"); }
    finally { setBusy(false); }
  };
  const chooseSchema = async (target: string, value: string) => {
    if (!project) return;
    const schemas = { ...(project.settings?.schemas ?? {}) };
    if (value) schemas[target] = value; else delete schemas[target];
    try { await api.saveSettings(project.id, { schemas }); await selectProject(project.id); await again(); }
    catch (e) { toast((e as Error).message, "bad"); }
  };

  if (!run) return null;
  const noSchemas = conf && conf.packages.length === 0;
  if (!check) {
    return (
      <div className="view checkdocs">
        <h1>Check documents</h1>
        <p className="lede-s">{err && !/not been checked/.test(err) ? err : "The documents are checked at the end of each run."}</p>
        <button className="btn primary" onClick={again} disabled={busy}>{busy ? "Checking…" : "Check the documents now"}</button>
      </div>
    );
  }
  const docs: Json[] = check.documents;
  const doc = docs[Math.min(sel, docs.length - 1)];
  const s = check.summary;

  return (
    <div className="view checkdocs">
      <header className="view-head">
        <h1>Check documents</h1>
        <p className="lede-s">
          {s.passed} of {plural(s.documents, "document")} pass. {s.errors ? `${plural(s.errors, "error")}, ` : ""}{plural(s.warnings, "warning")}.
          {" "}Checked {new Date(check.at).toLocaleString()} against what is installed in <button className="link" onClick={() => setView("schemas")}>Schemas and rules</button>.
        </p>
        <div className="toolbar">
          <button className="btn" onClick={again} disabled={busy}>{busy ? "Checking…" : "Check again"}</button>
          <span className="fine">Check again after adding schemas, BREX, rules or stylesheets.</span>
        </div>
        {noSchemas && <div className="callout warn">No schema package is installed, so the documents were only checked for well-formed XML.
          <button className="btn" onClick={() => setView("schemas")}>Add schemas</button></div>}
      </header>

      <div className="check-grid">
        <ol className="doc-list" aria-label="Documents">
          {docs.map((d, i) => {
            const r = d.report;
            const n = r.counts.error + r.counts.fatal;
            return (
              <li key={d.name}>
                <button className={i === sel ? "on" : ""} onClick={() => {
                  if (i !== sel && dirty.current && !window.confirm("This document has unsaved changes. Leave them?")) return;
                  dirty.current = false; setSel(i);
                }}>
                  <span className={`doc-dot ${r.passed ? "ok" : n ? "bad" : "warn"}`} aria-hidden />
                  <span className="doc-name">{docTitle(d)}</span>
                  <span className="doc-file">{d.name}{d.edited && <span className={`doc-edited ${d.edited.stale ? "stale" : ""}`}> · edited{d.edited.stale ? ", generated has changed" : ""}</span>}</span>
                  <span className="doc-count">{n ? plural(n, "error") : r.counts.warning ? plural(r.counts.warning, "warning") : "Clean"}</span>
                </button>
              </li>
            );
          })}
        </ol>
        {doc && <DocPanel key={doc.name} doc={doc} rid={run.id} conf={conf} checkedAt={check.at} editable={editable}
          choice={project?.settings?.schemas?.[doc.target] ?? ""} onChoose={(v) => chooseSchema(doc.target, v)}
          onChecked={(c) => { setCheck(c); touch(); }} onDirty={(b) => { dirty.current = b; }} />}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

const docTitle = (d: Json) => ({
  "S1000D-530": "Disassembly data module (530)", "S1000D-710": "Assembly data module (710)", "S1000D-941": "Illustrated parts data (941)",
  "ATA-CMM": "Component maintenance manual",
} as Record<string, string>)[d.key] ?? d.name;

type Tab = "problems" | "doc" | "xml" | "split";
const TABS: [Tab, string][] = [["doc", "Document"], ["problems", "Problems"], ["xml", "XML"], ["split", "Side by side"]];
const loadTags = () => { try { return localStorage.getItem("studio.tags") === "1"; } catch { return false; } };

function DocPanel({ doc, rid, conf, checkedAt, editable, choice, onChoose, onChecked, onDirty }: {
  doc: Json; rid: string; conf: Json; checkedAt: string; editable: boolean; choice: string; onChoose: (v: string) => void;
  onChecked: (c: Json) => void; onDirty: (b: boolean) => void;
}) {
  const { toast } = useStudio();
  const r = doc.report;
  const [tab, setTab] = useState<Tab>("doc");
  const [look, setLook] = useState("");                         // "" = the editable document; else a view stylesheet ("auto" or its id)
  const views: Json[] = (conf?.stylesheets ?? []).filter((x: Json) => x.kind === "view" && x.enabled !== false);
  const [tags, setTagsState] = useState(loadTags);
  const [goto, setGoto] = useState<{ line: number; n: number } | null>(null);
  const [saved, setSaved] = useState<string | null>(null);      // the document as checked
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [live, setLive] = useState<Json | null>(null);          // check of the unsaved text
  const [checking, setChecking] = useState(false);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const id = r.identification ?? {};
  const options: Json[] = conf?.coverage?.[doc.target]?.options ?? [];
  const dirty = draft != null && saved != null && draft !== saved;
  const setTags = (b: boolean) => { setTagsState(b); try { localStorage.setItem("studio.tags", b ? "1" : "0"); } catch { /* private window */ } };

  // the checked text; again after every check (save, discard, check again)
  useEffect(() => {
    let off = false;
    api.documentText(rid, doc.name).then((t) => { if (!off) { setSaved(t); setDraft((d) => (d == null || d === saved ? t : d)); } })
      .catch((e) => !off && setSaved(`<!-- ${e.message} -->`));
    return () => { off = true; };
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [rid, doc.name, checkedAt]);
  useEffect(() => { onDirty(dirty); }, [dirty, onDirty]);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!dirty) return;
    const warn = (e: BeforeUnloadEvent) => { e.preventDefault(); };
    window.addEventListener("beforeunload", warn);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("beforeunload", warn);
  }, [dirty]);

  // live check of the unsaved text, a moment after typing stops
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!dirty || draft == null) { setLive(null); return; }
    setChecking(true);
    const t = window.setTimeout(() => {
      api.documentValidate(rid, doc.name, draft).then(setLive).catch(() => setLive(null)).finally(() => setChecking(false));
    }, 700);
    return () => window.clearTimeout(t);
  }, [draft, dirty, rid, doc.name]);

  const report = dirty && live ? live : r;
  const diags: Json[] = report.diagnostics;
  const nErr = report.counts.error + report.counts.fatal, nWarn = report.counts.warning;
  const toLine = useCallback((l: number | null | undefined) => {
    if (!l) return;
    setGoto((g) => ({ line: l, n: (g?.n ?? 0) + 1 }));
    setTab((t) => (t === "split" ? t : "xml"));
  }, []);

  const save = async () => {
    if (!draft || !dirty) return;
    setSaving(true);
    try {
      const c = await api.documentSave(rid, doc.name, draft);
      const mine = c.documents.find((x: Json) => x.name === doc.name);
      setSaved(draft);
      onChecked(c);
      const n = mine ? mine.report.counts.error + mine.report.counts.fatal : 0;
      toast(n ? `Saved. ${plural(n, "error")} still to fix` : "Saved and checked: no errors", n ? "bad" : "ok");
    } catch (e) { toast((e as Error).message, "bad"); }
    finally { setSaving(false); }
  };
  const revert = () => { if (saved != null) setDraft(saved); };
  const discard = async () => {
    if (!window.confirm("Go back to the generated document? Your edit of this document is removed.")) return;
    try { const c = await api.documentDiscard(rid, doc.name); setDraft(null); onChecked(c); toast("Back to the generated document", "ok"); }
    catch (e) { toast((e as Error).message, "bad"); }
  };
  useEffect(() => {
    const key = (e: KeyboardEvent) => { if ((e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) && e.key.toLowerCase() === "s") { e.preventDefault(); if (editable) save(); } };
    window.addEventListener("keydown", key);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", key);
  });

  const editing = tab === "doc" || tab === "xml" || tab === "split";
  const ro = !editable;
  const status = checking ? { cls: "pending", text: "Checking…" }
    : nErr ? { cls: "bad", text: plural(nErr, "error") + (nWarn ? `, ${plural(nWarn, "warning")}` : "") }
    : nWarn ? { cls: "warn", text: plural(nWarn, "warning") } : { cls: "ok", text: "Valid" };

  return (
    <section className="doc-panel" aria-label={doc.name}>
      <div className="doc-head">
        <h2>{docTitle(doc)}</h2>
        <p className="fine">{doc.name}
          {doc.edited && <span className={`edit-badge ${doc.edited.stale ? "stale" : ""}`}>
            {doc.edited.stale ? "Edited by hand; the generated document has changed since" : `Edited by hand ${new Date(doc.edited.at).toLocaleString()}`}</span>}
        </p>
        <dl className="facts">
          <dt>Schema</dt>
          <dd>{id.package_id ? <>{id.package_id} · {id.doc_type} <span className="fine">({id.how})</span></> : <span className="warn-t">No installed schema fits this document</span>}</dd>
          {options.length > 0 && <>
            <dt><label htmlFor="schema-choice">Validate against</label></dt>
            <dd><select id="schema-choice" value={choice} onChange={(e) => onChoose(e.target.value)} disabled={dirty}>
              <option value="">The schema the document declares</option>
              {options.map((o) => <option key={o.package_id + o.doc_type} value={`${o.package_id}:${o.doc_type}`}>{o.label}{o.provenance === "synthetic" ? " (evaluation)" : ""}</option>)}
            </select></dd>
          </>}
          {doc.transforms?.length > 0 && <><dt>Transforms</dt><dd>{doc.transforms.map((t: Json) => t.name).join(", ")}</dd></>}
        </dl>
        <ol className="stage-strip">
          {report.stages.map((st: Json) => (
            <li key={st.stage} className={STATUS_CLS[st.status] ?? ""} title={st.note}>
              <span className="stage-n">{st.stage}</span>
              <span className="stage-t">{st.name}</span>
              <span className="stage-s">{STATUS_LABEL[st.status] ?? st.status}</span>
              {st.note && <span className="stage-note">{st.note}</span>}
            </li>
          ))}
        </ol>
      </div>
      <div className="tabs" role="tablist">
        {TABS.map(([k, label]) => (
          <button key={k} role="tab" aria-selected={tab === k} className={tab === k ? "on" : ""} onClick={() => setTab(k)}>
            {label}{k === "problems" && <span className={`tab-count ${nErr ? "bad" : nWarn ? "warn" : "ok"}`}>{diags.length}</span>}
          </button>
        ))}
        <a className="link tab-link" href={api.documentUrl(rid, doc.name)} download={doc.name}>Download</a>
      </div>
      {(editing || dirty) && (
        <div className={`edit-bar ${dirty ? "dirty" : ""}`}>
          <span className={`live ${status.cls}`} role="status">{status.text}</span>
          <span className="fine">{ro ? "Signed-off baseline: read only. Start a new run to change it."
            : dirty ? "Unsaved changes, checked as you type." : doc.edited ? "Saved edit: this is what is published." : "Edit the text in Document, the markup in XML."}</span>
          {(tab === "doc" || tab === "split") && !look && (
            <label className="switch"><input type="checkbox" checked={tags} onChange={(e) => setTags(e.target.checked)} /> Tags</label>
          )}
          {tab === "doc" && (
            <label className="look fine">Show
              <select value={look} onChange={(e) => setLook(e.target.value)}>
                <option value="">Document (edit here)</option>
                <option value="auto">Print preview: built-in stylesheet</option>
                {views.map((v) => <option key={v.id} value={v.id}>Print preview: {v.name}</option>)}
              </select>
            </label>
          )}
          <span className="edit-actions">
            {doc.edited && !dirty && !ro && <button className="btn quiet" onClick={discard}>Back to generated</button>}
            {dirty && <button className="btn quiet" onClick={revert}>Revert</button>}
            {!ro && <button className="btn primary" onClick={save} disabled={!dirty || saving} title="Ctrl+S">{saving ? "Saving…" : "Save and check"}</button>}
          </span>
        </div>
      )}
      {tab === "problems" && <Diagnostics items={diags} onLine={toLine} />}
      {editing && draft == null && <p className="fine">Loading…</p>}
      {editing && draft != null && (
        <div className={`editor ${tab}`}>
          {tab === "doc" && look &&
            <div className="editor-pane"><Preview rid={rid} name={doc.name} sheet={look === "auto" ? "" : look} draft={dirty ? draft : null} /></div>}
          {((tab === "doc" && !look) || tab === "split") &&
            <div className="editor-pane"><XmlDoc text={draft} onChange={setDraft} readOnly={ro} tags={tags} diagnostics={diags} onLine={toLine} /></div>}
          {(tab === "xml" || tab === "split") &&
            <div className="editor-pane code"><XmlCode text={draft} onChange={setDraft} readOnly={ro} diagnostics={diags} gotoLine={goto} /></div>}
        </div>
      )}
    </section>
  );
}

export function Diagnostics({ items, onLine }: { items: Json[]; onLine?: (l: number) => void }) {
  if (!items.length) return <p className="clean">No problems found.</p>;
  const order = { fatal: 0, error: 1, warning: 2, info: 3 } as Record<string, number>;
  const sorted = [...items].sort((a, b) => (order[a.severity] - order[b.severity]) || (a.stage - b.stage) || ((a.line ?? 0) - (b.line ?? 0)));
  return (
    <ul className="diags">
      {sorted.map((d, i) => (
        <li key={i} className={`diag-item ${d.severity}`}>
          <div className="diag-top">
            <span className={`sev ${d.severity}`}>{d.severity}</span>
            <code className="rule">{d.rule_id}</code>
            {d.line && onLine ? <button className="link" onClick={() => onLine(d.line)}>line {d.line}</button> : d.line ? <span className="fine">line {d.line}</span> : null}
            {d.element_path && <span className="path" title={d.element_path}>{d.element_path}</span>}
          </div>
          <p className="diag-msg">{d.message}</p>
          {d.suggestion && <p className="diag-sugg">{d.suggestion}</p>}
          {d.reference && <p className="fine">{d.reference}</p>}
        </li>
      ))}
    </ul>
  );
}

/** The document through a view stylesheet (read only): what a print or a portal shows. */
function Preview({ rid, name, sheet, draft }: { rid: string; name: string; sheet: string; draft: string | null }) {
  const [html, setHtml] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [err, setErr] = useState<string | null>(null);
  useEffect(() => {
    setErr(null);
    const p = draft != null ? api.documentViewText(rid, name, draft, sheet || undefined) : api.documentView(rid, name, sheet || undefined);
    p.then((v) => setHtml(v.html)).catch((e) => setErr(e.message));
  }, [rid, name, sheet, draft]);
  return err ? <p className="callout bad">{err}</p> : html == null ? <p className="fine">Rendering…</p> :
    <iframe className="doc-frame preview" title={`Print preview of ${name}`} sandbox="" srcDoc={html} />;
}

import { useState } from "react";
import { api, Json, Project } from "../api";
import { plural, useStudio } from "../state";

/* Products and runs. A product is one assembly; a variant is a product derived from another product's
   signed-off baseline. Every run says what it is: the first issue, a new issue (revision), a modification
   to units in service (SB / MOD / ECN), or the first issue of a variant. Files not chosen are carried over. */

const KINDS: { kind: "step" | "mbom" | "drawing"; label: string; accept: string; hint: string }[] = [
  { kind: "step", label: "3D model", accept: ".stp,.step", hint: "STEP AP203/AP214 assembly" },
  { kind: "mbom", label: "Parts list", accept: ".pdf,.xlsx,.xls,.xlsm,.csv", hint: "MBOM, APL or EBOM: Excel, CSV or PDF" },
  { kind: "drawing", label: "Drawing", accept: ".pdf", hint: "Assembly drawing PDF with torques and notes (optional)" },
];
type ChangeKind = "initial" | "revision" | "modification" | "variant";
const CHANGE: Record<ChangeKind, { label: string; hint: string }> = {
  initial: { label: "First issue", hint: "The first run of this product. Sign it off to make it the baseline." },
  revision: { label: "New issue", hint: "A new drawing, 3D model or parts list for this product. Compared with the baseline; unchanged steps keep their approved text, item numbers continue." },
  modification: { label: "Modification (SB / MOD)", hint: "A change applied to units in service. Compared with the baseline, with a modification procedure for the change. Give the bulletin's reference; attach it if you like." },
  variant: { label: "Variant", hint: "" },
};
export const changeLabel = (c: Json) => !c ? "" : c.kind === "modification" ? (c.reference ?? "Modification") : CHANGE[c.kind as ChangeKind]?.label ?? c.kind;

const fmtBytes = (n: number) => n > 1e6 ? `${(n / 1e6).toFixed(1)} MB` : `${Math.max(1, Math.round(n / 1e3))} kB`;

export function InputsView() {
  const { project, run, system, selectRun, toast } = useStudio();
  const rerun = async (stage: string) => {
    if (!run) return;
    try { await api.rerun(run.id, stage); await selectRun(run.id); } catch (e) { toast((e as Error).message, "bad"); }
  };
  const stages: { id: string; label: string }[] = system?.stages ?? [];

  if (!project) return <div className="view inputs"><NewProduct first /></div>;
  return (
    <div className="view inputs">
      <header className="product-head">
        <h1>{project.name}</h1>
        {project.parent && <p className="lede-s">Variant of <b>{project.parent.name}</b>, from its baseline {project.parent.label}. Runs are compared with it, and its approved procedure text is kept wherever nothing differs.</p>}
      </header>
      <NewRun project={project} />
      <NewProduct />

      {run && (
        <section className="stages">
          <h2>{run.label || run.id} <span className="sub">{run.change?.kind === "modification" ? (run.change.reference !== run.label ? `${run.change.reference}: ` : "") + (run.change.title ?? "Modification") : changeLabel(run.change)}</span></h2>
          {run.change?.reason && <p className="fine">Reason: {run.change.reason}</p>}
          {run.error && <p className="callout bad">{run.error}</p>}
          <ol className="stage-list">
            {stages.map((st) => {
              const r = run.stages?.[st.id];
              const active = run.progress?.stage === st.id && r?.status === "running";
              return (
                <li key={st.id} className={`stage ${r?.status ?? "pending"}`}>
                  <span className="stage-dot" aria-hidden />
                  <span className="stage-name">{st.label}</span>
                  <span className="stage-sum">{active ? run.progress.message : r?.status === "failed" ? r.error : summaryText(st.id, r?.summary)}</span>
                  <span className="stage-time">{r?.seconds != null ? `${r.seconds.toFixed(1)} s` : ""}</span>
                  {active && <span className="bar"><span style={{ width: `${Math.round((run.progress.fraction || 0) * 100)}%` }} /></span>}
                  {!run.signed_off && r && r.status !== "running" && !run.busy &&
                    <button className="link" onClick={() => rerun(st.id)} title="Run again from this stage">Run again</button>}
                </li>
              );
            })}
          </ol>
          <dl className="inputs-list">
            {Object.entries(run.inputs || {}).map(([k, v]) => (
              <div key={k}><dt>{KINDS.find((x) => x.kind === k)?.label ?? (k === "reference" ? "Bulletin" : k)}</dt>
                <dd><a href={`/api/runs/${run.id}/inputs/${k}`}>{v.file}</a> <span className="fine">{fmtBytes(v.bytes)}</span></dd></div>
            ))}
          </dl>
        </section>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function NewRun({ project }: { project: Project }) {
  const { selectProject, selectRun, toast } = useStudio();
  const isVariantStart = !!project.parent && project.runs.length === 0;
  // until a product has a baseline, runs are working runs of its first issue (a variant's are compared with its parent)
  const kinds: ChangeKind[] = project.baseline ? ["revision", "modification"] : project.parent ? ["variant"] : ["initial"];
  const [kind, setKind] = useState<ChangeKind>(kinds[0]);
  const k = kinds.includes(kind) ? kind : kinds[0];
  const [files, setFiles] = useState<Record<string, File | null>>({});
  const [refDoc, setRefDoc] = useState<File | null>(null);
  const [f, setF] = useState({ label: "", reference: "", title: "", reason: "" });
  const [sending, setSending] = useState(false);
  const prevInputs = (project.run_list?.[project.run_list.length - 1]?.inputs) ?? {};
  const inherited = isVariantStart ? `from ${project.parent!.name}` : "from the last run";
  const hasSource = project.runs.length > 0 || isVariantStart;
  const canStart = (hasSource || (files.step && files.mbom)) && (k !== "modification" || f.reference.trim());

  const start = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const fd = new FormData();
    Object.entries(files).forEach(([n, v]) => v && fd.append(n, v));
    if (refDoc && k === "modification") fd.append("reference_doc", refDoc);
    fd.append("change_kind", k);
    fd.append("label", f.label);
    if (k === "modification") { fd.append("reference", f.reference); fd.append("change_title", f.title); }
    fd.append("reason", f.reason);
    setSending(true);
    try {
      const r = await api.createRun(project.id, fd);
      setFiles({}); setRefDoc(null); setF({ label: "", reference: "", title: "", reason: "" });
      await selectProject(project.id); await selectRun(r.id);
      toast(`${r.label} started`);
    } catch (err) { toast((err as Error).message, "bad"); }
    finally { setSending(false); }
  };

  return (
    <form className="new-run" onSubmit={start}>
      {kinds.length > 1 && <div className="seg" role="radiogroup" aria-label="What is this run?">
        {kinds.map((x) => <button type="button" key={x} role="radio" aria-checked={k === x} className={k === x ? "on" : ""} onClick={() => setKind(x)}>{CHANGE[x].label}</button>)}
      </div>}
      <p className="fine change-hint">{k === "variant" ? (isVariantStart ? `The first issue of this variant. Choose only the files that differ from ${project.parent!.name} (for example its parts list or 3D model); the others are taken from its baseline.` :
        `Another run of this variant's first issue, compared with ${project.parent!.name}. Files you do not choose are kept from the last run. Sign off a run to make it this variant's baseline.`) :
        k === "initial" && project.runs.length ? "Another run of the first issue. Files you do not choose are kept from the last run. Sign off a run to make it the baseline." : CHANGE[k].hint}</p>
      <div className="drop-grid">
        {KINDS.map((x) => {
          const prev = isVariantStart ? null : prevInputs[x.kind];
          const file = files[x.kind];
          return (
            <label key={x.kind} className={`drop ${file ? "has" : ""}`}>
              <span className="drop-label">{x.label}</span>
              <span className="drop-file">{file ? `${file.name} · ${fmtBytes(file.size)}` : prev ? `Keep ${prev.file}` : hasSource ? `Keep the file ${inherited}` : x.hint}</span>
              <input type="file" accept={x.accept} onChange={(e) => setFiles((o) => ({ ...o, [x.kind]: e.target.files?.[0] ?? null }))} />
              <span className="drop-action">{file ? "Replace" : hasSource ? "Choose a new file" : "Choose file"}</span>
            </label>
          );
        })}
      </div>
      {k === "modification" && <div className="fields mod-fields">
        <label><span>Reference (required)</span><input value={f.reference} onChange={(e) => setF({ ...f, reference: e.target.value })} placeholder="SB 32-0042, MOD 1234, ECN …" /></label>
        <label className="wide2"><span>What the modification does</span><input value={f.title} onChange={(e) => setF({ ...f, title: e.target.value })} placeholder="Replace the plug screws with corrosion-resistant screws" /></label>
        <label className="file-field"><span>Bulletin document (optional)</span>
          <span className="btn file-btn">{refDoc ? refDoc.name : "Attach"}<input type="file" accept=".pdf,.docx,.doc,.xlsx,.txt,.xml,.zip" onChange={(e) => setRefDoc(e.target.files?.[0] ?? null)} /></span></label>
      </div>}
      <div className="drop-foot">
        <input aria-label="Run label" placeholder={k === "modification" ? "Label (default: the reference)" : "Label (default: Issue n)"} value={f.label} onChange={(e) => setF({ ...f, label: e.target.value })} />
        {k !== "initial" && <input aria-label="Reason for the change" placeholder="Reason for the change (optional)" value={f.reason} onChange={(e) => setF({ ...f, reason: e.target.value })} />}
        <button className="btn primary" disabled={!canStart || sending}>{sending ? "Uploading…" :
          k === "revision" ? "Start the new issue" : k === "modification" ? "Start the modification" : project.runs.length ? "Start a new run" : "Start the first run"}</button>
      </div>
    </form>
  );
}

function NewProduct({ first = false }: { first?: boolean }) {
  const { projects, refreshProjects, selectProject, toast } = useStudio();
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(first);
  const [name, setName] = useState("");
  const [parent, setParent] = useState("");
  const shipped = projects.filter((p) => p.baseline);
  if (!open) return <button className="link add-product" onClick={() => setOpen(true)}>Add a product or a variant</button>;
  const create = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    try {
      const p = await api.createProject(name.trim(), {}, parent || undefined);
      await refreshProjects(); await selectProject(p.id); setOpen(first); setName(""); setParent("");
      toast(parent ? "Variant created: start its first issue with the files that differ" : "Product created");
    } catch (err) { toast((err as Error).message, "bad"); }
  };
  return (
    <form className={first ? "lede" : "add-box new-product"} onSubmit={create}>
      {first ? <><h1>Start with a product</h1>
        <p>A product holds every issue of one assembly. Its first run, once signed off, is the baseline: later drawings, 3D models, parts lists and service bulletins are compared with it. A variant (a seat with a different cushion, a valve with another fitting) starts from a shipped product and records only what differs.</p></> :
        <h2>New product</h2>}
      <div className="fields">
        <label className="wide"><span>Name</span><input autoFocus={!first} value={name} onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)} placeholder={parent ? "For example: Pax seat 9G, leather cushion" : "For example: Brake selector valve D24907000"} /></label>
        <label className="wide"><span>Start from</span>
          <select value={parent} onChange={(e) => setParent(e.target.value)}>
            <option value="">Nothing: a new product</option>
            {shipped.map((p) => <option key={p.id} value={p.id}>Variant of {p.name} (baseline {p.run_list?.find((r) => r.id === p.baseline)?.label ?? p.last_run?.label ?? ""})</option>)}
          </select></label>
      </div>
      {parent && <p className="fine">The variant takes the parent's publication identity (with the next variant code), schema choices, parts-list mappings and wording rules. Its first run reuses the parent's files except the ones you replace.</p>}
      {!shipped.length && !first && <p className="fine">Variants start from a signed-off baseline; none exists yet.</p>}
      <div className="actions">
        <button className="btn primary" disabled={!name.trim()}>{parent ? "Create variant" : "Create product"}</button>
        {!first && <button type="button" className="link" onClick={() => setOpen(false)}>Cancel</button>}
      </div>
    </form>
  );
}

function summaryText(stage: string, s: Json): string {
  if (!s) return "";
  switch (stage) {
    case "convert": return `${s.occurrences} occurrences, ${s.products} distinct parts`;
    case "analyse": return `${s.contacts} contacts, ${s.steps} removal steps in ${s.layers} layers${s.conflicts ? `, ${s.conflicts} conflicts` : ""}`;
    case "reconcile": return `${s.parts_list_lines ? `${s.parts_list_lines} parts-list lines${s.parts_list_needs_review ? " (columns guessed: check the import)" : ""}; ` : ""}${s.matched} matched (${s.exact_matches} exact, ${s.fuzzy_matches} fuzzy)${s.unmatched_or_ambiguous_step ? `, ${plural(s.unmatched_or_ambiguous_step, "3D part")} unmatched` : ""}`;
    case "drawing": return `${s.torques} torques (${s.assigned} assigned), ${s.notes} notes`;
    case "ipl": return `${s.rows} rows, ${s.with_3d} in 3D, ${s.flagged} flagged${s.items_kept != null ? `; ${s.items_kept} item numbers kept, ${s.items_new} new, ${s.items_retired} retired` : ""}`;
    case "process": return `${s.disassembly_ops ?? 0} disassembly and ${s.assembly_ops ?? 0} assembly operations`;
    case "procedures": return `${s.disassembly?.steps ?? 0} disassembly and ${s.assembly?.steps ?? 0} assembly steps, ${(s.disassembly?.errors ?? 0) + (s.assembly?.errors ?? 0)} STE errors${(s.disassembly?.llm_steps ?? 0) + (s.assembly?.llm_steps ?? 0) ? `, ${(s.disassembly?.llm_steps ?? 0) + (s.assembly?.llm_steps ?? 0)} reworded by the LLM` : ""}`;
    case "revision": return s.changes != null ? `${plural(s.changes, "change")}, ${plural(s.affected_steps ?? 0, "step")} affected, ${s.kept_steps ?? 0} kept from the baseline` : "No baseline to compare with";
    case "check": return `${s.passed} of ${s.documents} documents pass${s.errors ? `, ${plural(s.errors, "error")}` : ""}${s.warnings ? `, ${plural(s.warnings, "warning")}` : ""}${s.not_validated ? `, ${s.not_validated} without an installed schema` : ""}`;
    default: return "";
  }
}

import { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { api, Json } from "../api";
import { plural, useArtifact, useStudio } from "../state";
import { Confidence } from "./Match";

/* The proposed IPL, row by row against the 3D model. Writers accept rows, correct fields, and link rows to
   3D occurrences by picking in the viewer. Edits go to the backend, which re-runs the stages downstream. */

const ROLES = ["part", "housing", "lru", "fastener", "washer", "nut", "insert", "lockwire", "seal", "backup_ring", "press_plug",
  "plate", "fitting", "cap", "spring", "bush", "closure", "moving", "marker", "process"];
const ROLE_LABEL: Record<string, string> = { lru: "Unit", backup_ring: "Backup ring", press_plug: "Press-fit plug", lockwire: "Lockwire / cable" };
const roleLabel = (r: string) => ROLE_LABEL[r] ?? r.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + r.slice(1).replace(/_/g, " ");

type Filter = "all" | "flagged" | "no3d" | "open";

export function IplView() {
  const { data: ipl } = useArtifact<Json>("ipl");
  const { run, setScene, pickHandler, editable, toast, touch } = useStudio();
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState<Filter>("all");
  const [selId, setSelId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [q, setQ] = useState("");
  const [picking, setPicking] = useState<Set<string> | null>(null);   // draft 3D link while picking
  const rowRefs = useRef<Record<string, HTMLTableRowElement | null>>({});

  const { data: model } = useArtifact<Json>("product_model");
  const parentOf = useMemo(() => new Map<string, string>((model?.occurrences ?? []).filter((o: Json) => o.parent).map((o: Json) => [o.occ_id, o.parent])), [model]);
  const rows: Json[] = ipl?.rows ?? [];
  const byOcc = useMemo(() => {
    const m = new Map<string, Json>();
    rows.forEach((r) => r.occ_ids?.forEach((o: string) => { if (!m.has(o)) m.set(o, r); }));
    return m;
  }, [rows]);
  const shown = rows.filter((r) => {
    if (filter === "flagged" && !r.flags?.length) return false;
    if (filter === "no3d" && r.occ_ids?.length) return false;
    if (filter === "open" && r.status === "accepted") return false;
    if (q) {
      const t = q.toLowerCase();
      return [r.part_number, r.nomenclature, r.item, r.step_name].some((x) => x && String(x).toLowerCase().includes(t));
    }
    return true;
  });
  const sel = rows.find((r) => r.id === selId) ?? null;

  // viewer: selected row in chromate; flagged rows rust; accepted green; other mapped parts neutral
  const tint = useMemo(() => {
    const m = new Map<string, string>();
    rows.forEach((r) => r.occ_ids?.forEach((o: string) =>
      m.set(o, r.flags?.length ? "#d39a77" : r.status === "accepted" || r.status === "edited" ? "#9cbdae" : "#aab3bd")));
    (ipl?.unmatched_3d ?? []).forEach((u: Json) => u.occ_ids?.forEach((o: string) => m.set(o, "#7f9fc0")));
    return m;
  }, [rows, ipl]);
  useEffect(() => {
    const chosen = picking ?? new Set<string>(sel?.occ_ids ?? []);
    // ghost the rest when a selected part sits inside the housing; never while picking (everything must stay clickable)
    setScene({ selected: chosen, tint, dim: !picking && chosen.size ? chosen : null, explode: undefined, hidden: undefined });
  }, [sel, tint, picking, setScene]);

  useEffect(() => {
    pickHandler.current = (id) => {
      if (picking) {
        if (!id) return;
        setPicking((p) => { const n = new Set(p); if (n.has(id)) n.delete(id); else n.add(id); return n; });
        return;
      }
      // a body or phase of a part (or a part inside a sub-assembly not in the list) selects the nearest listed parent
      let at: string | undefined = id ?? undefined;
      while (at && !byOcc.has(at)) at = parentOf.get(at);
      const r = at ? byOcc.get(at) : null;
      setSelId(r?.id ?? null);
      if (r) { setFilter("all"); setQ(""); setTimeout(() => rowRefs.current[r.id]?.scrollIntoView({ block: "nearest" }), 0); }
      else if (id) toast(`${id} is not in the parts list yet. Select a row and link it with “Pick in 3D”.`);
    };
    return () => { pickHandler.current = null; };
  }, [byOcc, parentOf, picking, pickHandler, toast]);

  // keyboard: up/down through the visible rows, A to accept
  const onKey = (e: React.KeyboardEvent) => {
    if ((e.target as HTMLElement).tagName === "INPUT" || (e.target as HTMLElement).tagName === "SELECT") return;
    const i = shown.findIndex((r) => r.id === selId);
    if (e.key === "ArrowDown" || e.key === "ArrowUp") {
      e.preventDefault();
      const n = shown[Math.max(0, Math.min(shown.length - 1, i + (e.key === "ArrowDown" ? 1 : -1)))];
      if (n) { setSelId(n.id); rowRefs.current[n.id]?.scrollIntoView({ block: "nearest" }); }
    } else if (e.key.toLowerCase() === "a" && sel && editable) { accept([sel.id]); }
  };

  const accept = async (ids: string[]) => {
    if (!run) return;
    try { const r = await api.acceptRows(run.id, ids); toast(ids.length ? "Row accepted" : `${plural(r.accepted, "row")} accepted`); touch(); }
    catch (e) { toast((e as Error).message, "bad"); }
  };
  const save = async (fields: Json) => {
    if (!run || !sel) return;
    try {
      const r = await api.editRow(run.id, sel.id, fields);
      toast(r.recompute ? "Saved. The procedures are being updated." : "Saved");
      touch();
    } catch (e) { toast((e as Error).message, "bad"); }
  };

  if (!ipl) return <div className="view"><p className="fine">Loading the parts list…</p></div>;
  const s = ipl.summary ?? {};
  const open = rows.filter((r) => r.status === "proposed").length;
  const flagged = rows.filter((r) => r.flags?.length).length;

  return (
    <div className="view ipl" onKeyDown={onKey}>
      <header className="view-head">
        <h1>Illustrated parts list <span className="sub">Figure {ipl.figure?.number} · {ipl.figure?.title}</span></h1>
        <p className="lede-s">{s.rows} rows, {s.with_3d} linked to the 3D model. Items are numbered in disassembly order, with attaching parts after the item they attach.
          {open ? ` ${plural(open, "row")} still to review.` : " Every row is reviewed."}</p>
        <div className="toolbar">
          <div className="seg" role="radiogroup" aria-label="Show">
            {([["all", `All ${rows.length}`], ["flagged", `Flagged ${flagged}`], ["no3d", "Not in 3D"], ["open", `To review ${open}`]] as const).map(([k, l]) =>
              <button key={k} role="radio" aria-checked={filter === k} className={filter === k ? "on" : ""} onClick={() => setFilter(k)}>{l}</button>)}
          </div>
          <input className="search" type="search" placeholder="Find part number or name" value={q} onChange={(e) => setQ(e.target.value)} aria-label="Find in the parts list" />
          {editable && <button className="btn" onClick={() => accept([])} disabled={!rows.some((r) => r.status === "proposed" && !r.flags?.length)}
            title="Accept every row that has no flags">Accept unflagged rows</button>}
        </div>
      </header>

      <div className="table-wrap" tabIndex={0} aria-label="Parts list rows">
        <table className="grid ipl-grid">
          <thead><tr>
            <th className="num">Item</th><th>Part number</th><th>Nomenclature</th><th className="num">Units</th>
            <th>Torque</th><th>Status</th>
          </tr></thead>
          <tbody>
            {shown.map((r) => (
              <tr key={r.id} ref={(el) => { rowRefs.current[r.id] = el; }}
                className={[r.id === selId && "sel", r.flags?.length && "flagged", r.attaching && "att", !r.occ_ids?.length && "no3d"].filter(Boolean).join(" ")}
                onClick={() => { setSelId(r.id === selId ? null : r.id); setPicking(null); }}>
                <td className="num item">{r.item}{r.effectivity && <span className="eff" title={`Effectivity ${r.effectivity}`}>{r.effectivity}</span>}</td>
                <td className="pn">{r.part_number}</td>
                <td className="nom" title={roleLabel(r.role)} style={{ paddingLeft: `${0.6 + Math.max(0, r.indent - 1) * 0.9}rem` }}>
                  {r.attaching && <span className="att-mark" title="Attaching part">Attaching</span>}
                  {r.nomenclature}
                  {!r.occ_ids?.length && r.depth > 0 && <span className="no3d-mark" title="Not linked to the 3D model">no 3D</span>}
                </td>
                <td className="num">{r.units_per_assy ?? "RF"}</td>
                <td className="torque">{r.torque ? `${fmt(r.torque.nominal_nm)} ± ${fmt(r.torque.tolerance_nm)} N.m` : ""}</td>
                <td className="status-cell"><StatusTag r={r} /> <Confidence v={r.confidence} /></td>
              </tr>
            ))}
            {!shown.length && <tr><td colSpan={6} className="empty-row">No rows match.</td></tr>}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>

      {sel && <RowDetail key={sel.id + (sel.status ?? "")} row={sel} rows={rows} editable={editable} picking={picking}
        onPick={() => setPicking(new Set(sel.occ_ids ?? []))}
        onPickDone={(keep) => { if (keep && picking) save({ occ_ids: [...picking] }); setPicking(null); }}
        onSave={save} onAccept={() => accept([sel.id])} onClose={() => setSelId(null)} />}
    </div>
  );
}

const fmt = (n: number | null | undefined) => n == null ? "" : String(Math.round(n * 100) / 100);

function StatusTag({ r }: { r: Json }) {
  if (r.status === "accepted") return <span className="tag ok">Accepted</span>;
  if (r.status === "edited") return <span className="tag ok">Edited</span>;
  if (r.flags?.length) return <span className="tag warn" title={r.flags.join("\n")}>{plural(r.flags.length, "flag")}</span>;
  return <span className="tag">Proposed</span>;
}

function RowDetail({ row, rows, editable, picking, onPick, onPickDone, onSave, onAccept, onClose }: {
  row: Json; rows: Json[]; editable: boolean; picking: Set<string> | null;
  onPick: () => void; onPickDone: (keep: boolean) => void; onSave: (f: Json) => void; onAccept: () => void; onClose: () => void;
}) {
  const [f, setF] = useState({
    item: row.item ?? "", nomenclature: row.nomenclature ?? "", units_per_assy: row.units_per_assy ?? "", effectivity: row.effectivity ?? "",
    role: row.role, nominal: row.torque?.nominal_nm ?? "", tol: row.torque?.tolerance_nm ?? "", notes: (row.notes ?? []).join("\n"),
  });
  const changed: Json = {};
  if (f.item !== (row.item ?? "")) changed.item = f.item;
  if (f.nomenclature !== (row.nomenclature ?? "")) changed.nomenclature = f.nomenclature;
  if (String(f.units_per_assy) !== String(row.units_per_assy ?? "")) changed.units_per_assy = f.units_per_assy === "" ? null : Number(f.units_per_assy);
  if (f.effectivity !== (row.effectivity ?? "")) changed.effectivity = f.effectivity || null;
  if (f.role !== row.role) changed.role = f.role;
  if (String(f.nominal) !== String(row.torque?.nominal_nm ?? "") || String(f.tol) !== String(row.torque?.tolerance_nm ?? "")) {
    const n = parseFloat(String(f.nominal).replace(",", ".")), t = parseFloat(String(f.tol).replace(",", ".")) || 0;
    changed.torque = isNaN(n) ? null : { nominal_nm: n, tolerance_nm: t, min_nm: +(n - t).toFixed(2), max_nm: +(n + t).toFixed(2), evidence: [{ text: "entered by the writer" }], confidence: 1 };
  }
  if (f.notes !== (row.notes ?? []).join("\n")) changed.notes = f.notes.split("\n").map((x: string) => x.trim()).filter(Boolean);
  const dirty = Object.keys(changed).length > 0;
  const parent = rows.find((r) => r.id === row.parent_row);
  const att = rows.find((r) => r.id === row.attaching_for);
  const set = (k: keyof typeof f) => (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement | HTMLSelectElement | HTMLTextAreaElement>) => setF({ ...f, [k]: e.target.value });

  return (
    <aside className="detail row-detail" aria-label={`Row ${row.item}`}>
      <div className="detail-head">
        <h3><span className="item-no">{row.item}</span> <span className="pn">{row.part_number}</span> {row.nomenclature}</h3>
        <button className="link" onClick={onClose} aria-label="Close">Close</button>
      </div>
      {row.flags?.map((x: string, i: number) => <p key={i} className="flag">{x}</p>)}
      <div className="detail-cols">
        <fieldset disabled={!editable}>
          <div className="fields">
            <label><span>Item</span><input value={f.item} onChange={set("item")} /></label>
            <label className="wide"><span>Nomenclature</span><input value={f.nomenclature} onChange={set("nomenclature")} /></label>
            <label><span>Units per assy</span><input inputMode="numeric" value={f.units_per_assy} onChange={set("units_per_assy")} /></label>
            <label><span>Effectivity</span><input value={f.effectivity} onChange={set("effectivity")} placeholder="—" /></label>
            <label><span>Role</span><select value={f.role} onChange={set("role")}>{ROLES.map((r) => <option key={r} value={r}>{roleLabel(r)}</option>)}</select></label>
            <label><span>Torque, N.m</span><span className="pair"><input inputMode="decimal" value={f.nominal} onChange={set("nominal")} placeholder="nominal" aria-label="Nominal torque" />±<input inputMode="decimal" value={f.tol} onChange={set("tol")} placeholder="tol." aria-label="Torque tolerance" /></span></label>
            <label className="wide"><span>Notes for the procedure</span><textarea rows={2} value={f.notes} onChange={set("notes")} /></label>
          </div>
          <div className="actions">
            <button className="btn primary" disabled={!dirty} onClick={() => onSave(changed)}>Save changes</button>
            {row.status === "proposed" && <button className="btn" disabled={dirty} onClick={onAccept} title="Accept this row as proposed (A)">Accept row</button>}
            {!picking ? <button className="btn quiet" onClick={onPick} title="Choose the 3D parts for this row by clicking them in the model">Pick in 3D</button> :
              <span className="picking">Click parts in the model: {plural(picking.size, "part")} chosen.
                <button className="btn primary" onClick={() => onPickDone(true)}>Link these parts</button>
                <button className="link" onClick={() => onPickDone(false)}>Cancel</button></span>}
          </div>
        </fieldset>
        <dl className="facts">
          <dt>3D</dt><dd>{row.occ_ids?.length ? plural(row.occ_ids.length, "occurrence") : "Not linked"}{row.step_name ? ` · ${row.step_name}` : ""}</dd>
          {row.step_description && <><dt>3D description</dt><dd>{row.step_description}</dd></>}
          {parent && <><dt>Next higher</dt><dd>{parent.item} {parent.nomenclature}</dd></>}
          {att && <><dt>Attaches</dt><dd>{att.item} {att.nomenclature}</dd></>}
          {row.alternate_of && <><dt>Alternate of</dt><dd>{rows.find((r) => r.id === row.alternate_of)?.item ?? row.alternate_of}</dd></>}
          {row.disassembly_step && <><dt>Removed at</dt><dd>Step {row.disassembly_step} of the sequence</dd></>}
          {row.torque?.evidence?.length > 0 && <><dt>Torque from</dt><dd>{row.torque.evidence.map((e: Json) => e.page ? `drawing p.${e.page}: ${e.text}` : e.text).join("; ")}</dd></>}
          {row.mbom_comments && <><dt>Parts-list remark</dt><dd>{row.mbom_comments}</dd></>}
          {row.processes?.length > 0 && <><dt>Processes</dt><dd className="procs">{row.processes.map((x: Json, i: number) =>
            <span key={i}><b>{typeof x === "string" ? x : x.spec}</b>{typeof x === "object" && x.description ? ` ${x.description.toLowerCase()}` : ""}</span>)}</dd></>}
          <dt>Sources</dt><dd className="sources">{Object.entries(row.sources ?? {}).map(([k, v]) => <span key={k}><b>{k.replace(/_/g, " ")}</b> {String(v)}</span>)}</dd>
          <dt>Role from</dt><dd className="fine rule-text">{row.role_rule}</dd>
        </dl>
      </div>
    </aside>
  );
}

FILE: frontend\src\views\Match.tsx

import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { Json } from "../api";
import { occsForPn, useArtifact, useStudio } from "../state";
import { PartsImport } from "./PartsImport";

/* 3D <-> MBOM reconciliation: what the stp2glb reconciler matched, how sure it is, and what is left over. */

const STATUS: Record<string, { label: string; cls: string }> = {
  matched: { label: "Exact", cls: "ok" },
  exact_match: { label: "Exact", cls: "ok" },
  normalized_match: { label: "Normalised", cls: "ok" },
  fuzzy_candidate: { label: "Fuzzy", cls: "warn" },
  supersession_match: { label: "Superseded", cls: "info" },
  variant_match: { label: "Variant", cls: "info" },
  fuzzy_match: { label: "Fuzzy", cls: "warn" },
  translated_candidate: { label: "Translated", cls: "warn" },
  ambiguous: { label: "Ambiguous", cls: "warn" },
  unmatched: { label: "No match", cls: "bad" },
};

export function MatchView() {
  const { data: rec } = useArtifact<Json>("reconciliation");
  const { setScene, nodes, pickHandler, run } = useStudio();
  const review = !!run?.stages?.reconcile?.summary?.parts_list_needs_review;
  const [tab, setTab] = useState<"matched" | "unmatched_step" | "unmatched_mbom" | "import">(review ? "import" : "matched");
  const [sel, setSel] = useState<number | null>(null);

  const rows: Json[] = tab === "import" ? [] : rec?.[tab] ?? [];
  const tint = useMemo(() => {
    const m = new Map<string, string>();
    for (const r of rec?.matched ?? []) for (const o of occsForPn(nodes, r.step_part_number)) m.set(o, (STATUS[r.status]?.cls ?? "ok") === "ok" ? "#8fb5a3" : "#d9a283");
    for (const r of rec?.unmatched_step ?? []) for (const o of occsForPn(nodes, r.step_part_number)) m.set(o, "#c46a3a");
    return m;
  }, [rec, nodes]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const r = sel != null ? rows[sel] : null;
    setScene({ selected: new Set(r ? occsForPn(nodes, r.step_part_number) : []), tint, dim: null, explode: undefined, hidden: undefined });
  }, [sel, rows, nodes, tint, setScene]);

  useEffect(() => {
    pickHandler.current = (id) => {
      if (!id) { setSel(null); return; }
      for (const t of ["matched", "unmatched_step"] as const) {
        const i = (rec?.[t] ?? []).findIndex((r: Json) => occsForPn(nodes, r.step_part_number).includes(id));
        if (i >= 0) { setTab(t); setSel(i); return; }
      }
    };
    return () => { pickHandler.current = null; };
  }, [rec, nodes, pickHandler]);

  if (!rec) {
    const failed = run?.stages?.reconcile?.status === "failed";
    return (
      <div className="view match">
        <header className="view-head"><h1>Match 3D to parts list</h1>
          {failed ? <p className="callout bad">{run?.stages?.reconcile?.error}</p> : <p className="fine">The parts list is matched after the 3D conversion.</p>}</header>
        {failed && <PartsImport />}
      </div>
    );
  }
  const s = rec.summary ?? {};
  const cur = sel != null ? rows[sel] : null;

  return (
    <div className="view match">
      <header className="view-head">
        <h1>Match 3D to parts list</h1>
        <p className="lede-s">{s.matched} of {s.matched + (s.unmatched_or_ambiguous_step ?? 0)} distinct 3D parts matched to the parts list. {s.unmatched_mbom_lines} parts-list lines have no 3D part; most are processes, specifications and items not modelled.</p>
        <div className="legend"><span className="sw" style={{ background: "#8fb5a3" }} />Matched <span className="sw" style={{ background: "#d9a283" }} />Matched, check <span className="sw" style={{ background: "#c46a3a" }} />Not matched</div>
      </header>
      <div className="tabs" role="tablist">
        {([["matched", `Matched (${rec.matched.length})`], ["unmatched_step", `3D only (${rec.unmatched_step.length})`], ["unmatched_mbom", `Parts list only (${rec.unmatched_mbom.length})`], ["import", review ? "Parts list import · check" : "Parts list import"]] as const).map(([k, l]) =>
          <button key={k} role="tab" aria-selected={tab === k} className={tab === k ? "on" : ""} onClick={() => { setTab(k); setSel(null); }}>{l}</button>)}
      </div>
      {tab === "import" ? <PartsImport /> : <div className="table-wrap">
        <table className="grid">
          <thead>{tab === "unmatched_mbom" ?
            <tr><th>Level</th><th>Part number</th><th>Description</th><th className="num">Qty</th><th>CAGE</th></tr> :
            <tr><th>3D part</th><th>3D name</th><th>Parts-list match</th><th>How</th><th className="num">Score</th><th className="num">Qty</th></tr>}
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            {rows.map((r: Json, i: number) => tab === "unmatched_mbom" ? (
              <tr key={i}><td>{r.level}</td><td className="pn">{r.part_number}</td><td>{r.description}</td><td className="num">{r.qty}</td><td>{r.manuf_code}</td></tr>
            ) : (
              <tr key={i} className={sel === i ? "sel" : ""} onClick={() => setSel(sel === i ? null : i)} tabIndex={0}
                onKeyDown={(e) => e.key === "Enter" && setSel(i)}>
                <td className="pn">{r.step_part_number}</td>
                <td>{r.step_name}</td>
                <td>{r.mbom_part_number ? <><span className="pn">{r.mbom_part_number}</span> <span className="fine">{r.mbom_description}</span></> : "—"}</td>
                <td><span className={`tag ${STATUS[r.status]?.cls ?? ""}`}>{STATUS[r.status]?.label ?? r.status}</span></td>
                <td className="num"><Confidence v={r.confidence} /></td>
                <td className="num">{r.step_qty}{r.mbom_qty != null && r.mbom_qty !== r.step_qty ? <span className="warn-t"> / {r.mbom_qty}</span> : ""}</td>
              </tr>
            ))}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>}
      {cur && tab !== "unmatched_mbom" && tab !== "import" && (
        <aside className="detail">
          <h3><span className="pn">{cur.step_part_number}</span> {cur.step_name}</h3>
          {(cur.flags ?? []).map((f: string, i: number) => <p key={i} className="flag">{f}</p>)}
          {cur.candidates?.length > 0 && <>
            <h4>Other candidates</h4>
            <ul className="plain">{cur.candidates.slice(0, 5).map((c: Json, i: number) =>
              <li key={i}><span className="pn">{c.part_number ?? c.mbom_part_number}</span> {c.description ?? c.mbom_description} <Confidence v={c.score ?? c.confidence} /></li>)}</ul>
          </>}
          <p className="fine">Change a match in the parts list: open the row in Illustrated parts list and set its 3D occurrences.</p>
        </aside>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

export function Confidence({ v }: { v: number | null | undefined }) {
  if (v == null) return <span className="fine">—</span>;
  const pct = Math.round(v * 100);
  return <span className={`conf ${v >= 0.85 ? "hi" : v >= 0.6 ? "mid" : "lo"}`} title={`${pct}% confidence`}><span className="conf-bar" style={{ width: `${pct}%` }} />{pct}%</span>;
}

import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { api, Json } from "../api";
import { useStudio } from "../state";

/* How the parts list file was read: which table, which column is which field, and how sure the reading is.
   The writer corrects it here; the mapping is kept for this product and this file layout. */

const FIELDS: [string, string, boolean][] = [
  ["part_number", "Part number", true], ["description", "Description", true], ["qty", "Quantity", true],
  ["level", "Level / indenture", false], ["manuf_code", "CAGE / manufacturer", false], ["unit_measure", "Unit", false],
  ["find_number", "Find / item number", false], ["seq_number", "Sequence number", false], ["equiv", "Equivalence (J/K)", false],
  ["comments", "Remarks", false], ["cad_reference", "3D / CAD reference", false], ["material_spec", "Material", false],
];
const clean = (h: string | null | undefined) => (h ?? "").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();

export function PartsImport() {
  const { run, editable, toast, touch } = useStudio();
  const [imp, setImp] = useState<Json | null>(null);
  const [table, setTable] = useState("");
  const [cols, setCols] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!run) return;
    api.partsImport(run.id).then((d) => {
      setImp(d);
      setTable(d.mapping?.table ?? d.chosen ?? "");
      setCols({ ...(d.mapping?.columns ?? {}) });
    }).catch((e) => toast(e.message, "bad"));
  }, [run?.id, run?.stages?.reconcile?.status]); // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps

  const t: Json = useMemo(() => {
    if (!imp) return null;
    if (table === "pdf:*") return imp.tables.find((x: Json) => x.id.startsWith("pdf:")) ?? null;
    return imp.tables.find((x: Json) => x.id === table) ?? null;
  }, [imp, table]);
  const headers: string[] = (t?.headers ?? []).filter((h: string) => clean(h));
  const how = (f: string) => {
    const m = t?.mapping?.[f];
    if (!cols[f]) return "missing";
    return m && clean(m.header) === clean(cols[f]) ? m.how : "set by you";
  };

  if (!imp) return <p className="fine">Reading the parts list…</p>;
  const save = async () => {
    if (!run) return;
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      const r = await api.confirmPartsImport(run.id, table, cols);
      toast(`${r.rows} parts-list lines read. Matching again…`);
      touch();
    } catch (e) { toast((e as Error).message, "bad"); }
    finally { setBusy(false); }
  };
  const idx = (h: string) => (t?.headers ?? []).findIndex((x: string) => clean(x) === clean(h));
  const shown = FIELDS.filter(([f]) => cols[f]);

  return (
    <section className="parts-import">
      <p className="lede-s">
        <b>{imp.file}</b>: {imp.rows ? `${imp.rows} lines read` : "not read yet"}, {imp.source === "confirmed" ? "with the column mapping you confirmed for this layout." : "with the columns Studio proposed."}
      </p>
      {imp.problems?.length > 0 && <div className={`callout ${imp.needs_review ? "warn" : "info"}`}>
        <b>{imp.needs_review ? "Check the columns before relying on the matching:" : "Notes"}</b>
        <ul>{imp.problems.map((p: string, i: number) => <li key={i}>{p}</li>)}</ul></div>}
      <div className="fields">
        <label className="wide"><span>Table</span>
          <select value={table} onChange={(e) => { setTable(e.target.value); const nt = imp.tables.find((x: Json) => x.id === e.target.value);
            if (nt) setCols(Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(nt.mapping).map(([f, m]: [string, Json]) => [f, m.header]))); }} disabled={!editable}>
            {imp.tables.some((x: Json) => x.id.startsWith("pdf:")) && <option value="pdf:*">Every page with this layout (PDF)</option>}
            {imp.tables.map((x: Json) => <option key={x.id} value={x.id}>{x.label} · {x.rows} lines</option>)}
          </select></label>
      </div>
      <table className="grid compact static map-grid">
        <thead><tr><th>Field</th><th>Column in the file</th><th>How it was found</th></tr></thead>
        <tbody>{FIELDS.map(([f, label, req]) => (
          <tr key={f}>
            <td>{label}{req && <span className="fine"> · required</span>}</td>
            <td><select value={cols[f] ?? ""} disabled={!editable} onChange={(e) => setCols({ ...cols, [f]: e.target.value })}>
              <option value="">Not in this file</option>
              {headers.map((h, i) => <option key={i} value={h}>{clean(h)}</option>)}
            </select></td>
            <td><span className={`tag ${how(f) === "exact" ? "ok" : how(f) === "missing" ? (req ? "bad" : "") : how(f) === "set by you" ? "info" : "warn"}`}>
              {how(f) === "exact" ? "known header" : how(f) === "guessed" ? `guessed${t?.mapping?.[f]?.why ? `: ${t.mapping[f].why}` : ""}` : how(f) === "missing" ? "not found" : "set by you"}</span></td>
          </tr>))}</tbody>
      </table>
      {t && shown.length > 0 && <>
        <h3>First lines, as they will be read</h3>
        <div className="table-wrap"><table className="grid compact static">
          <thead><tr>{shown.map(([f, l]) => <th key={f}>{l}</th>)}</tr></thead>
          <tbody>{(t.sample ?? []).map((row: string[], i: number) => <tr key={i}>{shown.map(([f]) => <td key={f}>{row[idx(cols[f])] ?? ""}</td>)}</tr>)}</tbody>
        </table></div>
      </>}
      {editable && <div className="actions">
        <button className="btn primary" disabled={busy || !cols.part_number} onClick={save}>{busy ? "Reading…" : "Use this mapping and match again"}</button>
        <span className="fine">Kept for this product: the next file with the same columns is read the same way.</span>
      </div>}
    </section>
  );
}

FILE: frontend\src\views\Procedures.tsx

import { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { api, Json } from "../api";
import { plural, useArtifact, useStudio } from "../state";

/* STE procedures generated from the process graph. Each step names the IPL items it acts on, so selecting a
   step shows those parts. Writers can rewrite a step; the STE checker and the fact check run on every save. */

type Kind = "disassembly" | "assembly" | "modification";

export function ProceduresView() {
  const { run, procKind, setProcKind, system, editable, toast, selectRun } = useStudio();
  const llmOn = !!system?.llm?.available;
  const reword = async () => {
    if (!run) return;
    try { await api.rerun(run.id, "procedures"); await selectRun(run.id); toast(`Rewording with ${system.llm.provider}${system.llm.model ? ` (${system.llm.model})` : ""}; every step is checked again.`); }
    catch (e) { toast((e as Error).message, "bad"); }
  };
  const hasMod = run?.stages?.revision?.status === "done" && !!run?.base_run && (run?.stages?.revision?.summary?.changes ?? 0) > 0;
  const kind = procKind as Kind, setKind = setProcKind;
  useEffect(() => { if (kind === "modification" && !hasMod) setKind("disassembly"); }, [hasMod, kind]);
  const { data: proc } = useArtifact<Json>(`procedure_${kind}`);
  const { data: ipl } = useArtifact<Json>("ipl");
  const llm = run?.stages?.procedures?.summary?.[kind]?.llm_steps;
  // count from the steps themselves so writer edits show up at once
  const all: Json[] = proc?.subtasks?.flatMap((st: Json) => st.steps) ?? [];
  const iss: Json[] = all.flatMap((x) => x.issues ?? []);
  const nErr = iss.filter((i) => i.severity === "error").length, nWarn = iss.length - nErr;

  return (
    <div className="view procedures">
      <header className="view-head">
        <h1>{proc?.title ?? "Procedures"}</h1>
        <div className="tabs" role="tablist">
          {(["disassembly", "assembly", ...(hasMod ? ["modification"] : [])] as Kind[]).map((k) =>
            <button key={k} role="tab" aria-selected={kind === k} className={kind === k ? "on" : ""} onClick={() => setKind(k)}>
              {k === "disassembly" ? "Disassembly" : k === "assembly" ? "Assembly" : run?.change?.kind === "variant" ? "Conversion" : "Modification"}</button>)}
          {llmOn && editable && kind !== "modification" && <button className="btn quiet tab-btn" onClick={reword} title="Generate the steps again and let the language model improve the wording">Reword with the language model</button>}
        </div>
        {proc && <p className="lede-s">
          {plural(all.length, "step")} in {plural(proc.subtasks?.length ?? 0, "subtask")}.{" "}
          {iss.length === 0 ? "No STE issues." : `${plural(nErr, "STE error")}, ${plural(nWarn, "STE warning")}.`}
          {" "}{llm ? `${llm} steps reworded by the LLM and checked.` : "Written from templates."}
          {kind === "modification" && " This procedure covers only what the change touches."}
        </p>}
      </header>
      {!proc ? <p className="fine">Loading…</p> : <ProcBody proc={proc} ipl={ipl} kind={kind} />}
    </div>
  );
}

function ProcBody({ proc, ipl, kind }: { proc: Json; ipl: Json; kind: Kind }) {
  const { run, setScene, pickHandler, editable, toast, touch } = useStudio();
  const [sel, setSel] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const rowOcc = useMemo(() => new Map<string, string[]>((ipl?.rows ?? []).map((r: Json) => [r.id, r.occ_ids ?? []])), [ipl]);
  const allSteps: Json[] = useMemo(() => proc.subtasks.flatMap((st: Json) => st.steps), [proc]);
  const occOf = (s: Json): string[] => s.occ_ids?.length ? s.occ_ids : (s.rows ?? []).flatMap((r: string) => rowOcc.get(r) ?? []);

  useEffect(() => {
    const s = allSteps.find((x) => x.id === sel);
    const occ = s ? occOf(s) : [];
    setScene({ selected: new Set(occ), dim: occ.length ? new Set(occ) : null, tint: undefined, explode: undefined, hidden: undefined });
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [sel, allSteps, rowOcc, setScene]);
  useEffect(() => () => setScene({ dim: null }), [setScene]);

  useEffect(() => {
    pickHandler.current = (id) => {
      if (!id) { setSel(null); return; }
      const s = allSteps.find((x) => occOf(x).includes(id));
      if (s) { setSel(s.id); document.getElementById(`step-${s.id}`)?.scrollIntoView({ block: "nearest", behavior: "smooth" }); }
    };
    return () => { pickHandler.current = null; };
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [allSteps, rowOcc, pickHandler]);

  const save = async (s: Json, text: string) => {
    if (!run) return;
    try {
      const r = await api.editStep(run.id, kind, s.id, text);
      setEditing(null);
      toast(r.issues?.length ? `Saved with ${plural(r.issues.length, "issue")} to check` : "Saved. No STE issues.", r.issues?.some((i: Json) => i.severity === "error") ? "bad" : "ok");
      touch();
    } catch (e) { toast((e as Error).message, "bad"); }
  };

  const pre = proc.preliminary ?? {};
  const safety: Record<string, Json> = proc.safety ?? {};
  let n = 0;
  return (
    <div className="proc">
      {kind === "modification" && proc.changes?.length > 0 && <div className="callout info"><b>Changes covered</b><ul>{proc.changes.map((c: string, i: number) => <li key={i}>{c}</li>)}</ul></div>}
      <section className="prelim">
        <PreList title="Support equipment" items={(pre.support_equipment ?? []).map((x: Json) => x.name)} empty="None" />
        <PreList title="Supplies" items={(pre.supplies ?? []).map((x: Json) => x.name)} empty="None" />
        <PreList title="Spares" items={(pre.spares ?? []).map((x: Json) => `${x.qty} × ${x.name} (${x.item}) ${x.part_number}`)} empty="None" />
        {(proc.common_info ?? []).length > 0 && <PreList title="General" items={proc.common_info} empty="" />}
      </section>
      {(pre.warnings ?? []).map((w: string) => safety[w] && <Safety key={w} s={safety[w]} />)}

      {proc.subtasks.map((st: Json) => (
        <section key={st.id} className="subtask">
          <h2>{st.title}</h2>
          {[...(st.warnings ?? []), ...(st.cautions ?? [])].map((w: string) => safety[w] && <Safety key={w} s={safety[w]} />)}
          <ol className="steps">
            {st.steps.map((s: Json) => {
              n += 1;
              const issues: Json[] = s.issues ?? [];
              const isSel = sel === s.id;
              return (
                <li key={s.id} id={`step-${s.id}`} className={["step", isSel && "sel", issues.some((i) => i.severity === "error") && "err", s.revision && s.revision !== "unchanged" && "rev"].filter(Boolean).join(" ")}
                  onClick={() => setSel(isSel ? null : s.id)}>
                  <span className="step-no">{n}</span>
                  <div className="step-body">
                    {editing === s.id ? <StepEditor text={s.text} onSave={(t) => save(s, t)} onCancel={() => setEditing(null)} /> :
                      <p className="step-text">{s.text}</p>}
                    <div className="step-meta">
                      {s.revision && s.revision !== "unchanged" && <span className="tag info">{s.revision === "changed" ? "Changed from baseline" : s.revision === "new" ? "New in this revision" : s.revision}</span>}
                      {s.origin === "writer" && <span className="tag">Edited by writer</span>}
                      {s.origin === "llm" && <span className="tag">Reworded by LLM</span>}
                      {!occOf(s).length && !(s.flags ?? []).length && <span className="fine">Not shown in 3D</span>}
                      {editable && kind !== "modification" && editing !== s.id &&
                        <button className="link" onClick={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); setEditing(s.id); }}>Edit</button>}
                    </div>
                    {issues.map((i, k) => <p key={k} className={`issue ${i.severity}`}><b>{i.rule}</b> {i.message}</p>)}
                    {(s.flags ?? []).map((f: string, k: number) => <p key={k} className="flag">{f}</p>)}
                  </div>
                </li>
              );
            })}
          </ol>
        </section>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

function StepEditor({ text, onSave, onCancel }: { text: string; onSave: (t: string) => void; onCancel: () => void }) {
  const [t, setT] = useState(text);
  const ref = useRef<HTMLTextAreaElement>(null);
  useEffect(() => { ref.current?.focus(); }, []);
  const words = t.trim().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean).length;
  return (
    <div className="step-editor" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
      <textarea ref={ref} value={t} rows={2} onChange={(e) => setT(e.target.value)}
        onKeyDown={(e) => { if (e.key === "Enter" && (e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey)) onSave(t); if (e.key === "Escape") onCancel(); }} />
      <div className="actions">
        <span className={`fine ${words > 20 ? "warn-t" : ""}`}>{words} words{words > 20 ? ": STE allows 20 in an instruction" : ""}</span>
        <button className="btn primary" disabled={!t.trim() || t === text} onClick={() => onSave(t)}>Save and check</button>
        <button className="link" onClick={onCancel}>Cancel</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function PreList({ title, items, empty }: { title: string; items: string[]; empty: string }) {
  return <div className="pre"><h3>{title}</h3>{items.length ? <ul>{items.map((x, i) => <li key={i}>{x}</li>)}</ul> : <p className="fine">{empty}</p>}</div>;
}

function Safety({ s }: { s: Json }) {
  return (
    <div className={`safety ${s.kind}`} title={(s.evidence ?? []).join("\n")}>
      <b>{s.kind === "warning" ? "WARNING" : "CAUTION"}</b>
      <p>{s.text}</p>
    </div>
  );
}

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { api, Json } from "../api";
import { plural, useStudio } from "../state";

/* Publishing: pick the outputs and where they go, set the publication identity once per product.
   S1000D and ATA documents are checked again first; documents with errors are held back unless the
   writer publishes them anyway, and the check result travels with every published file. */

// defaults the backend uses when a field is empty (publish/config.py PublicationConfig)
const DEFAULTS: Record<string, string> = { model_ident_code: "TECHPUB", system_diff_code: "A", system_code: "32", sub_system_code: "4",
  sub_sub_system_code: "2", assy_code: "11", disassy_code: "00", issue_number: "001", in_work: "01", ata_chapter: "32", ata_section: "42",
  ata_subject: "11", cmm_doc_number: "top part number", enterprise_code: "CAGE of the top part", brex_dmc: "S1000D-G-04-10-0301-00A-022A-D" };
const ID_FIELDS: { k: string; label: string; group: "s1000d" | "ata" | "both"; w?: number }[] = [
  { k: "model_ident_code", label: "Model ident code", group: "s1000d", w: 2 },
  { k: "system_diff_code", label: "System diff.", group: "s1000d" },
  { k: "system_code", label: "System", group: "s1000d" },
  { k: "sub_system_code", label: "Sub-system", group: "s1000d" },
  { k: "sub_sub_system_code", label: "Sub-sub-system", group: "s1000d" },
  { k: "assy_code", label: "Assembly", group: "s1000d" },
  { k: "disassy_code", label: "Disassembly", group: "s1000d" },
  { k: "issue_number", label: "Issue", group: "s1000d" },
  { k: "in_work", label: "In work", group: "s1000d" },
  { k: "brex_dmc", label: "BREX data module code (the BREX the data modules name)", group: "s1000d", w: 4 },
  { k: "ata_chapter", label: "ATA chapter", group: "ata" },
  { k: "ata_section", label: "Section", group: "ata" },
  { k: "ata_subject", label: "Subject", group: "ata" },
  { k: "cmm_doc_number", label: "CMM number", group: "ata", w: 2 },
  { k: "enterprise_code", label: "CAGE / enterprise code", group: "both" },
  { k: "enterprise_name", label: "Enterprise name", group: "both", w: 2 },
];

export function PublishView() {
  const { run, project, system, toast, selectProject, setView, touch } = useStudio();
  const targets: Record<string, string> = system?.targets ?? {};
  const conns: Json[] = system?.connectors_status ?? [];
  const [connector, setConnector] = useState<string>("");
  const [chosen, setChosen] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set(["s1000d", "ata"]));
  const [ident, setIdent] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [history, setHistory] = useState<Json[]>([]);
  const [blocked, setBlocked] = useState<string | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => { if (!connector && conns.length) setConnector((conns.find((c) => c.available) ?? conns[0]).name); }, [conns, connector]);
  useEffect(() => { setIdent({ ...(project?.settings?.publication ?? {}) }); }, [project]);
  const loadHistory = () => run && api.publications(run.id).then(setHistory).catch(() => setHistory([]));
  // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  useEffect(() => { loadHistory(); }, [run?.id]);

  if (!run || !project) return null;
  const conn = conns.find((c) => c.name === connector);
  const ready = run.status === "done";
  const chk = run.stages?.check?.summary;

  const saveIdent = async () => {
    try {
      await api.saveSettings(project.id, { publication: ident });
      await selectProject(project.id);
      if (!run.busy) await api.checkAgain(run.id).catch(() => undefined);
      touch();
      toast("Publication identity saved; documents checked again");
    } catch (e) { toast((e as Error).message, "bad"); }
  };
  const publish = async (allowErrors = false) => {
    setBusy(true); setBlocked(null);
    try {
      await api.saveSettings(project.id, { publication: ident });
      const r = await api.publish(run.id, { connector, targets: [...chosen], publication: ident, allow_errors: allowErrors });
      const docs: Json[] = r.documents ?? [];
      toast(r.published_with_errors ? `Published ${plural(docs.length, "file")}, with validation errors recorded` : `Published ${plural(docs.length, "file")}`,
        r.published_with_errors ? "bad" : "ok");
      loadHistory(); touch();
    } catch (e) {
      const err = e as Error & { status?: number };
      if (err.status === 409) setBlocked(err.message);
      else toast(`Not published: ${err.message}`, "bad");
    } finally { setBusy(false); }
  };

  return (
    <div className="view publish">
      <header className="view-head">
        <h1>Publish</h1>
        <p className="lede-s">{run.signed_off ? "This run is the signed-off baseline." : "You can publish a working run for review; sign it off to make it the baseline."} S1000D and ATA documents are checked again just before they leave, and what was checked is exactly what is published.</p>
        {chk && <p className={chk.errors ? "callout bad" : "callout info"}>
          Last check: {chk.passed} of {plural(chk.documents, "document")} pass{chk.errors ? `, ${plural(chk.errors, "error")}` : ""}{chk.warnings ? `, ${plural(chk.warnings, "warning")}` : ""}.
          <button className="link" onClick={() => setView("check")}>See the check</button></p>}
      </header>

      <div className="pub-grid">
        <section className="pub-block">
          <h2>Outputs</h2>
          {Object.entries(targets).map(([k, label]) => (
            <label key={k} className="check">
              <input type="checkbox" checked={chosen.has(k)} onChange={(e) => { const n = new Set(chosen); if (e.target.checked) n.add(k); else n.delete(k); setChosen(n); }} />
              <span>{label}{k !== "techpub" && <span className="fine"> · validated</span>}</span>
              <span className="check-actions"><a href={api.exportUrl(run.id, k)} className="link">Download</a></span>
            </label>
          ))}
        </section>

        <section className="pub-block">
          <h2>Destination</h2>
          {conns.map((c) => (
            <label key={c.name} className={`check dest ${c.available ? "" : "off"}`}>
              <input type="radio" name="conn" checked={connector === c.name} onChange={() => setConnector(c.name)} />
              <span><b>{c.name === "folder" ? "Folder" : c.name}</b> <span className="fine">{c.path ?? c.url ?? c.error ?? ""}</span></span>
            </label>
          ))}
          <p className="fine">Other destinations (PLM, CMS, document control) are added in studio.yaml without changing Studio.</p>
          {blocked && <div className="callout bad">{blocked}
            <button className="btn" onClick={() => setView("check")}>See the problems</button>
            <button className="btn quiet" onClick={() => publish(true)}>Publish anyway</button></div>}
          <button className="btn primary big" disabled={!ready || busy || !chosen.size || !conn?.available} onClick={() => publish(false)}>
            {busy ? "Checking and publishing…" : `Publish to ${connector === "folder" ? "the folder" : connector}`}</button>
        </section>

        <section className="pub-block ident">
          <h2>Publication identity</h2>
          <p className="fine">Set once per product. Empty fields take the defaults shown. Saving checks the documents again.</p>
          {(["s1000d", "ata", "both"] as const).map((g) => (
            <div key={g} className="fields">
              <h3>{g === "s1000d" ? "S1000D data module code" : g === "ata" ? "ATA iSpec 2200" : "Company"}</h3>
              {ID_FIELDS.filter((f) => f.group === g).map((f) => (
                <label key={f.k} className={f.w === 2 ? "wide2" : f.w === 4 ? "wide" : ""}><span>{f.label}</span>
                  <input value={ident[f.k] ?? ""} placeholder={DEFAULTS[f.k] ?? ""} onChange={(e) => setIdent({ ...ident, [f.k]: e.target.value })} /></label>))}
            </div>
          ))}
          <button className="btn" onClick={saveIdent}>Save identity</button>
        </section>
      </div>

      {history.length > 0 && (
        <section className="pub-history">
          <h2>Published</h2>
          {[...history].reverse().map((h, i) => (
            <div key={i} className="pub-run">
              <div className="pub-run-head"><b>{h.connector === "folder" ? "Folder" : h.connector ?? "—"}</b> <span className="fine">{h.at ? new Date(h.at).toLocaleString() : ""}{h.location ? ` · ${h.location}` : ""}</span>
                {h.published_with_errors && <span className="tag bad">published with validation errors</span>}</div>
              <table className="grid compact static">
                <thead><tr><th>File</th><th>Result</th><th>Check</th></tr></thead>
                <tbody>{(h.documents ?? []).map((d: Json, k: number) => (
                  <tr key={k}>
                    <td className="pn">{d.file}</td>
                    <td>{d.action === "written" ? "Written" : d.action ?? ""}{d.error && <span className="bad-t"> {d.error}</span>}</td>
                    <td>{d.statuses ? <>
                      <span className={`tag ${d.passed ? "ok" : "bad"}`}>{d.passed ? "Valid" : "Errors"}</span>
                      <span className="fine"> schema {d.statuses.structural}, business rules {d.statuses.business_rules}{d.counts?.warning ? `, ${plural(d.counts.warning, "warning")}` : ""}</span></> :
                      <span className="fine">not an XML publication</span>}</td>
                  </tr>))}</tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          ))}
        </section>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
