import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { api, Json } from "../api";
import { plural, useStudio } from "../state";
import { Diagnostics } from "./Check";

/* Everything documents are checked against, for every product: schema packages, BREX, rule sets,
   stylesheets. Changes apply the next time documents are checked. */

type Tab = "schemas" | "brex" | "rules" | "stylesheets" | "try";
const STANDARDS = ["S1000D", "ATA2200", "ATA2300", "S2000M", "S3000L", "S4000P", "S5000F", "S6000T", "OEM"];

export function SchemasView() {
  const { toast, refreshSystem } = useStudio();
  const [tab, setTab] = useState<Tab>("schemas");
  const [conf, setConf] = useState<Json | null>(null);
  const reload = () => api.conformance().then(setConf).catch((e) => toast(e.message, "bad"));
  // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  useEffect(() => { reload(); }, []);
  const act = async (p: Promise<unknown>, ok: string) => {
    try { await p; toast(ok); await reload(); refreshSystem(); return true; } catch (e) { toast((e as Error).message, "bad"); return false; }
  };
  if (!conf) return <div className="view"><p className="fine">Loading…</p></div>;
  const counts: Record<Tab, number | null> = { schemas: conf.packages.length, brex: conf.brex.length, rules: conf.rules.length,
    stylesheets: conf.stylesheets.length, try: null };

  return (
    <div className="view schemas">
      <header className="view-head">
        <h1>Schemas and rules</h1>
        <p className="lede-s">What every product's documents are checked against: the schema of the standard, the BREX the documents name, your own rule sets, and the stylesheets that show or transform them. Changes apply the next time documents are checked.</p>
      </header>
      <div className="tabs" role="tablist">
        {([["schemas", "Schemas"], ["brex", "BREX"], ["rules", "Rule sets"], ["stylesheets", "Stylesheets"], ["try", "Try a document"]] as [Tab, string][]).map(([k, l]) =>
          <button key={k} role="tab" aria-selected={tab === k} className={tab === k ? "on" : ""} onClick={() => setTab(k)}>
            {l}{counts[k] != null ? ` (${counts[k]})` : ""}</button>)}
      </div>
      {tab === "schemas" && <SchemaPackages conf={conf} act={act} reload={reload} />}
      {tab === "brex" && <BrexPanel conf={conf} act={act} />}
      {tab === "rules" && <RulesPanel conf={conf} act={act} />}
      {tab === "stylesheets" && <StylesPanel conf={conf} act={act} />}
      {tab === "try" && <TryPanel />}
    </div>
  );
}

type Act = (p: Promise<unknown>, ok: string) => Promise<boolean>;

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- schema packages
function SchemaPackages({ conf, act, reload }: { conf: Json; act: Act; reload: () => void }) {
  const { toast, refreshSystem } = useStudio();
  const [proposal, setProposal] = useState<Json | null>(null);
  const [sending, setSending] = useState(false);
  const folder = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  useEffect(() => { folder.current?.setAttribute("webkitdirectory", ""); }, []);

  const inspect = async (list: FileList | null) => {
    if (!list?.length) return;
    const files = Array.from(list);
    setSending(true);
    try {
      const p = await api.inspectSchemas(files, files.map((f) => (f as File & { webkitRelativePath?: string }).webkitRelativePath || f.name));
      setProposal(p);
    } catch (e) { toast((e as Error).message, "bad"); }
    finally { setSending(false); }
  };

  return (
    <section className="panel-sec">
      <div className="sec-head">
        <p className="fine">Add an issue of a standard as you received it: the zip or folder of the S1000D schemas (the default BREX inside is added too), an ATA or OEM DTD set, any XSD set, or a ready-made schema package. Studio works out the document types and asks only what it cannot read from the files.</p>
        <div className="toolbar">
          <label className="btn primary file-btn">{sending ? "Reading…" : "Add schemas from a zip or files"}
            <input type="file" multiple accept=".zip,.xsd,.dtd,.ent,.mod,.cat,.xml,.json" onChange={(e) => { inspect(e.target.files); e.target.value = ""; }} /></label>
          <label className="btn file-btn">Add a folder
            <input ref={folder} type="file" multiple onChange={(e) => { inspect(e.target.files); e.target.value = ""; }} /></label>
          {conf.evaluation_packages && <button className="btn quiet" onClick={() => act(api.installEvaluation(), "Evaluation schemas installed")}
            title="Synthetic subsets written for testing. Use the official schemas for real checks.">Install evaluation subsets</button>}
        </div>
      </div>
      {proposal && <Proposal p={proposal} onDone={() => { setProposal(null); reload(); refreshSystem(); }} onCancel={() => setProposal(null)} />}

      <h2>Coverage of Studio's outputs</h2>
      <table className="grid compact static">
        <thead><tr><th>Output</th><th>Installed schemas that validate it</th></tr></thead>
        <tbody>{Object.entries(conf.coverage).map(([k, v]: [string, Json]) => (
          <tr key={k}><td>{v.label}</td><td>{v.options.length ? v.options.map((o: Json) => <div key={o.package_id + o.doc_type}>{o.label}{o.provenance === "synthetic" && <span className="tag warn">evaluation</span>}</div>) : <span className="warn-t">None installed: documents are checked for well-formed XML only</span>}</td></tr>
        ))}</tbody>
      </table>

      <h2>Installed schema packages</h2>
      {!conf.packages.length ? <p className="fine">None yet.</p> : (
        <ul className="lib-list">
          {conf.packages.map((p: Json) => (
            <li key={p.id} className={p.enabled ? "" : "off"}>
              <div className="lib-main">
                <b>{p.name}</b>
                <span className="fine">{p.standard} {p.issue} · {plural(p.file_count, "file")} · {p.id}</span>
                <span className="lib-tags">
                  {p.provenance === "synthetic" ? <span className="tag warn">evaluation subset</span> : <span className="tag ok">{p.provenance}</span>}
                  {p.doc_types.map((d: Json) => <span key={d.id} className="tag" title={`root <${d.root}>`}>{d.label}</span>)}
                </span>
              </div>
              <div className="lib-actions">
                <label className="switch"><input type="checkbox" checked={p.enabled} onChange={(e) => act(api.setPackage(p.id, e.target.checked), e.target.checked ? "Enabled" : "Disabled")} /> Enabled</label>
                <a className="link" href={api.packageExportUrl(p.id)}>Export</a>
                <button className="link danger" onClick={() => confirm(`Remove ${p.name}? Documents are no longer checked against it.`) && act(api.removePackage(p.id), "Removed")}>Remove</button>
              </div>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      )}
    </section>
  );
}

function Proposal({ p, onDone, onCancel }: { p: Json; onDone: () => void; onCancel: () => void }) {
  const { toast } = useStudio();
  const [c, setC] = useState<Json>(() => ({ ...p, types: p.default_types, doc_types: p.doc_types?.map((t: Json) => ({ ...t })) }));
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const install = async (replace = false) => {
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      const r = await api.installSchemas(p.staging, c, replace);
      toast(`Installed ${r.package.name}${r.brex_installed?.length ? ` and ${plural(r.brex_installed.length, "BREX")}` : ""}`);
      onDone();
    } catch (e) {
      const msg = (e as Error).message;
      if (/already installed/.test(msg) && confirm(`${msg}\n\nReplace the installed build?`)) { setBusy(false); return install(true); }
      toast(msg, "bad");
    } finally { setBusy(false); }
  };
  const setType = (i: number, k: string, v: unknown) => setC({ ...c, doc_types: c.doc_types.map((t: Json, j: number) => j === i ? { ...t, [k]: v } : t) });
  return (
    <div className="proposal">
      <h3>{p.kind === "package" ? "Schema package" : p.kind === "s1000d" ? "S1000D schemas" : p.kind === "dtd" ? "DTD set" : "XSD set"} found</h3>
      {(p.notes ?? []).map((n: string, i: number) => <p key={i} className="fine">{n}</p>)}
      <div className="fields">
        {p.kind !== "package" && <label><span>Issue / revision (required)</span><input value={c.issue ?? ""} onChange={(e) => setC({ ...c, issue: e.target.value })} placeholder="for example 4.2 or 2023.1" /></label>}
        {(p.kind === "dtd" || p.kind === "xsd") && <label><span>Standard</span><select value={c.standard} onChange={(e) => setC({ ...c, standard: e.target.value })}>{STANDARDS.map((s) => <option key={s}>{s}</option>)}</select></label>}
        {(p.kind === "dtd" || p.kind === "xsd") && <label className="wide"><span>Name (optional)</span><input value={c.name ?? ""} onChange={(e) => setC({ ...c, name: e.target.value })} /></label>}
        {p.kind === "s1000d" && p.folders?.length > 1 && <label className="wide"><span>Schema copy</span><select value={c.folder} onChange={(e) => setC({ ...c, folder: e.target.value })}>
          {p.folders.map((f: Json) => <option key={f.path} value={f.path}>{f.path} {f.issue ? `(issue ${f.issue})` : ""}</option>)}</select></label>}
        {p.kind === "s1000d" && <label className="wide"><span>Document types (schema names, comma separated)</span>
          <input value={(c.types ?? []).join(", ")} onChange={(e) => setC({ ...c, types: e.target.value.split(",").map((x) => x.trim()).filter(Boolean) })} /></label>}
      </div>
      {(p.kind === "dtd" || p.kind === "xsd") && c.doc_types?.length > 0 && (
        <table className="grid compact static">
          <thead><tr><th /><th>Document type</th><th>File</th><th>Top element</th></tr></thead>
          <tbody>{c.doc_types.map((t: Json, i: number) => (
            <tr key={i}><td><input type="checkbox" checked={!!t.selected} onChange={(e) => setType(i, "selected", e.target.checked)} aria-label={`Install ${t.id}`} /></td>
              <td>{t.label ?? t.id}{t.problem && <div className="warn-t fine">{t.problem}</div>}</td><td className="fine">{t.schema_file}</td>
              <td>{t.root_candidates?.length ? <select value={t.root ?? ""} onChange={(e) => setType(i, "root", e.target.value)}><option value="">Choose…</option>
                {t.root_candidates.map((r: string) => <option key={r}>{r}</option>)}</select> : t.root}</td></tr>))}</tbody>
        </table>
      )}
      <div className="actions">
        <button className="btn primary" disabled={busy || (p.kind !== "package" && !c.issue)} onClick={() => install()}>{busy ? "Installing…" : "Install"}</button>
        <button className="link" onClick={onCancel}>Cancel</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- BREX
function BrexPanel({ conf, act }: { conf: Json; act: Act }) {
  const [named, setNamed] = useState("");
  const [use, setUse] = useState("");
  const subs: Record<string, string> = conf.brex_substitutes ?? {};
  return (

      <div className="sec-head">
        <p className="fine">S1000D data modules name the BREX that holds their business rules. Add the S1000D default BREX for your issue and your project BREX (information code 022); a project BREX that builds on the default is checked as a chain. Set which BREX your documents name under Publish → Publication identity.</p>
        <label className="btn primary file-btn">Add a BREX data module
          <input type="file" accept=".xml,.XML" onChange={(e) => { const f = e.target.files?.[0]; if (f) act(api.addBrex(f), "BREX added"); e.target.value = ""; }} /></label>
      </div>

        <input aria-label="BREX the documents name" placeholder="BREX the documents name, e.g. S1000D-G-04-10-0301-00A-022A-D" value={named} onChange={(e) => setNamed(e.target.value)} />

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- applies-to editor
function AppliesTo({ value, onChange }: { value: Json; onChange: (v: Json) => void }) {
  const list = (s: string) => s.split(",").map((x) => x.trim()).filter(Boolean);
  return (
    <div className="fields applies">
      <label><span>Standards</span><input placeholder="all, or e.g. S1000D" defaultValue={(value.standards ?? []).join(", ")} onChange={(e) => onChange({ ...value, standards: list(e.target.value) })} /></label>
      <label><span>Document types</span><input placeholder="all, or e.g. proced, ipd" defaultValue={(value.doc_types ?? []).join(", ")} onChange={(e) => onChange({ ...value, doc_types: list(e.target.value) })} /></label>
      <label><span>Top elements</span><input placeholder="all, or e.g. dmodule, cmm" defaultValue={(value.roots ?? []).join(", ")} onChange={(e) => onChange({ ...value, roots: list(e.target.value) })} /></label>
    </div>
  );
}
const appliesText = (a: Json) => {
  const parts = [a?.standards?.join(", "), a?.doc_types?.length ? `types ${a.doc_types.join(", ")}` : "", a?.roots?.length ? `<${a.roots.join(">, <")}>` : ""].filter(Boolean);
  return parts.length ? parts.join(" · ") : "all documents";
};

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- rule sets
function RulesPanel({ conf, act }: { conf: Json; act: Act }) {
  const [file, setFile] = useState<File | null>(null);
  const [applies, setApplies] = useState<Json>({});
  const [k, setK] = useState(0);
  return (
    <section className="panel-sec">
      <div className="sec-head">
        <p className="fine">Your own business rules, checked with the BREX. A rule set is a Schematron file (<code>.sch</code>; <code>@id</code> is the rule id, <code>@role</code> the severity) or a rule file in YAML or JSON: each rule has an id, a <code>context</code> XPath and one test (<code>assert</code>, <code>forbid</code>, <code>allowed</code> or <code>pattern</code>). Examples are in the <code>examples/rules</code> folder of the delivery. Installing a file with the same id replaces it.</p>
      </div>
      <form key={k} className="add-box" onSubmit={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); if (file) act(api.addRules(file, applies), "Rule set added").then((ok) => { if (ok) { setFile(null); setApplies({}); setK(k + 1); } }); }}>
        <label className="btn file-btn">{file ? file.name : "Choose a rule file"}<input type="file" accept=".sch,.yaml,.yml,.json" onChange={(e) => setFile(e.target.files?.[0] ?? null)} /></label>
        <p className="fine">Applies to (leave empty for every document; a YAML file can say this itself):</p>
        <AppliesTo value={applies} onChange={setApplies} />
        <button className="btn primary" disabled={!file}>Add rule set</button>
      </form>
      {!conf.rules.length ? <p className="fine">No rule sets yet.</p> : (
        <ul className="lib-list">{conf.rules.map((r: Json) => (
          <li key={r.id} className={r.enabled ? "" : "off"}>
            <div className="lib-main">
              <b>{r.name}</b>
              <span className="fine">{r.kind === "schematron" ? "Schematron" : "XPath rules"} · {plural(r.rules, "rule")} · applies to {appliesText(r.applies_to)}</span>
            </div>
            <div className="lib-actions">
              <label className="switch"><input type="checkbox" checked={r.enabled} onChange={(e) => act(api.changeRules(r.id, { enabled: e.target.checked }), e.target.checked ? "Enabled" : "Disabled")} /> Enabled</label>
              <a className="link" href={api.rulesSourceUrl(r.id)} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">Source</a>
              <button className="link danger" onClick={() => confirm(`Remove ${r.name}?`) && act(api.removeRules(r.id), "Removed")}>Remove</button>
            </div>
          </li>))}</ul>
      )}
    </section>
  );
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- stylesheets
function StylesPanel({ conf, act }: { conf: Json; act: Act }) {
  const [file, setFile] = useState<File | null>(null);
  const [kind, setKind] = useState("view");
  const [order, setOrder] = useState(100);
  const [applies, setApplies] = useState<Json>({});
  const [k, setK] = useState(0);
  const list: Json[] = conf.stylesheets;
  return (
    <section className="panel-sec">
      <div className="sec-head">
        <p className="fine">XSLT 1.0 stylesheets. A <b>view</b> turns a document into the reading view on Check documents; yours take precedence over the built-in ones for the documents they apply to. A <b>transform</b> rewrites Studio's XML before it is checked and published (house conventions, a customer's flavour of the schema); transforms run in order. A stylesheet that includes others is added as a zip. Stylesheets cannot reach the network or write files.</p>
      </div>
      <form key={k} className="add-box" onSubmit={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); if (file) act(api.addStylesheet(file, kind, applies, order), "Stylesheet added").then((ok) => { if (ok) { setFile(null); setApplies({}); setK(k + 1); } }); }}>
        <div className="toolbar">
          <label className="btn file-btn">{file ? file.name : "Choose a stylesheet"}<input type="file" accept=".xsl,.xslt,.zip" onChange={(e) => setFile(e.target.files?.[0] ?? null)} /></label>
          <div className="seg" role="radiogroup" aria-label="Kind">
            {(["view", "transform"] as const).map((x) => <button type="button" key={x} role="radio" aria-checked={kind === x} className={kind === x ? "on" : ""} onClick={() => setKind(x)}>{x === "view" ? "View" : "Transform"}</button>)}
          </div>
          {kind === "transform" && <label className="fine">Order <input type="number" value={order} onChange={(e) => setOrder(+e.target.value)} style={{ width: "5rem" }} /></label>}
        </div>
        <AppliesTo value={applies} onChange={setApplies} />
        <button className="btn primary" disabled={!file}>Add stylesheet</button>
      </form>
      <ul className="lib-list">{list.map((s: Json) => (
        <li key={s.id} className={s.enabled ? "" : "off"}>
          <div className="lib-main">
            <b>{s.name}</b>
            <span className="fine">{s.kind === "view" ? "View" : `Transform, order ${s.order}`} · applies to {appliesText(s.applies_to)}</span>
            {s.builtin && <span className="lib-tags"><span className="tag">built in</span></span>}
          </div>
          <div className="lib-actions">
            <label className="switch"><input type="checkbox" checked={s.enabled} onChange={(e) => act(api.changeStylesheet(s.id, { enabled: e.target.checked }), e.target.checked ? "Enabled" : "Disabled")} /> Enabled</label>
            <a className="link" href={api.stylesheetSourceUrl(s.id)} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">Source</a>
            {!s.builtin && <button className="link danger" onClick={() => confirm(`Remove ${s.name}?`) && act(api.removeStylesheet(s.id), "Removed")}>Remove</button>}
          </div>
        </li>))}</ul>
    </section>
  );
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- try any document
function TryPanel() {
  const { toast } = useStudio();
  const [rep, setRep] = useState<Json | null>(null);
  const [name, setName] = useState("");
  return (
    <section className="panel-sec">
      <div className="sec-head">
        <p className="fine">Check any XML document against what is installed, without a run: useful when writing a new rule set or stylesheet.</p>
        <label className="btn primary file-btn">Choose an XML document
          <input type="file" accept=".xml,.XML,.sgm" onChange={async (e) => {
            const f = e.target.files?.[0]; e.target.value = "";
            if (!f) return;
            setName(f.name);
            try { setRep(await api.checkAny(f)); } catch (err) { toast((err as Error).message, "bad"); }
          }} /></label>
      </div>
      {rep && <>
        <h2>{name}</h2>
        <p className="fine">{rep.identification.package_id ? `Validated against ${rep.identification.package_id} · ${rep.identification.doc_type} (${rep.identification.how}).` : rep.identification.notes?.join(" ")}</p>
        <ol className="stage-strip">{rep.stages.map((st: Json) => <li key={st.stage} className={st.status === "passed" ? "ok" : st.status === "failed" ? "bad" : ""} title={st.note}>
          <span className="stage-n">{st.stage}</span><span className="stage-t">{st.name}</span><span className="stage-s">{st.status}</span>{st.note && <span className="stage-note">{st.note}</span>}</li>)}</ol>
        <Diagnostics items={rep.diagnostics} />
        {rep.view?.html && <iframe className="doc-frame" title={`Reading view of ${name}`} sandbox="" srcDoc={rep.view.html} />}
      </>}
    </section>
  );
}

import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { api, Json } from "../api";
import { useArtifact, useStudio } from "../state";

/* The disassembly sequence the planner found from the 3D contacts. The scrubber removes parts step by step in
   the viewer; the writer can reorder steps (the backend checks the blocking constraints and rebuilds the rest). */

export function SequenceView() {
  const { data: seq } = useArtifact<Json>("sequence");
  const { data: ipl } = useArtifact<Json>("ipl");
  const { run, setScene, pickHandler, editable, toast, touch } = useStudio();
  const [order, setOrder] = useState<string[] | null>(null);       // draft order while editing
  const [cur, setCur] = useState(0);                                  // 0 = assembled, n = after step n
  const [explode, setExplode] = useState(0);
  const [focus, setFocus] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const steps: Json[] = useMemo(() => {
    const ds: Json[] = seq?.disassembly ?? [];
    if (!order) return ds;
    const by = new Map(ds.map((s) => [s.unit, s]));
    return order.map((u) => by.get(u)!).filter(Boolean);
  }, [seq, order]);

  const rowByOcc = useMemo(() => {
    const m = new Map<string, Json>();
    (ipl?.rows ?? []).forEach((r: Json) => r.occ_ids?.forEach((o: string) => m.set(o, r)));
    return m;
  }, [ipl]);
  const rowById = useMemo(() => new Map<string, Json>((ipl?.rows ?? []).map((r: Json) => [r.id, r])), [ipl]);
  /** A sub-assembly that moves as one: the parts-list row that holds all its parts. */
  const holder = (s: Json): Json | null => {
    const rs = (s.members ?? []).map((m: string) => rowByOcc.get(m)).filter(Boolean) as Json[];
    if (rs.length < 2) return null;
    const chain = (r: Json) => { const out: string[] = []; let x: Json | undefined = r; while (x) { out.push(x.id); x = x.parent_row ? rowById.get(x.parent_row) : undefined; } return out; };
    // the row that holds most of the parts (a few parts of a sub-assembly may be listed elsewhere, e.g. its screws)
    const cover = new Map<string, number>();
    rs.forEach((r) => chain(r).forEach((id) => cover.set(id, (cover.get(id) ?? 0) + 1)));
    let best: Json | null = null, n = 0;
    cover.forEach((c, id) => {
      const r = rowById.get(id);
      if (r && r.depth >= 1 && (c > n || (c === n && best && r.depth > best.depth))) { best = r; n = c; }
    });
    return n >= rs.length / 2 ? best : null;
  };
  const name = (s: Json) => {
    const r = holder(s) ?? rowByOcc.get(s.unit) ?? rowByOcc.get(s.members?.[0]);
    return r ? { item: r.item, text: r.nomenclature } : { item: "", text: s.unit.replace(/_\d+$/, "") };
  };
  const partName = (unit: string) => {
    const s = (seq?.disassembly ?? []).find((x: Json) => x.unit === unit);
    const n = s ? name(s) : null;
    if (n) return n.item ? `${n.text.toLowerCase()} (${n.item})` : n.text;
    const r = rowByOcc.get(unit);
    return r ? `${r.nomenclature.toLowerCase()} (${r.item})` : "the base unit";
  };
  const blockers = useMemo(() => {
    const m = new Map<string, string[]>();
    (seq?.precedence ?? []).forEach((p: Json) => { if (!m.has(p.then)) m.set(p.then, []); m.get(p.then)!.push(p.first); });
    return m;
  }, [seq]);
  const pos = new Map(steps.map((s, i) => [s.unit, i]));
  const broken = new Set<string>();
  steps.forEach((s, i) => (blockers.get(s.unit) ?? []).forEach((b) => { if ((pos.get(b) ?? -1) > i) broken.add(s.unit); }));

  // viewer
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!seq) return;
    const hidden = new Set<string>();
    steps.slice(0, cur).forEach((s) => [...s.members, ...(s.riders ?? [])].forEach((m: string) => hidden.add(m)));
    const active = focus ? steps.find((s) => s.unit === focus) : steps[cur] ?? null;
    const sel = new Set<string>(active ? [...active.members, ...(active.riders ?? [])] : []);
    const ex = new Map<string, [number, number, number]>();
    steps.forEach((s) => [...s.members, ...(s.riders ?? [])].forEach((m: string) => ex.set(m, s.direction)));
    setScene({ selected: sel, hidden, explode: ex, explodeAmount: explode, tint: undefined, dim: null });
  }, [seq, steps, cur, explode, focus, setScene]);
  useEffect(() => () => setScene({ hidden: undefined, explode: undefined, explodeAmount: 0 }), [setScene]);

  useEffect(() => {
    pickHandler.current = (id) => {
      const s = id ? steps.find((x) => x.members.includes(id) || x.riders?.includes(id)) : null;
      setFocus(s?.unit ?? null);
      if (s) document.getElementById(`seq-${s.unit}`)?.scrollIntoView({ block: "nearest" });
    };
    return () => { pickHandler.current = null; };
  }, [steps, pickHandler]);

  // identical parts removed one after the other (four screws of the same item, same part, same direction) show as one row
  const groups = useMemo(() => {
    const out: { index: number; start: number; steps: Json[] }[] = [];
    steps.forEach((s, i) => {
      const g = out[out.length - 1];
      const p = g?.steps[g.steps.length - 1];
      const same = p && name(p).item && name(p).item === name(s).item && p.attaches === s.attaches
        && p.direction_label === s.direction_label && !(s.riders?.length) && !(p.riders?.length);
      if (same) g.steps.push(s); else out.push({ index: out.length, start: i, steps: [s] });
    });
    return out;
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [steps, rowByOcc]);
  const moveGroup = (gi: number, d: number) => {
    const j = gi + d;
    if (j < 0 || j >= groups.length) return;
    const gs = groups.map((g) => g.steps.map((s) => s.unit));
    [gs[gi], gs[j]] = [gs[j], gs[gi]];
    setOrder(gs.flat());
  };
  const save = async () => {
    if (!run || !order) return;
    try {
      const r = await api.reorder(run.id, order);
      setOrder(null);
      toast(r.warnings?.length ? `Saved with ${r.warnings.length} blocking warnings` : "Order saved. The parts list and procedures are being updated.", r.warnings?.length ? "bad" : "ok");
      touch();
    } catch (e) { toast((e as Error).message, "bad"); }
  };

  if (!seq) return <div className="view"><p className="fine">Loading the sequence…</p></div>;
  const warnings: string[] = seq.order_warnings ?? [];

  return (
    <div className="view sequence">
      <header className="view-head">
        <h1>Disassembly sequence</h1>
        <p className="lede-s">{steps.length} removal steps worked out from contacts and blocking directions in the 3D model, part by part: each part comes off right after its attaching parts.
          {seq.conflicts?.length ? ` ${seq.conflicts.length} parts could not be freed and were forced.` : " Every part comes free."}
          {seq.writer_order ? " The order was changed by a writer." : ""}</p>
        <div className="scrub">
          <label htmlFor="scrub">After step</label>
          <input id="scrub" type="range" min={0} max={steps.length} value={cur} onChange={(e) => { setCur(+e.target.value); setFocus(null); }} />
          <output>{cur === 0 ? "Assembled" : `${cur} of ${steps.length}`}</output>
          <label htmlFor="explode">Explode</label>
          <input id="explode" type="range" min={0} max={1} step={0.02} value={explode} onChange={(e) => setExplode(+e.target.value)} />
        </div>
      </header>
      {warnings.length > 0 && <div className="callout warn"><b>The saved order breaks blocking constraints:</b><ul>{warnings.map((w, i) => <li key={i}>{w}</li>)}</ul></div>}
      {order && <div className="callout info editing">
        <span>You changed the order.{broken.size ? ` ${broken.size} steps now come before a part that blocks them.` : ""}</span>
        <button className="btn primary" onClick={save}>Save order</button>
        <button className="link" onClick={() => setOrder(null)}>Discard</button>
      </div>}
      <ol className="seq-list">
        {groups.map((g) => {
          const s = g.steps[0], i = g.start, last = g.start + g.steps.length - 1;
          const n = name(s);
          const units = g.steps.map((x) => x.unit);
          const isCur = cur >= i && cur <= last && !focus, isFocus = !!focus && units.includes(focus), done = last < cur;
          const isBroken = units.some((u) => broken.has(u)), forced = g.steps.some((x) => x.forced);
          return (
            <li key={s.unit} id={`seq-${s.unit}`} className={[isCur && "cur", isFocus && "focus", done && "done", isBroken && "broken", forced && "forced",
              s.attaches && "att", s.attached_by?.length && "held"].filter(Boolean).join(" ")}
              onClick={() => { setFocus(isFocus ? null : s.unit); }}>
              <span className="seq-no">{g.steps.length > 1 ? `${i + 1}–${last + 1}` : i + 1}</span>
              <span className="seq-what">
                <span className="seq-name">{n.item && <span className="item-no">{n.item}</span>}{n.text}
                  {g.steps.length > 1 && <span className="seq-qty"> × {g.steps.length}</span>}
                  {s.members.length > 1 && <span className="fine"> (sub-assembly, {s.members.length} parts)</span>}</span>
                <span className="seq-meta">
                  {s.attaches && <>Attaching part of {partName(s.attaches)} · </>}
                  {s.attached_by?.length > 0 && <>After its attaching parts · </>}
                  Out along {s.direction_label}
                  {(s.riders?.length ?? 0) > 0 && ` · carries ${s.riders.length} fitted parts`}
                  {forced && <span className="warn-t"> · forced: no free direction found</span>}
                  {isBroken && <span className="warn-t"> · blocked by a later step</span>}
                </span>
              </span>
              <span className="dir" aria-hidden>{arrow(s.direction_label)}</span>
              {editable && <span className="mv">
                <button className="icon" aria-label="Move earlier" onClick={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); moveGroup(g.index, -1); }} disabled={g.index === 0}>▲</button>
                <button className="icon" aria-label="Move later" onClick={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); moveGroup(g.index, 1); }} disabled={g.index === groups.length - 1}>▼</button>
              </span>}
            </li>
          );
        })}
      </ol>
      <p className="fine">Assembly is this sequence in reverse. Parts that stay installed (permanent inserts, press-fit plugs) ride along with their carrier.</p>
    </div>
  );
}

const arrow = (d: string) => ({ "+X": "→", "-X": "←", "+Y": "↗", "-Y": "↙", "+Z": "↑", "-Z": "↓" } as Record<string, string>)[d] ?? "•";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { api, Json } from "../api";

/* The language model connection. Optional: procedures are complete without it. When connected, it only
   rewords template steps, and every reworded step must pass the STE checker and the fact check (items,
   quantities, torques) or the template text is kept. */

const PROVIDERS: { id: string; label: string; note: string }[] = [
  { id: "none", label: "None", note: "Steps are written from templates only. Deterministic and offline." },
  { id: "ollama", label: "Ollama (offline)", note: "A model on this computer or your network, for example Qwen 2.5 / Qwen 3. Nothing leaves your network." },
  { id: "openai", label: "OpenAI-compatible server", note: "vLLM, LM Studio, LocalAI or an internal gateway that speaks the OpenAI chat API." },
  { id: "bedrock", label: "Amazon Bedrock", note: "Claude or another Bedrock model in your AWS account, optionally through a VPC interface endpoint (PrivateLink)." },
  { id: "anthropic", label: "Anthropic API", note: "Claude through the Anthropic API." },
];
const DEFAULTS: Record<string, Json> = {
  ollama: { base_url: "http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1", model: "qwen2.5:7b", batch_size: 8, timeout: 300 },
  openai: { base_url: "http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1", model: "", batch_size: 15, json_mode: true },
  bedrock: { region: "eu-west-3", model: "eu.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929-v1:0", endpoint_url: "", profile: "" },
  anthropic: { model: "claude-sonnet-4-5", api_key_env: "ANTHROPIC_API_KEY" },
};

export function SettingsView() {
  const { toast, refreshSystem } = useStudio();
  const [s, setS] = useState<Json | null>(null);
  const [source, setSource] = useState("");
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<Json>(null);
  const [models, setModels] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [test, setTest] = useState<Json>(null);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState("");

  useEffect(() => {
    api.llmSettings().then((r) => { setS(r.settings); setSource(r.source); setStatus(r.status); }).catch((e) => toast(e.message, "bad"));
  }, []); // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  if (!s) return <div className="view"><p className="fine">Loading…</p></div>;
  const p = s.provider || "none";
  const set = (k: string, v: unknown) => setS({ ...s, [k]: v });
  const choose = (id: string) => { setS({ provider: id, ...(DEFAULTS[id] ?? {}) }); setModels([]); setTest(null); };
  const field = (k: string, label: string, ph = "", type = "text") => (
    <label key={k}><span>{label}</span><input type={type} value={s[k] ?? ""} placeholder={ph} onChange={(e) => set(k, type === "number" ? +e.target.value : e.target.value)} /></label>);

  const save = async () => {
    setBusy("save");
    try { const r = await api.saveLlm(s); setStatus(r.status); setSource("app"); refreshSystem(); toast("Language model saved. New runs use it; to reword an existing run, use Procedures → Reword."); }
    catch (e) { toast((e as Error).message, "bad"); } finally { setBusy(""); }
  };
  const runTest = async () => {
    setBusy("test"); setTest(null);
    try { setTest(await api.testLlm(s)); } catch (e) { setTest({ ok: false, message: (e as Error).message }); } finally { setBusy(""); }
  };
  const listModels = async () => {
    setBusy("models");
    try { const r = await api.llmModels(s); setModels(r.models); if (!r.models.length) toast("The server lists no models. Pull one first: ollama pull qwen2.5:7b", "bad"); }
    catch (e) { toast((e as Error).message, "bad"); } finally { setBusy(""); }
  };

  return (
    <div className="view settings">
      <header className="view-head">
        <h1>Settings</h1>
        <p className="lede-s">Language model for rewording procedure steps. It is optional: Studio writes complete STE procedures from templates. A connected model only improves the wording, and each reworded step goes through the STE checker and the fact check; a step that changes an item, quantity or torque keeps the template text.</p>
      </header>
      <section className="panel-sec">
        <h2>Language model</h2>
        <p className="fine">Now: {status?.available ? <span className="ok-t">{status.provider} connected{status.model ? ` · ${status.model}` : ""}</span> : status?.provider === "none" ? "templates only" : <span className="warn-t">{status?.provider} not reachable</span>}{source === "studio.yaml" ? " (from studio.yaml)" : ""}.</p>
        <div className="provider-list" role="radiogroup" aria-label="Provider">
          {PROVIDERS.map((x) => (
            <label key={x.id} className={`check ${p === x.id ? "on" : ""}`}>
              <input type="radio" name="provider" checked={p === x.id} onChange={() => choose(x.id)} />
              <span><b>{x.label}</b><br /><span className="fine">{x.note}</span></span>
            </label>))}
        </div>
        {p !== "none" && <div className="fields llm-fields">
          {(p === "ollama" || p === "openai") && <>
            {field("base_url", "Server address", DEFAULTS[p].base_url)}
            <label><span>Model</span>
              <span className="pair">
                {models.length ? <select value={s.model ?? ""} onChange={(e) => set("model", e.target.value)}>
                  {!models.includes(s.model) && <option value={s.model}>{s.model || "Choose…"}</option>}
                  {models.map((m) => <option key={m}>{m}</option>)}</select> :
                  <input value={s.model ?? ""} placeholder="qwen2.5:7b" onChange={(e) => set("model", e.target.value)} />}
                <button type="button" className="btn" onClick={listModels} disabled={busy === "models"}>{busy === "models" ? "…" : "List models"}</button>
              </span></label>
            {p === "openai" && field("api_key", "API key (if the server needs one)", "")}
            {field("batch_size", "Steps per request", "8", "number")}
            {field("timeout", "Timeout per request, s", "300", "number")}
          </>}
          {p === "bedrock" && <>
            {field("region", "AWS region", "eu-west-3")}
            {field("model", "Model or inference profile id", DEFAULTS.bedrock.model)}
            {field("endpoint_url", "VPC endpoint URL (optional)", "https://vpce-…bedrock-runtime.eu-west-3.vpce.amazonaws.com")}
            {field("profile", "AWS profile (optional)", "default credentials chain")}
            <p className="fine wide">Credentials come from the server's AWS credentials chain (instance role, profile or environment), never from this page.</p>
          </>}
          {p === "anthropic" && <>
            {field("model", "Model", "claude-sonnet-4-5")}
            {field("api_key_env", "Environment variable with the key", "ANTHROPIC_API_KEY")}
          </>}
        </div>}
        <div className="actions">
          {p !== "none" && <button className="btn" onClick={runTest} disabled={!!busy}>{busy === "test" ? "Testing… (a local model can take a minute)" : "Test with two sample steps"}</button>}
          <button className="btn primary" onClick={save} disabled={!!busy}>Save</button>
        </div>
        {test && <div className={`callout ${test.ok ? "info" : "bad"}`}>
          {test.ok ? <div className="test-out">
            <b>Answered in {test.seconds} s.</b>
            <table className="grid compact static"><thead><tr><th>Sent</th><th>Returned</th></tr></thead>
              <tbody>{test.sample.map((x: Json, i: number) => <tr key={x.id}><td>{x.text}</td><td>{test.answer?.[i]?.text ?? <span className="warn-t">missing</span>}</td></tr>)}</tbody></table>
            <span className="fine">During a run, each answer is checked; one that changes a value is discarded.</span>
          </div> : <span>Not working: {test.message}</span>}
        </div>}
      </section>
    </div>
  );
}

export function toCm(doc: EditorState["doc"], diags: Json[]): CmDiagnostic[] {
  const out: CmDiagnostic[] = [];
  for (const d of diags) {
    if (!d.line || d.line < 1 || d.line > doc.lines) continue;
    const ln = doc.line(d.line);
    const lead = ln.text.length - ln.text.trimStart().length;
    let from = ln.from + lead, to = ln.to;
    if (d.column && d.column > 0) from = Math.min(ln.to, ln.from + d.column - 1);
    if (to <= from) to = Math.min(doc.length, from + 1);
    const sev = d.severity === "fatal" || d.severity === "error" ? "error" : d.severity === "warning" ? "warning" : "info";
    out.push({ from, to, severity: sev, source: d.rule_id, message: d.message + (d.suggestion ? `\n${d.suggestion}` : "") });
  }
  return out;
}

export function XmlCode({ text, onChange, readOnly, diagnostics, gotoLine }: {
  text: string; onChange: (t: string) => void; readOnly: boolean; diagnostics: Json[]; gotoLine?: { line: number; n: number } | null;
}) {
  const host = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const view = useRef<EditorView | null>(null);
  const ro = useRef(new Compartment());
  const cb = useRef(onChange);
  cb.current = onChange;

  useEffect(() => {
    const v = new EditorView({
      parent: host.current!,
      state: EditorState.create({
        doc: text,
        extensions: [
          lineNumbers(), foldGutter(), lintGutter(), highlightActiveLineGutter(), history(), drawSelection(),
          indentOnInput(), bracketMatching(), highlightActiveLine(), highlightSelectionMatches(),
          xml(), syntaxHighlighting(syntax), theme, EditorView.lineWrapping,
          keymap.of([...defaultKeymap, ...historyKeymap, ...searchKeymap, ...foldKeymap, indentWithTab]),
          ro.current.of([EditorState.readOnly.of(readOnly), EditorView.editable.of(!readOnly)]),
          EditorView.updateListener.of((u) => { if (u.docChanged) cb.current(u.state.doc.toString()); }),
        ],
      }),
    });
    view.current = v;
    return () => { v.destroy(); view.current = null; };
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, []);

  // outside changes (document view, revert, save) replace the text without losing the scroll position
  useEffect(() => {
    const v = view.current;
    if (v && v.state.doc.toString() !== text) v.dispatch({ changes: { from: 0, to: v.state.doc.length, insert: text } });
  }, [text]);

  useEffect(() => {
    view.current?.dispatch({ effects: ro.current.reconfigure([EditorState.readOnly.of(readOnly), EditorView.editable.of(!readOnly)]) });
  }, [readOnly]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const v = view.current;
    if (v) v.dispatch(setDiagnostics(v.state, toCm(v.state.doc, diagnostics)));
  }, [diagnostics, text]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const v = view.current;
    if (!v || !gotoLine || gotoLine.line > v.state.doc.lines) return;
    const ln = v.state.doc.line(gotoLine.line);
    v.dispatch({ selection: { anchor: ln.from }, effects: EditorView.scrollIntoView(ln.from, { y: "center" }) });
    v.focus();
  }, [gotoLine]);

  return <div className="xml-code" ref={host} />;
}

import { Fragment, useEffect, useLayoutEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from "react";
import type { Json } from "../../api";

/* The document view: the XML as a document, with its text editable in place. With "Tags" on, every element
   is drawn as a bracket with its name (and attributes) on a tab — the same tag view as ASTHRA's editor.
   Problems from the check are tied to their element: red for errors, amber for warnings.

   The XML text stays the single source: editing here changes the parsed document and writes it back as
   text; changes made in the XML view are parsed again. */

const SEV_RANK: Record<string, number> = { fatal: 0, error: 0, warning: 1, info: 2 };
const isErr = (d: Json) => d.severity === "error" || d.severity === "fatal";

/* parts of S1000D / ATA documents shown folded in the document view (they are metadata, not reading text) */
const FOLDED = new Set(["identAndStatusSection", "idstatus", "dmAddressItems", "dmStatus"]);
const PROSE = new Set(["title", "para", "simplePara", "warningAndCautionPara", "notePara", "attentionListItemPara", "techName", "infoName"]);
const FOLD_LABEL: Record<string, string> = { identAndStatusSection: "Identification and status", idstatus: "Identification and status" };

/** Line of each element's start tag, in document order (the order of getElementsByTagName("*")). */
export function elementLines(text: string): number[] {
  const re = /<!--[\s\S]*?-->|<!\[CDATA\[[\s\S]*?\]\]>|<\?[\s\S]*?\?>|<!DOCTYPE(?:[^[>]|\[[\s\S]*?\])*>|<([A-Za-z_][\w.:-]*)/g;
  const out: number[] = [];
  let line = 1, pos = 0, m: RegExpExecArray | null;
  while ((m = re.exec(text))) {
    for (let i = pos; i < m.index; i++) if (text.charCodeAt(i) === 10) line++;
    pos = m.index;
    if (m[1]) out.push(line);
  }
  return out;
}

/** '/dmodule/content/procedure/mainProcedure/proceduralStep[2]' — the path the checker reports. */
export function readablePath(el: Element): string {
  const parts: string[] = [];
  let e: Element | null = el;
  while (e) {
    const p: Element | null = e.parentElement;
    const name = e.localName;
    if (!p) parts.push(name);
    else {
      const same = Array.from(p.children).filter((c) => c.localName === e!.localName && c.namespaceURI === e!.namespaceURI);
      parts.push(same.length > 1 ? `${name}[${same.indexOf(e) + 1}]` : name);
    }
    e = p;
  }
  return "/" + parts.reverse().join("/");
}

interface Parsed { doc: Document; prolog: string; tail: string }

function parse(text: string): Parsed | { error: string } {
  const doc = new DOMParser().parseFromString(text, "application/xml");
  const err = doc.getElementsByTagName("parsererror")[0];
  if (err) return { error: (err.textContent || "The XML is not well-formed.").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim() };
  const start = text.search(new RegExp(`<${doc.documentElement.nodeName}[\\s/>]`));
  const endTag = `</${doc.documentElement.nodeName}>`;
  const end = text.lastIndexOf(endTag);
  return { doc, prolog: start > 0 ? text.slice(0, start) : "",
           tail: end >= 0 ? text.slice(end + endTag.length) : "\n" };
}

function serialize(p: Parsed): string {
  return p.prolog + new XMLSerializer().serializeToString(p.doc.documentElement) + p.tail;
}

interface Ctx {
  tags: boolean; readOnly: boolean; sel: Element | null; select: (e: Element) => void;
  diags: Map<Element, Json[]>; edited: () => void; key: (n: Node) => number; skip: Set<Element>;
}

export function XmlDoc({ text, onChange, readOnly, tags, diagnostics, onLine }: {
  text: string; onChange: (t: string) => void; readOnly: boolean; tags: boolean; diagnostics: Json[]; onLine: (l: number) => void;
}) {
  const [parsed, setParsed] = useState<Parsed | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [rev, setRev] = useState(0);
  const [sel, setSel] = useState<Element | null>(null);
  const emitted = useRef<string | null>(null);
  const ids = useRef(new WeakMap<Node, number>());
  const next = useRef(1);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (text === emitted.current) return;          // our own edit coming back
    const p = parse(text);
    if ("error" in p) { setError(p.error); return; }   // keep the last good tree, read-only, until the XML is fixed
    setError(null); setParsed(p); setSel(null);
    emitted.current = text;
  }, [text]);

  const edited = () => {
    if (!parsed) return;
    const t = serialize(parsed);
    emitted.current = t;
    onChange(t);
  };
  const structural = () => { edited(); setRev((r) => r + 1); };

  const diags = useMemo(() => {
    const m = new Map<Element, Json[]>();
    if (!parsed || error) return m;
    const els = Array.from(parsed.doc.getElementsByTagName("*"));
    const lines = elementLines(text);
    const byPath = new Map<string, Element>();
    els.forEach((e) => byPath.set(readablePath(e), e));
    for (const d of diagnostics) {
      let el: Element | undefined = d.element_path ? byPath.get(d.element_path) : undefined;
      if (!el && d.line && lines.length === els.length) {
        let lo = 0, hi = lines.length - 1, hit = -1;
        while (lo <= hi) { const mid = (lo + hi) >> 1; if (lines[mid] <= d.line) { hit = mid; lo = mid + 1; } else hi = mid - 1; }
        if (hit >= 0) el = els[hit];
      }
      if (el) { if (!m.has(el)) m.set(el, []); m.get(el)!.push(d); }
    }
    return m;
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [parsed, diagnostics, text, rev, error]);

  if (!parsed) return <div className="callout bad">{error ?? "Reading the document…"}</div>;
  const ro = readOnly || !!error;
  const ctx: Ctx = {
    tags, readOnly: ro, sel, select: setSel, diags, edited, skip: new Set(),
    key: (n) => { let k = ids.current.get(n); if (!k) { k = next.current++; ids.current.set(n, k); } return k; },
  };
  const lineOf = (el: Element) => {
    const els = Array.from(parsed.doc.getElementsByTagName("*"));
    const lines = elementLines(text);
    return lines.length === els.length ? lines[els.indexOf(el)] : undefined;
  };

  return (
    <div className="xdoc-wrap">
      <div className="xdoc-main">
        {error && <div className="callout bad xdoc-banner">The XML is not well-formed, so the document shows the last good version and cannot be edited here.
          <span className="fine"> {error}</span></div>}
        <div className={`xdoc ${tags ? "mode-tags" : "mode-doc"}`} data-rev={rev}>
          <Block el={parsed.doc.documentElement} ctx={ctx} />
        </div>
      </div>
      {sel && sel.ownerDocument === parsed.doc && parsed.doc.contains(sel) ? (
        <Inspector key={ctx.key(sel)} el={sel} ctx={ctx} line={lineOf(sel)} onLine={onLine} onStructure={structural}
          onClose={() => setSel(null)} problems={diags.get(sel) ?? []} />
      ) : (
        <aside className="x-inspector empty"><p className="fine">Select an element to see its attributes and problems
          {ro ? "." : ", change its attributes, move, duplicate or delete it."} Text is edited where it is.</p></aside>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

const hasText = (el: Element) => Array.from(el.childNodes).some((n) => n.nodeType === Node.TEXT_NODE && n.textContent!.trim() !== "")
  || Array.from(el.childNodes).some((n) => n.nodeType === Node.CDATA_SECTION_NODE);
const attrSummary = (el: Element, max = 3) => Array.from(el.attributes).filter((a) => !a.name.startsWith("xmlns") && !a.name.startsWith("xsi:"))
  .slice(0, max).map((a) => `${a.name}="${a.value.length > 24 ? a.value.slice(0, 22) + "…" : a.value}"`).join(" ");

const humanize = (n: string) => { const t = n.replace(/([a-z])([A-Z])/g, "$1 $2").toLowerCase(); return t.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + t.slice(1); };

/** The leaf fields of a small record-like element (all short values, no prose), or null. */
function recordLeaves(el: Element): Element[] | null {
  if (FOLDED.has(el.localName) || el.children.length < 2) return null;
  const all = Array.from(el.getElementsByTagName("*"));
  if (all.length > 14 || all.some((c) => PROSE.has(c.localName))) return null;
  const leaves = all.filter((c) => c.children.length === 0);
  if (leaves.length < 2 || leaves.length > 8) return null;
  if (leaves.some((c) => (c.textContent ?? "").trim().length > 40)) return null;
  // no loose text outside the leaves
  if (all.concat(el).some((c) => c.children.length > 0 && hasText(c))) return null;
  return leaves;
}

/** 'DMC-TECHPUB-A-32-42-11-00A-530A-C', as the reading view shows it. */
function dmcOf(el: Element): string {
  const c = el.getElementsByTagName("dmCode")[0];
  if (!c) return "";
  const a = (n: string) => c.getAttribute(n) ?? "";
  return `DMC-${a("modelIdentCode")}-${a("systemDiffCode")}-${a("systemCode")}-${a("subSystemCode")}${a("subSubSystemCode")}-` +
    `${a("assyCode")}-${a("disassyCode")}${a("disassyCodeVariant")}-${a("infoCode")}${a("infoCodeVariant")}-${a("itemLocationCode")}`;
}
function metaOf(el: Element): string {
  const i = el.getElementsByTagName("issueInfo")[0], d = el.getElementsByTagName("issueDate")[0];
  const parts = [];
  if (i) parts.push(`Issue ${i.getAttribute("issueNumber")}-${i.getAttribute("inWork")}`);
  if (d) parts.push(`${d.getAttribute("year")}-${d.getAttribute("month")}-${d.getAttribute("day")}`);
  return parts.join("    ");
}

function nodeClass(el: Element, ctx: Ctx, base: string) {
  const ds = ctx.diags.get(el);
  const sev = ds ? (ds.some(isErr) ? "has-error" : ds.some((d) => d.severity === "warning") ? "has-warning" : "") : "";
  return [base, sev, ctx.sel === el ? "is-selected" : ""].filter(Boolean).join(" ");
}
const tip = (el: Element, ctx: Ctx) => ctx.diags.get(el)?.sort((a, b) => SEV_RANK[a.severity] - SEV_RANK[b.severity])
  .map((d) => `${d.rule_id}: ${d.message}`).join("\n");

function Label({ el, ctx }: { el: Element; ctx: Ctx }) {
  if (!ctx.tags) return null;
  const s = attrSummary(el);
  return <span className="x-label" onClick={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); ctx.select(el); }}>{el.nodeName}{s && <span className="x-attrs"> {s}</span>}</span>;
}

function Block({ el, ctx, force }: { el: Element; ctx: Ctx; force?: boolean }) {
  if (!force && ctx.skip.has(el)) return null;
  const kids = Array.from(el.childNodes);
  const name = el.localName;
  const select = (e: React.MouseEvent) => { e.stopPropagation(); ctx.select(el); };
  if (!kids.some((n) => n.nodeType === Node.ELEMENT_NODE) && !hasText(el)) {
    return (
      <span className={nodeClass(el, ctx, "x-node x-atom")} data-name={name} title={tip(el, ctx)} onClick={select}>
        <span className="x-label">{el.nodeName}</span>{attrSummary(el, 4) && <span className="x-summary">{attrSummary(el, 4)}</span>}
      </span>
    );
  }
  if (hasText(el)) {
    return (
      <div className={nodeClass(el, ctx, "x-node x-text")} data-name={name} title={tip(el, ctx)} onClick={select}>
        <Label el={el} ctx={ctx} />
        <span className="x-content"><Inline nodes={kids} ctx={ctx} /></span>
      </div>
    );
  }
  const leaves = recordLeaves(el);
  if (!ctx.tags && leaves) {
    // a record (spare part, supply, tool: name, code, part number, quantity): one line of labelled fields
    return (
      <div className={nodeClass(el, ctx, "x-node x-record")} data-name={name} title={tip(el, ctx)} onClick={select}>
        {leaves.map((c) => (
          <span key={ctx.key(c)} className={nodeClass(c, ctx, "x-node x-field")} data-name={c.localName} title={tip(c, ctx)}
            onClick={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); ctx.select(c); }}>
            <span className="x-cap">{humanize(c.localName)}</span>
            {hasText(c) ? <Inline nodes={Array.from(c.childNodes)} ctx={ctx} /> : <span className="x-summary">{attrSummary(c, 3) || "—"}</span>}
          </span>
        ))}
      </div>
    );
  }
  const body = kids.map((n) => n.nodeType === Node.ELEMENT_NODE ? <Block key={ctx.key(n)} el={n as Element} ctx={ctx} />
    : n.nodeType === Node.COMMENT_NODE && ctx.tags ? <div key={ctx.key(n)} className="x-comment">{`<!-- ${n.textContent?.trim()} -->`}</div> : null);
  if (!ctx.tags && FOLDED.has(name)) {
    // the title reads as the document's heading; the rest of the identification is folded
    const title = el.getElementsByTagName("dmTitle")[0] ?? null;
    if (title) ctx.skip.add(title);
    return (
      <>
      {title && <header className="x-doc-title">
        {dmcOf(el) && <p className="x-dmc">{dmcOf(el)}</p>}
        <Block el={title} ctx={ctx} force />
        {metaOf(el) && <p className="x-meta">{metaOf(el)}</p>}
      </header>}
      <details className={nodeClass(el, ctx, "x-node x-fold")} data-name={name} title={tip(el, ctx)}>
        <summary>{FOLD_LABEL[name] ?? name}{ctx.diags.get(el) || Array.from(ctx.diags.keys()).some((k) => el.contains(k)) ? <span className="x-fold-flag"> · has problems</span> : null}</summary>
        {body}
      </details>
      </>
    );
  }
  return (
    <div className={nodeClass(el, ctx, "x-node x-block")} data-name={name} title={tip(el, ctx)} onClick={select}>
      <Label el={el} ctx={ctx} />
      {body}
    </div>
  );
}

function Inline({ nodes, ctx }: { nodes: ChildNode[]; ctx: Ctx }) {
  return (
    <>
      {nodes.map((n) => {
        if (n.nodeType === Node.TEXT_NODE || n.nodeType === Node.CDATA_SECTION_NODE) {
          return n.textContent!.trim() === "" ? <Fragment key={ctx.key(n)}>{" "}</Fragment>
            : <EditableText key={ctx.key(n)} node={n as CharacterData} ctx={ctx} />;
        }
        if (n.nodeType === Node.ELEMENT_NODE) {
          const el = n as Element;
          const kids = Array.from(el.childNodes);
          return (
            <span key={ctx.key(n)} className={nodeClass(el, ctx, "x-node x-inl")} data-name={el.localName} title={tip(el, ctx)}
              onClick={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); ctx.select(el); }}>
              {ctx.tags && <span className="x-inl-tag">{el.nodeName}</span>}
              {kids.length ? <Inline nodes={kids} ctx={ctx} /> : <span className="x-inl-empty">{attrSummary(el, 2) || el.nodeName}</span>}
            </span>
          );
        }
        return null;
      })}
    </>
  );
}

function EditableText({ node, ctx }: { node: CharacterData; ctx: Ctx }) {
  const ref = useRef<HTMLSpanElement>(null);
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    if (ref.current && document.activeElement !== ref.current && ref.current.textContent !== node.data) ref.current.textContent = node.data;
  });
  return (
    <span ref={ref} className="x-t" contentEditable={ctx.readOnly ? false : "plaintext-only"} suppressContentEditableWarning spellCheck
      onKeyDown={(e) => { if (e.key === "Enter") e.preventDefault(); }}
      onInput={(e) => { node.data = e.currentTarget.textContent ?? ""; ctx.edited(); }} />
  );
}

function Inspector({ el, ctx, line, onLine, onStructure, onClose, problems }: {
  el: Element; ctx: Ctx; line?: number; onLine: (l: number) => void; onStructure: () => void; onClose: () => void; problems: Json[];
}) {
  const [, force] = useState(0);
  const [newName, setNewName] = useState("");
  const [newValue, setNewValue] = useState("");
  const attrs = Array.from(el.attributes);
  const isRoot = !el.parentElement;
  const setAttr = (name: string, value: string) => { el.setAttribute(name, value); ctx.edited(); force((x) => x + 1); };
  const removeAttr = (name: string) => { el.removeAttribute(name); onStructure(); };
  const addAttr = () => {
    const n = newName.trim();
    if (!/^[A-Za-z_][\w.:-]*$/.test(n)) return;
    el.setAttribute(n, newValue); setNewName(""); setNewValue(""); onStructure();
  };
  const duplicate = () => { el.parentNode!.insertBefore(el.cloneNode(true), el.nextSibling); onStructure(); };
  const remove = () => { onClose(); el.parentNode!.removeChild(el); onStructure(); };
  const up = () => { const p = el.previousElementSibling; if (p) { el.parentNode!.insertBefore(el, p); onStructure(); } };
  const down = () => { const n = el.nextElementSibling; if (n) { el.parentNode!.insertBefore(n, el); onStructure(); } };

  return (
    <aside className="x-inspector" aria-label="Element">
      <div className="x-insp-head">
        <h3><code>{el.nodeName}</code></h3>
        <button className="link" onClick={onClose} aria-label="Close">Close</button>
      </div>
      <p className="x-path" title={readablePath(el)}>{readablePath(el)}</p>
      {line && <button className="link" onClick={() => onLine(line)}>Show in XML, line {line}</button>}
      {problems.length > 0 && <div className="x-insp-diags">
        {problems.map((d, i) => (
          <div key={i} className={`diag-card sev-${isErr(d) ? "error" : d.severity}`}>
            <strong>{d.rule_id}</strong> {d.message}{d.suggestion && <div className="fine">{d.suggestion}</div>}
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>}
      <h4>Attributes</h4>
      {attrs.length === 0 && <p className="fine">None.</p>}
      <table className="x-attrs-t"><tbody>
        {attrs.map((a) => (
          <tr key={a.name}>
            <th scope="row">{a.name}</th>
            <td><input value={a.value} readOnly={ctx.readOnly} onChange={(e) => setAttr(a.name, e.target.value)} aria-label={a.name} /></td>
            <td>{!ctx.readOnly && !a.name.startsWith("xmlns") && <button className="link" onClick={() => removeAttr(a.name)} aria-label={`Remove ${a.name}`}>Remove</button>}</td>
          </tr>
        ))}
      </tbody></table>
      {!ctx.readOnly && <div className="x-add-attr">
        <input placeholder="name" value={newName} onChange={(e) => setNewName(e.target.value)} aria-label="New attribute name" />
        <input placeholder="value" value={newValue} onChange={(e) => setNewValue(e.target.value)} aria-label="New attribute value"
          onKeyDown={(e) => { if (e.key === "Enter") addAttr(); }} />
        <button className="btn" onClick={addAttr} disabled={!newName.trim()}>Add</button>
      </div>}
      {!ctx.readOnly && !isRoot && <>
        <h4>Element</h4>
        <div className="x-insp-actions">
          <button className="btn" onClick={up} disabled={!el.previousElementSibling}>Move up</button>
          <button className="btn" onClick={down} disabled={!el.nextElementSibling}>Move down</button>
          <button className="btn" onClick={duplicate}>Duplicate</button>
          <button className="btn danger" onClick={remove}>Delete</button>
        </div>
        <p className="fine">The check runs again as you edit; the schema says what may go where.</p>
      </>}
    </aside>
  );
}
